verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā l-jidāru fakāna lighulāmayni yatīmayni fī l-madīnati wakāna taḥtahu kanzun lahumā wakāna abūhumā ṣāliḥan fa-arāda rabbuka an yablughā ashuddahumā wayastakhrijā kanzahumā raḥmatan min rabbika wamā faʿaltuhu ʿan amrī dhālika tawīlu mā lam tasṭiʿ ʿalayhi ṣabra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما الجدار فكان لغلمين يتيمين فى المدينة وكان تحته كنز لهما وكان أبوهما صلحا فأراد ربك أن يبلغا أشدهما ويستخرجا كنزهما رحمة من ربك وما فعلته عن أمرى ذلك تأويل ما لم تسطع عليه صبرا

verse_text_english: They ask you about Zul-Qarnain. Say, "I will narrate to you some of his history."
verse_text_arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayasalūnaka ʿan dhī l-qarnayni qul sa-atlū ʿalaykum min'hu dhik'ra
verse_subtitle_english: Zul-Qarnain: The One With the Two Horns or Two Generations
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويسـٔلونك عن ذى القرنين قل سأتلوا عليكم منه ذكرا

verse_text_english: We granted him authority on earth, and provided him with all kinds of means.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ سَبَبًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā makkannā lahu fī l-arḍi waātaynāhu min kulli shayin sababa
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا مكنا له فى الأرض وءاتينه من كل شىء سببا

verse_text_english: Then, he pursued one way.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-atbaʿa sababa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأتبع سببا

verse_text_english: When he reached the far west, he found the sun setting in a vast ocean, and found people there. We said, "O Zul-Qarnain, you can rule as you wish; either punish, or be kind to them."
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًا قُلْنَا يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā idhā balagha maghriba l-shamsi wajadahā taghrubu fī ʿaynin ḥami-atin wawajada ʿindahā qawman qul'nā yādhā l-qarnayni immā an tuʿadhiba wa-immā an tattakhidha fīhim ḥus'na
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى إذا بلغ مغرب الشمس وجدها تغرب فى عين حمئة ووجد عندها قوما قلنا يذا القرنين إما أن تعذب وإما أن تتخذ فيهم حسنا

verse_text_english: He said, "As for those who transgress, we will punish them, then, when they return to their Lord, He will commit them to more retribution.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla ammā man ẓalama fasawfa nuʿadhibuhu thumma yuraddu ilā rabbihi fayuʿadhibuhu ʿadhāban nuk'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أما من ظلم فسوف نعذبه ثم يرد إلى ربه فيعذبه عذابا نكرا

verse_text_english: "As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a good reward; we will treat them kindly."
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan falahu jazāan l-ḥus'nā wasanaqūlu lahu min amrinā yus'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما من ءامن وعمل صلحا فله جزاء الحسنى وسنقول له من أمرنا يسرا

verse_text_english: Then he pursued another way.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma atbaʿa sababa
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أتبع سببا

verse_text_english: When he reached the far east, he found the sun rising on people who had nothing to shelter them from it.
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā idhā balagha maṭliʿa l-shamsi wajadahā taṭluʿu ʿalā qawmin lam najʿal lahum min dūnihā sit'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى إذا بلغ مطلع الشمس وجدها تطلع على قوم لم نجعل لهم من دونها سترا

verse_text_english: Naturally, we were fully aware of everything he found out.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: kadhālika waqad aḥaṭnā bimā ladayhi khub'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك وقد أحطنا بما لديه خبرا

verse_text_english: He then pursued another way.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma atbaʿa sababa
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أتبع سببا

verse_text_english: When he reached the valley between two palisades, he found people whose language was barely understandable.
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā idhā balagha bayna l-sadayni wajada min dūnihimā qawman lā yakādūna yafqahūna qawla
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى إذا بلغ بين السدين وجد من دونهما قوما لا يكادون يفقهون قولا

verse_text_english: They said, "O Zul-Qarnain, Gog and Magog are corruptors of the earth. Can we pay you to create a barrier between us and them?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qālū yādhā l-qarnayni inna yajūja wamajūja muf'sidūna fī l-arḍi fahal najʿalu laka kharjan ʿalā an tajʿala baynanā wabaynahum sadda
verse_footnote_english: *18:94-98 One of my duties as God's Messenger of the Covenant is to state that Gog and Magog, the final sign before the end of the world, will reappear in 2270 AD (1700 AH), just 10 years before the end. Note that Gog and Magog occur in Suras 18 and 21, precisely 17 verses before the end of each sura, representing 17 lunar centuries (see 72:27 and Appendix 25).
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا يذا القرنين إن يأجوج ومأجوج مفسدون فى الأرض فهل نجعل لك خرجا على أن تجعل بيننا وبينهم سدا

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord has given me great bounties. If you cooperate with me, I will build a dam between you and them.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla mā makkannī fīhi rabbī khayrun fa-aʿīnūnī biquwwatin ajʿal baynakum wabaynahum radma
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال ما مكنى فيه ربى خير فأعينونى بقوة أجعل بينكم وبينهم ردما

verse_text_english: "Bring to me masses of iron." Once he filled the gap between the two palisades, he said, "Blow." Once it was red hot, he said, "Help me pour tar on top of it."
verse_text_arabic: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: ātūnī zubara l-ḥadīdi ḥattā idhā sāwā bayna l-ṣadafayni qāla unfukhū ḥattā idhā jaʿalahu nāran qāla ātūnī uf'righ ʿalayhi qiṭ'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءاتونى زبر الحديد حتى إذا ساوى بين الصدفين قال انفخوا حتى إذا جعله نارا قال ءاتونى أفرغ عليه قطرا

verse_text_english: Thus, they could not climb it, nor could they bore holes in it.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًا
verse_text_transliterated: famā is'ṭāʿū an yaẓharūhu wamā is'taṭāʿū lahu naqba
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما اسطعوا أن يظهروه وما استطعوا له نقبا

verse_text_english: He said, "This is mercy from my Lord. When the prophecy of my Lord comes to pass, He will cause the dam to crumble. The prophecy of my Lord is truth."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّى فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla hādhā raḥmatun min rabbī fa-idhā jāa waʿdu rabbī jaʿalahu dakkāa wakāna waʿdu rabbī ḥaqqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال هذا رحمة من ربى فإذا جاء وعد ربى جعله دكاء وكان وعد ربى حقا

verse_text_english: At that time, we will let them invade with one another, then the horn will be blown, and we will summon them all together.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَٰهُمْ جَمْعًا
verse_text_transliterated: wataraknā baʿḍahum yawma-idhin yamūju fī baʿḍin wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fajamaʿnāhum jamʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتركنا بعضهم يومئذ يموج فى بعض ونفخ فى الصور فجمعنهم جمعا

verse_text_english: We will present Hell, on that day, to the disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا
verse_text_transliterated: waʿaraḍnā jahannama yawma-idhin lil'kāfirīna ʿarḍa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعرضنا جهنم يومئذ للكفرين عرضا

verse_text_english: They are the ones whose eyes were too veiled to see My message. Nor could they hear.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna kānat aʿyunuhum fī ghiṭāin ʿan dhik'rī wakānū lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين كانت أعينهم فى غطاء عن ذكرى وكانوا لا يستطيعون سمعا

verse_text_english: Do those who disbelieve think that they can get away with setting up My servants as gods beside Me? We have prepared for the disbelievers Hell as an eternal abode.
verse_text_arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًا
verse_text_transliterated: afaḥasiba alladhīna kafarū an yattakhidhū ʿibādī min dūnī awliyāa innā aʿtadnā jahannama lil'kāfirīna nuzula
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفحسب الذين كفروا أن يتخذوا عبادى من دونى أولياء إنا أعتدنا جهنم للكفرين نزلا

verse_text_english: Say, "Shall I tell you who the worst losers are?
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul hal nunabbi-ukum bil-akhsarīna aʿmāla
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل هل ننبئكم بالأخسرين أعملا

verse_text_english: "They are the ones whose works in this life are totally astray, but they think that they are doing good."
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna ḍalla saʿyuhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wahum yaḥsabūna annahum yuḥ'sinūna ṣun'ʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين ضل سعيهم فى الحيوة الدنيا وهم يحسبون أنهم يحسنون صنعا

verse_text_english: Such are the ones who disbelieved in the revelations of their Lord and in meeting Him. Therefore, their works are in vain; on the Day of Resurrection, they have no weight.
verse_text_arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًا
verse_text_transliterated: ulāika alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim waliqāihi faḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum falā nuqīmu lahum yawma l-qiyāmati wazna
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولئك الذين كفروا بـٔايت ربهم ولقائه فحبطت أعملهم فلا نقيم لهم يوم القيمة وزنا

verse_text_english: Their just requital is Hell, in return for their disbelief, and for mocking My revelations and My messengers.
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
verse_text_transliterated: dhālika jazāuhum jahannamu bimā kafarū wa-ittakhadhū āyātī warusulī huzuwa
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذلك جزاؤهم جهنم بما كفروا واتخذوا ءايتى ورسلى هزوا

verse_text_english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life they have deserved a blissful Paradise as their abode.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātu l-fir'dawsi nuzula
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت كانت لهم جنت الفردوس نزلا

verse_text_english: Forever they abide therein; they will never want any other substitute.
verse_text_arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا
verse_text_transliterated: khālidīna fīhā lā yabghūna ʿanhā ḥiwala
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلدين فيها لا يبغون عنها حولا

verse_text_english: Say, "If the ocean were ink for the words of my Lord, the ocean would run out, before the words of my Lord run out, even if we double the ink supply."
verse_text_arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul law kāna l-baḥru midādan likalimāti rabbī lanafida l-baḥru qabla an tanfada kalimātu rabbī walaw ji'nā bimith'lihi madada
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل لو كان البحر مدادا لكلمت ربى لنفد البحر قبل أن تنفد كلمت ربى ولو جئنا بمثله مددا

verse_text_english: Say, "I am no more than a human like you, being inspired that your god is one god. Those who hope to meet their Lord shall work righteousness, and never worship any other god beside his Lord."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun faman kāna yarjū liqāa rabbihi falyaʿmal ʿamalan ṣāliḥan walā yush'rik biʿibādati rabbihi aḥada
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنما أنا بشر مثلكم يوحى إلى أنما إلهكم إله وحد فمن كان يرجوا لقاء ربه فليعمل عملا صلحا ولا يشرك بعبادة ربه أحدا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: K. H. Y. 'A. S.* (Kãf Hã Yã 'Ayn Sãd)
verse_text_arabic: كٓهيعٓصٓ
verse_text_transliterated: kaf-ha-ya-ain-saad
verse_footnote_english: *19:1 This is the maximum number of Quranic Initials, because this sura deals with such crucial matters as the miraculous birth of John and the virgin birth of Jesus, and strongly condemns the gross blasphemy that considers Jesus to be a son of God. The five initials provide a powerful physical evidence to support these issues (See Appendices 1 & 22).
verse_text_arabic_clean: كهيعص

verse_text_english: A narration about your Lord's mercy towards His servant Zachariah.
verse_text_arabic: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
verse_text_transliterated: dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyy
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذكر رحمت ربك عبده زكريا

verse_text_english: He called his Lord, a secret call.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ نادى ربه نداء خفيا

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, the bones have turned brittle in my body, and my hair is aflame with gray. As I implore You, my Lord, I never despair.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-ish'taʿala l-rasu shayban walam akun biduʿāika rabbi shaqiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب إنى وهن العظم منى واشتعل الرأس شيبا ولم أكن بدعائك رب شقيا

verse_text_english: "I worry about my dependants after me, and my wife has been sterile. Grant me, from You, an heir.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innī khif'tu l-mawāliya min warāī wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran fahab lī min ladunka waliyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنى خفت المولى من وراءى وكانت امرأتى عاقرا فهب لى من لدنك وليا

verse_text_english: "Let him be my heir and the heir of Jacob's clan, and make him, my Lord, acceptable."
verse_text_arabic: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wa-ij'ʿalhu rabbi raḍiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: يرثنى ويرث من ءال يعقوب واجعله رب رضيا

verse_text_english: "O Zachariah, we give you good news; a boy whose name shall be John (Yahya). We never created anyone like him before."
verse_text_arabic: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yāzakariyyā innā nubashiruka bighulāmin us'muhu yaḥyā lam najʿal lahu min qablu samiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: يزكريا إنا نبشرك بغلم اسمه يحيى لم نجعل له من قبل سميا

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, will I have a son despite my wife's sterility, and despite my old age?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran waqad balaghtu mina l-kibari ʿitiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب أنى يكون لى غلم وكانت امرأتى عاقرا وقد بلغت من الكبر عتيا

verse_text_english: He said, "Thus said your Lord: 'It is easy for Me to do. I created you before that, and you were nothing.'"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shaya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال كذلك قال ربك هو على هين وقد خلقتك من قبل ولم تك شيـٔا

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, give me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three consecutive nights."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب اجعل لى ءاية قال ءايتك ألا تكلم الناس ثلث ليال سويا

verse_text_english: He came out to his family, from the sanctuary, and signaled to them: "Meditate (on GOD) day and night."
verse_text_arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina l-miḥ'rābi fa-awḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū buk'ratan waʿashiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فخرج على قومه من المحراب فأوحى إليهم أن سبحوا بكرة وعشيا

verse_text_english: "O John, you shall uphold the scripture, strongly." We endowed him with wisdom, even in his youth.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yāyaḥyā khudhi l-kitāba biquwwatin waātaynāhu l-ḥuk'ma ṣabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ييحيى خذ الكتب بقوة وءاتينه الحكم صبيا

verse_text_english: And (we endowed him with) kindness from us and purity, for he was righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: waḥanānan min ladunnā wazakatan wakāna taqiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحنانا من لدنا وزكوة وكان تقيا

verse_text_english: He honored his parents, and was never a disobedient tyrant.
verse_text_arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wabarran biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبرا بولديه ولم يكن جبارا عصيا

verse_text_english: Peace be upon him the day he was born, the day he dies, and the day he is resurrected back to life.
verse_text_arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yub'ʿathu ḥayya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وسلم عليه يوم ولد ويوم يموت ويوم يبعث حيا

verse_text_english: Mention in the scripture Mary. She isolated herself from her family, into an eastern location.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi maryama idhi intabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر فى الكتب مريم إذ انتبذت من أهلها مكانا شرقيا

verse_text_english: While a barrier separated her from them, we sent to her our Spirit. He went to her in the form of a human being.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ittakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاتخذت من دونهم حجابا فأرسلنا إليها روحنا فتمثل لها بشرا سويا

verse_text_english: She said, "I seek refuge in the Most Gracious, that you may be righteous."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qālat innī aʿūdhu bil-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالت إنى أعوذ بالرحمن منك إن كنت تقيا

verse_text_english: He said, "I am the messenger of your Lord, to grant you a pure son."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًا زَكِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla innamā anā rasūlu rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulāman zakiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال إنما أنا رسول ربك لأهب لك غلما زكيا

verse_text_english: She said, "How can I have a son, when no man has touched me; I have never been unchaste."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun walam yamsasnī basharun walam aku baghiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالت أنى يكون لى غلم ولم يمسسنى بشر ولم أك بغيا

verse_text_english: He said, "Thus said your Lord, 'It is easy for Me. We will render him a sign for the people, and mercy from us. This is a predestined matter.'"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyinun walinajʿalahu āyatan lilnnāsi waraḥmatan minnā wakāna amran maqḍiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال كذلك قال ربك هو على هين ولنجعله ءاية للناس ورحمة منا وكان أمرا مقضيا

verse_text_english: When she bore him, she isolated herself to a faraway place.
verse_text_arabic: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: faḥamalathu fa-intabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فحملته فانتبذت به مكانا قصيا

verse_text_english: The birth process came to her by the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "(I am so ashamed;) I wish I were dead before this happened, and completely forgotten."
verse_text_arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ajāahā l-makhāḍu ilā jidh'ʿi l-nakhlati qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyan mansiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأجاءها المخاض إلى جذع النخلة قالت يليتنى مت قبل هذا وكنت نسيا منسيا

verse_text_english: (The infant) called her from beneath her, saying, "Do not grieve. Your Lord has provided you with a stream.
verse_text_arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فنادىها من تحتها ألا تحزنى قد جعل ربك تحتك سريا

verse_text_english: "If you shake the trunk of this palm tree, it will drop ripe dates for you.*
verse_text_arabic: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wahuzzī ilayki bijidh'ʿi l-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyya
verse_footnote_english: *19:25 Thus, Jesus was born in late September or early October. This is when dates ripen in the Middle East to the point of falling off the tree.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهزى إليك بجذع النخلة تسقط عليك رطبا جنيا

verse_text_english: "Eat and drink, and be happy. When you see anyone, say, 'I have made a vow of silence; I am not talking today to anyone.' "
verse_text_arabic: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fakulī wa-ish'rabī waqarrī ʿaynan fa-immā tarayinna mina l-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallima l-yawma insiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكلى واشربى وقرى عينا فإما ترين من البشر أحدا فقولى إنى نذرت للرحمن صوما فلن أكلم اليوم إنسيا

verse_text_english: She came to her family, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have committed something that is totally unexpected.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأتت به قومها تحمله قالوا يمريم لقد جئت شيـٔا فريا

verse_text_english: "O descendant of Aaron, your father was not a bad man, nor was your mother unchaste."
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawin wamā kānat ummuki baghiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأخت هرون ما كان أبوك امرأ سوء وما كانت أمك بغيا

verse_text_english: She pointed to him. They said, "How can we talk with an infant in the crib?"
verse_text_arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأشارت إليه قالوا كيف نكلم من كان فى المهد صبيا

verse_text_english: (The infant spoke and) said, "I am a servant of GOD. He has given me the scripture, and has appointed me a prophet.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال إنى عبد الله ءاتىنى الكتب وجعلنى نبيا

verse_text_english: "He made me blessed wherever I go, and enjoined me to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat) for as long as I live.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنى مباركا أين ما كنت وأوصنى بالصلوة والزكوة ما دمت حيا

verse_text_english: "I am to honor my mother; He did not make me a disobedient rebel.
verse_text_arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبرا بولدتى ولم يجعلنى جبارا شقيا

verse_text_english: "And peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I get resurrected."
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayya
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسلم على يوم ولدت ويوم أموت ويوم أبعث حيا

verse_text_english: That was Jesus, the son of Mary, and this is the truth of this matter, about which they continue to doubt.
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذلك عيسى ابن مريم قول الحق الذى فيه يمترون

verse_text_english: It does not befit GOD that He begets a son, be He glorified. To have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.
verse_text_arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verse_text_transliterated: mā kāna lillahi an yattakhidha min waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما كان لله أن يتخذ من ولد سبحنه إذا قضى أمرا فإنما يقول له كن فيكون

verse_text_english: He also proclaimed, "GOD is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him alone. This is the right path."*
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmu
verse_footnote_english: *19:36 This is similar to the statement attributed to Jesus in the Gospel of John 20:17.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن الله ربى وربكم فاعبدوه هذا صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: The various parties disputed among themselves (regarding the identity of Jesus). Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve from the sight of a terrible day.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاختلف الأحزاب من بينهم فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم

verse_text_english: Wait till you hear them and see them when they come to face us. The transgressors on that day will be totally lost.
verse_text_arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini l-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: أسمع بهم وأبصر يوم يأتوننا لكن الظلمون اليوم فى ضلل مبين

verse_text_english: Warn them about the day of remorse, when judgment will be issued. They are totally oblivious; they do not believe.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatin wahum lā yu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنذرهم يوم الحسرة إذ قضى الأمر وهم فى غفلة وهم لا يؤمنون

verse_text_english: We are the ones who inherit the earth and everyone on it; to us everyone will be returned.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا نحن نرث الأرض ومن عليها وإلينا يرجعون

verse_text_english: Mention in the scripture Abraham; he was a saint, a prophet.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر فى الكتب إبرهيم إنه كان صديقا نبيا

verse_text_english: He said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor help you in any way?
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
verse_text_transliterated: idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shaya
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ قال لأبيه يأبت لم تعبد ما لا يسمع ولا يبصر ولا يغنى عنك شيـٔا

verse_text_english: "O my father, I have received certain knowledge that you did not receive. Follow me, and I will guide you in a straight path.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأبت إنى قد جاءنى من العلم ما لم يأتك فاتبعنى أهدك صرطا سويا

verse_text_english: "O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil has rebelled against the Most Gracious.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yāabati lā taʿbudi l-shayṭāna inna l-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأبت لا تعبد الشيطن إن الشيطن كان للرحمن عصيا

verse_text_english: "O my father, I fear lest you incur retribution from the Most Gracious, then become an ally of the devil."
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yāabati innī akhāfu an yamassaka ʿadhābun mina l-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأبت إنى أخاف أن يمسك عذاب من الرحمن فتكون للشيطن وليا

verse_text_english: He said, "Have you forsaken my gods, O Abraham? Unless you stop, I will stone you. Leave me alone."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أراغب أنت عن ءالهتى يإبرهيم لئن لم تنته لأرجمنك واهجرنى مليا

verse_text_english: He said, "Peace be upon you. I will implore my Lord to forgive you; He has been Most Kind to me.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال سلم عليك سأستغفر لك ربى إنه كان بى حفيا

verse_text_english: "I will abandon you and the gods you worship besides GOD. I will worship only my Lord. By imploring my Lord alone, I cannot go wrong."
verse_text_arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأعتزلكم وما تدعون من دون الله وأدعوا ربى عسى ألا أكون بدعاء ربى شقيا

verse_text_english: Because he abandoned them and the gods they worshiped beside GOD, we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we made each of them a prophet.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما اعتزلهم وما يعبدون من دون الله وهبنا له إسحق ويعقوب وكلا جعلنا نبيا

verse_text_english: We showered them with our mercy, and we granted them an honorable position in history.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wawahabnā lahum min raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا وجعلنا لهم لسان صدق عليا

verse_text_english: Mention in the scripture Moses. He was devoted, and he was a messenger prophet.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣan wakāna rasūlan nabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر فى الكتب موسى إنه كان مخلصا وكان رسولا نبيا

verse_text_english: We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai. We brought him close, to confer with him.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wanādaynāhu min jānibi l-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وندينه من جانب الطور الأيمن وقربنه نجيا

verse_text_english: And we granted him, out of our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wawahabnā lahu min raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووهبنا له من رحمتنا أخاه هرون نبيا

verse_text_english: And mention in the scripture Ismail. He was truthful when he made a promise, and he was a messenger prophet.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر فى الكتب إسمعيل إنه كان صادق الوعد وكان رسولا نبيا

verse_text_english: He used to enjoin his family to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat); he was acceptable to his Lord.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكان يأمر أهله بالصلوة والزكوة وكان عند ربه مرضيا

verse_text_english: And mention in the scripture Idrîs. He was a saint, a prophet.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر فى الكتب إدريس إنه كان صديقا نبيا

verse_text_english: We raised him to an honorable rank.
verse_text_arabic: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ورفعنه مكانا عليا

verse_text_english: These are some of the prophets whom GOD blessed. They were chosen from among the descendants of Adam, and the descendants of those whom we carried with Noah, and the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom we guided and selected. When the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they fall prostrate, weeping.
verse_text_arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu l-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadan wabukiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولئك الذين أنعم الله عليهم من النبين من ذرية ءادم وممن حملنا مع نوح ومن ذرية إبرهيم وإسرءيل وممن هدينا واجتبينا إذا تتلى عليهم ءايت الرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا

verse_text_english: After them, He substituted generations who lost the Contact Prayers (Salat), and pursued their lusts. They will suffer the consequences.
verse_text_arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū l-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū l-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فخلف من بعدهم خلف أضاعوا الصلوة واتبعوا الشهوت فسوف يلقون غيا

verse_text_english: Only those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life will enter Paradise, without the least injustice.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
verse_text_transliterated: illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shaya
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا من تاب وءامن وعمل صلحا فأولئك يدخلون الجنة ولا يظلمون شيـٔا

verse_text_english: The gardens of Eden await them, as promised by the Most Gracious for those who worship Him, even in privacy. Certainly, His promise must come to pass.
verse_text_arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada l-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: جنت عدن التى وعد الرحمن عباده بالغيب إنه كان وعده مأتيا

verse_text_english: They will not hear any nonsense therein; only peace. They receive their provisions therein, day and night.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāman walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'ratan waʿashiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا إلا سلما ولهم رزقهم فيها بكرة وعشيا

verse_text_english: Such is Paradise; we grant it to those among our servants who are righteous.
verse_text_arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: تلك الجنة التى نورث من عبادنا من كان تقيا

verse_text_english: We do not come down except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs our past, our future, and everything between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما نتنزل إلا بأمر ربك له ما بين أيدينا وما خلفنا وما بين ذلك وما كان ربك نسيا

verse_text_english: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; you shall worship Him and steadfastly persevere in worshiping Him. Do you know of anyone who equals Him?
verse_text_arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب السموت والأرض وما بينهما فاعبده واصطبر لعبدته هل تعلم له سميا

verse_text_english: The human being asks, "After I die, do I come back to life?"
verse_text_arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويقول الإنسن أءذا ما مت لسوف أخرج حيا

verse_text_english: Did the human being forget that we created him already, and he was nothing?
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verse_text_transliterated: awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shaya
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولا يذكر الإنسن أنا خلقنه من قبل ولم يك شيـٔا

verse_text_english: By your Lord, we will certainly summon them, together with the devils, and will gather them around Hell, humiliated.
verse_text_arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فوربك لنحشرنهم والشيطين ثم لنحضرنهم حول جهنم جثيا

verse_text_english: Then we will pick out from each group the most ardent opponent of the Most Gracious.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā l-raḥmāni ʿitiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم لننزعن من كل شيعة أيهم أشد على الرحمن عتيا

verse_text_english: We know full well those who are most deserving of burning therein.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم لنحن أعلم بالذين هم أولى بها صليا

verse_text_english: Every single one of you must see it; this is an irrevocable decision of your Lord.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyya
verse_footnote_english: *19:71 As detailed in Appendix 11, we will be resurrected prior to God's physical arrival to our universe. That will be a temporary taste of Hell, since the absence of God is Hell. When God comes (89:22), the righteous will be rescued. See 19:72.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن منكم إلا واردها كان على ربك حتما مقضيا

verse_text_english: Then we rescue the righteous, and leave the transgressors in it, humiliated.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu l-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم ننجى الذين اتقوا ونذر الظلمين فيها جثيا

verse_text_english: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of us is more prosperous? Which of us is in the majority?"
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrun maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا تتلى عليهم ءايتنا بينت قال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا أى الفريقين خير مقاما وأحسن نديا

verse_text_english: Many a generation have we annihilated before them; they were more powerful, and more prosperous.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
verse_text_transliterated: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthan wari'ya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم أحسن أثثا ورءيا

verse_text_english: Say, "Those who choose to go astray, the Most Gracious will lead them on, until they see what is promised for them—either the retribution or the Hour. That is when they find out who really is worse off, and weaker in power."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul man kāna fī l-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu l-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā l-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun makānan wa-aḍʿafu junda
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل من كان فى الضللة فليمدد له الرحمن مدا حتى إذا رأوا ما يوعدون إما العذاب وإما الساعة فسيعلمون من هو شر مكانا وأضعف جندا

verse_text_english: GOD augments the guidance of those who choose to be guided. For the good deeds are eternally rewarded by your Lord, and bring far better returns.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudan wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun maradda
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويزيد الله الذين اهتدوا هدى والبقيت الصلحت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير مردا

verse_text_english: Have you noted the one who rejected our revelations then said, "I will be given wealth and children"?!
verse_text_arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālan wawalada
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفرءيت الذى كفر بـٔايتنا وقال لأوتين مالا وولدا

verse_text_english: Has he seen the future? Has he taken such a pledge from the Most Gracious?
verse_text_arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahda
verse_text_arabic_clean: أطلع الغيب أم اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا

verse_text_english: Indeed, we will record what he utters, then commit him to ever-increasing retribution.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi madda
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا سنكتب ما يقول ونمد له من العذاب مدا

verse_text_english: Then we inherit everything he possessed, and he comes back to us all alone.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā farda
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونرثه ما يقول ويأتينا فردا

verse_text_english: They worship beside GOD other gods that may be of help to them.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan liyakūnū lahum ʿizza
verse_text_arabic_clean: واتخذوا من دون الله ءالهة ليكونوا لهم عزا

verse_text_english: On the contrary; they will reject their idolatry, and will be their enemies.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍidda
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا سيكفرون بعبادتهم ويكونون عليهم ضدا

verse_text_english: Do you not see how we unleash the devils upon the disbelievers to stir them up?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
verse_text_transliterated: alam tara annā arsalnā l-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azza
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم تر أنا أرسلنا الشيطين على الكفرين تؤزهم أزا

verse_text_english: Do not be impatient; we are preparing for them some preparation.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿadda
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا تعجل عليهم إنما نعد لهم عدا

verse_text_english: The day will come when we summon the righteous before the Most Gracious in a group.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā l-raḥmāni wafda
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم نحشر المتقين إلى الرحمن وفدا

verse_text_english: And we will herd the guilty to Hell, to be their eternal abode.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'da
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونسوق المجرمين إلى جهنم وردا

verse_text_english: No one will possess the power to intercede, except those who conform to the laws of the Most Gracious.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: lā yamlikūna l-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahda
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يملكون الشفعة إلا من اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا

verse_text_english: They said, "The Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu walada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا

verse_text_english: You have uttered a gross blasphemy.
verse_text_arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: laqad ji'tum shayan idda
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد جئتم شيـٔا إدا

verse_text_english: The heavens are about to shatter, the earth is about to tear asunder, and the mountains are about to crumble.
verse_text_arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu hadda
verse_text_arabic_clean: تكاد السموت يتفطرن منه وتنشق الأرض وتخر الجبال هدا

verse_text_english: Because they claim that the Most Gracious has begotten a son.
verse_text_arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: an daʿaw lilrraḥmāni walada
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن دعوا للرحمن ولدا

verse_text_english: It is not befitting the Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni an yattakhidha walada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما ينبغى للرحمن أن يتخذ ولدا

verse_text_english: Every single one in the heavens and the earth is a servant of the Most Gracious.
verse_text_arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: in kullu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī l-raḥmāni ʿabda
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن كل من فى السموت والأرض إلا ءاتى الرحمن عبدا

verse_text_english: He has encompassed them, and has counted them one by one.
verse_text_arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿadda
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد أحصىهم وعدهم عدا

verse_text_english: All of them will come before Him on the Day of Resurrection as individuals.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati farda
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكلهم ءاتيه يوم القيمة فردا

verse_text_english: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life, the Most Gracious will shower them with love.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu l-raḥmānu wudda
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت سيجعل لهم الرحمن ودا

verse_text_english: We thus made this (Quran) elucidated in your tongue, in order to deliver good news to the righteous, and to warn with it the opponents.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawman ludda
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإنما يسرنه بلسانك لتبشر به المتقين وتنذر به قوما لدا

verse_text_english: Many a generation before them we annihilated; can you perceive any of them, or hear from them any sound?
verse_text_arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'za
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هل تحس منهم من أحد أو تسمع لهم ركزا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: T. H.*
verse_text_arabic: طه
verse_text_transliterated: tta-ha
verse_footnote_english: *20:1 The role of these Quranic initials as components of the Quran's awesome mathematical miracle is given in detail in Appendix 1.
verse_text_arabic_clean: طه

verse_text_english: We did not reveal the Quran to you, to cause you any hardship.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashq
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أنزلنا عليك القرءان لتشقى

verse_text_english: Only to remind the reverent.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: illā tadhkiratan liman yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا تذكرة لمن يخشى

verse_text_english: A revelation from the Creator of the earth and the high heavens.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verse_text_transliterated: tanzīlan mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wal-samāwāti l-ʿul
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزيلا ممن خلق الأرض والسموت العلى

verse_text_english: The Most Gracious; He has assumed all authority.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: al-raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi is'taw
verse_text_arabic_clean: الرحمن على العرش استوى

verse_text_english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens, and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the ground.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta l-thar
verse_text_arabic_clean: له ما فى السموت وما فى الأرض وما بينهما وما تحت الثرى

verse_text_english: Whether you declare your convictions (or not) He knows the secret, and what is even more hidden.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu l-sira wa-akhf
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن تجهر بالقول فإنه يعلم السر وأخفى

verse_text_english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. To Him belong the most beautiful names.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله لا إله إلا هو له الأسماء الحسنى

verse_text_english: Have you noted the history of Moses?
verse_text_arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wahal atāka ḥadīthu mūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهل أتىك حديث موسى

verse_text_english: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, "Stay here. I have seen a fire. Maybe I can bring you some of it, or find some guidance at the fire."
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
verse_text_transliterated: idh raā nāran faqāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum min'hā biqabasin aw ajidu ʿalā l-nāri huda
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ رءا نارا فقال لأهله امكثوا إنى ءانست نارا لعلى ءاتيكم منها بقبس أو أجد على النار هدى

verse_text_english: When he came to it, he was called, "O, Moses.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā atāhā nūdiya yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما أتىها نودى يموسى

verse_text_english: "I am your Lord; remove your sandals. You are in the sacred valley, Tuwã.
verse_text_arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verse_text_transliterated: innī anā rabbuka fa-ikh'laʿ naʿlayka innaka bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwa
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنى أنا ربك فاخلع نعليك إنك بالواد المقدس طوى

verse_text_english: "I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anā ikh'tartuka fa-is'tamiʿ limā yūḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا اخترتك فاستمع لما يوحى

verse_text_english: "I am GOD; there is no other god beside Me. You shall worship Me alone, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) to remember Me.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verse_text_transliterated: innanī anā l-lahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'bud'nī wa-aqimi l-ṣalata lidhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: إننى أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا فاعبدنى وأقم الصلوة لذكرى

verse_text_english: "The Hour (end of the world) is surely coming; I will keep it almost hidden. For each soul must be paid for its works.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-sāʿata ātiyatun akādu ukh'fīhā lituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿ
verse_subtitle_english: End of the World is Not Hidden*
verse_footnote_english: *20:15 The end of the world is given in the Quran, God's final message (15:87).
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الساعة ءاتية أكاد أخفيها لتجزى كل نفس بما تسعى

verse_text_english: "Do not be diverted therefrom by those who do not believe in it— those who pursue their own opinions—lest you fall.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā man lā yu'minu bihā wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu fatard
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها واتبع هوىه فتردى

verse_text_english: "What is this in your right hand, Moses?"
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā til'ka biyamīnika yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تلك بيمينك يموسى

verse_text_english: He said, "This is my staff. I lean on it, herd my sheep with it, and I use it for other purposes."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla hiya ʿaṣāya atawakka-u ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamī waliya fīhā maāribu ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال هى عصاى أتوكؤا عليها وأهش بها على غنمى ولى فيها مـٔارب أخرى

verse_text_english: He said, "Throw it down, Moses."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla alqihā yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال ألقها يموسى

verse_text_english: He threw it down, whereupon it turned into a moving serpent.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-alqāhā fa-idhā hiya ḥayyatun tasʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: فألقىها فإذا هى حية تسعى

verse_text_english: He said, "Pick it up; do not be afraid. We will return it to its original state.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla khudh'hā walā takhaf sanuʿīduhā sīratahā l-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال خذها ولا تخف سنعيدها سيرتها الأولى

verse_text_english: "And hold your hand under your wing; it will come out white without a blemish; another proof.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uḍ'mum yadaka ilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin āyatan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: واضمم يدك إلى جناحك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء ءاية أخرى

verse_text_english: "We thus show you some of our great portents.
verse_text_arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verse_text_transliterated: linuriyaka min āyātinā l-kub'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: لنريك من ءايتنا الكبرى

verse_text_english: "Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed."
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, cool my temper.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi ish'raḥ lī ṣadr
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب اشرح لى صدرى

verse_text_english: "And make this matter easy for me.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: wayassir lī amr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويسر لى أمرى

verse_text_english: "And untie a knot from my tongue.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uḥ'lul ʿuq'datan min lisān
verse_text_arabic_clean: واحلل عقدة من لسانى

verse_text_english: "So they can understand my speech.
verse_text_arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verse_text_transliterated: yafqahū qawl
verse_text_arabic_clean: يفقهوا قولى

verse_text_english: "And appoint an assistant for me from my family.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ij'ʿal lī wazīran min ahl
verse_text_arabic_clean: واجعل لى وزيرا من أهلى

verse_text_english: "My brother Aaron.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
verse_text_transliterated: hārūna akh
verse_text_arabic_clean: هرون أخى

verse_text_english: "Strengthen me with him.
verse_text_arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: ush'dud bihi azr
verse_text_arabic_clean: اشدد به أزرى

verse_text_english: "Let him be my partner in this matter.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ashrik'hu fī amr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأشركه فى أمرى

verse_text_english: "That we may glorify You frequently.
verse_text_arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: kay nusabbiḥaka kathīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: كى نسبحك كثيرا

verse_text_english: "And commemorate You frequently.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wanadhkuraka kathīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونذكرك كثيرا

verse_text_english: "You are Seer of us."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: innaka kunta binā baṣīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنك كنت بنا بصيرا

verse_text_english: He said, "Your request is granted, O Moses.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla qad ūtīta su'laka yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال قد أوتيت سؤلك يموسى

verse_text_english: "We have blessed you another time.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad manannā ʿalayka marratan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد مننا عليك مرة أخرى

verse_text_english: "When we revealed to your mother what we revealed.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: idh awḥaynā ilā ummika mā yūḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ أوحينا إلى أمك ما يوحى

verse_text_english: "Saying: 'Throw him into the box, then throw him into the river. The river will throw him onto the shore, to be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.' I showered you with love from Me, and I had you made before My watchful eye.
verse_text_arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verse_text_transliterated: ani iq'dhifīhi fī l-tābūti fa-iq'dhifīhi fī l-yami falyul'qihi l-yamu bil-sāḥili yakhudh'hu ʿaduwwun lī waʿaduwwun lahu wa-alqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbatan minnī walituṣ'naʿa ʿalā ʿayn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن اقذفيه فى التابوت فاقذفيه فى اليم فليلقه اليم بالساحل يأخذه عدو لى وعدو له وألقيت عليك محبة منى ولتصنع على عينى

verse_text_english: "Your sister walked to them and said, 'I can tell you about a nursing mother who can take good care of him.' We thus returned you to your mother, that she may be happy and stop worrying. And when you killed a soul, we saved you from the grievous consequences; indeed we tested you thoroughly. You stayed years with the people of Midyan, and now you have come back in accordance with a precise plan.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًا فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh tamshī ukh'tuka fataqūlu hal adullukum ʿalā man yakfuluhu farajaʿnāka ilā ummika kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina l-ghami wafatannāka futūnan falabith'ta sinīna fī ahli madyana thumma ji'ta ʿalā qadarin yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ تمشى أختك فتقول هل أدلكم على من يكفله فرجعنك إلى أمك كى تقر عينها ولا تحزن وقتلت نفسا فنجينك من الغم وفتنك فتونا فلبثت سنين فى أهل مدين ثم جئت على قدر يموسى

verse_text_english: "I have made you just for Me.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iṣ'ṭanaʿtuka linafs
verse_text_arabic_clean: واصطنعتك لنفسى

verse_text_english: "Go with your brother, supported by My signs, and do not waver in remembering Me.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: idh'hab anta wa-akhūka biāyātī walā taniyā fī dhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهب أنت وأخوك بـٔايتى ولا تنيا فى ذكرى

verse_text_english: "Go to Pharaoh, for he transgressed.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh'habā ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهبا إلى فرعون إنه طغى

verse_text_english: "Speak to him nicely; he may take heed, or become reverent."
verse_text_arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: faqūlā lahu qawlan layyinan laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقولا له قولا لينا لعله يتذكر أو يخشى

verse_text_english: They said, "Our Lord, we fear lest he may attack us, or transgress."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qālā rabbanā innanā nakhāfu an yafruṭa ʿalaynā aw an yaṭgh
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالا ربنا إننا نخاف أن يفرط علينا أو أن يطغى

verse_text_english: He said, "Do not be afraid, for I will be with you, listening and watching.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla lā takhāfā innanī maʿakumā asmaʿu wa-ar
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال لا تخافا إننى معكما أسمع وأرى

verse_text_english: "Go to him and say, 'We are two messengers from your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go. You must refrain from persecuting them. We bring a sign from your Lord, and peace is the lot of those who heed the guidance.
verse_text_arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: fatiyāhu faqūlā innā rasūlā rabbika fa-arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla walā tuʿadhib'hum qad ji'nāka biāyatin min rabbika wal-salāmu ʿalā mani ittabaʿa l-hud
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأتياه فقولا إنا رسولا ربك فأرسل معنا بنى إسرءيل ولا تعذبهم قد جئنك بـٔاية من ربك والسلم على من اتبع الهدى

verse_text_english: " 'We have been inspired that the retribution will inevitably afflict those who disbelieve and turn away.' "
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: innā qad ūḥiya ilaynā anna l-ʿadhāba ʿalā man kadhaba watawall
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا قد أوحى إلينا أن العذاب على من كذب وتولى

verse_text_english: He said, "Who is your Lord, O Moses."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla faman rabbukumā yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فمن ربكما يموسى

verse_text_english: He said, "Our Lord is the One who granted everything its existence, and its guidance."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbunā alladhī aʿṭā kulla shayin khalqahu thumma had
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال ربنا الذى أعطى كل شىء خلقه ثم هدى

verse_text_english: He said, "What about the past generations?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla famā bālu l-qurūni l-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فما بال القرون الأولى

verse_text_english: He said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verse_text_transliterated: qāla ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī fī kitābin lā yaḍillu rabbī walā yans
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال علمها عند ربى فى كتب لا يضل ربى ولا ينسى

verse_text_english: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and paved in it roads for you. And He sends down from the sky water with which we produce many different kinds of plants.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ شَتَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wasalaka lakum fīhā subulan wa-anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi azwājan min nabātin shatt
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى جعل لكم الأرض مهدا وسلك لكم فيها سبلا وأنزل من السماء ماء فأخرجنا به أزوجا من نبات شتى

verse_text_english: Eat and raise your livestock. These are sufficient proofs for those who possess intelligence.*
verse_text_arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: kulū wa-ir'ʿaw anʿāmakum inna fī dhālika laāyātin li-ulī l-nuh
verse_footnote_english: *20:54 Those who possess intelligence appreciate the fact that we are astronauts who were launched into space on this 'Spaceship Earth.' God provided us with renewable food, water, pets, wildlife, and livestock, as we embark on this temporary space odyssey. Compare God's provisions to 'Spaceship Earth' with the provisions we give to our astronauts (Appendix 7).
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلوا وارعوا أنعمكم إن فى ذلك لءايت لأولى النهى

verse_text_english: From it we created you, into it we return you, and from it we bring you out once more.
verse_text_arabic: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: min'hā khalaqnākum wafīhā nuʿīdukum wamin'hā nukh'rijukum tāratan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: منها خلقنكم وفيها نعيدكم ومنها نخرجكم تارة أخرى

verse_text_english: We showed him all our proofs, but he disbelieved and refused.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad araynāhu āyātinā kullahā fakadhaba wa-ab
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أرينه ءايتنا كلها فكذب وأبى

verse_text_english: He said, "Did you come here to take us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla aji'tanā litukh'rijanā min arḍinā bisiḥ'rika yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أجئتنا لتخرجنا من أرضنا بسحرك يموسى

verse_text_english: "We will surely show you similar magic. Therefore, set an appointment that neither we, nor you will violate; in a neutral place."
verse_text_arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى
verse_text_transliterated: falanatiyannaka bisiḥ'rin mith'lihi fa-ij'ʿal baynanā wabaynaka mawʿidan lā nukh'lifuhu naḥnu walā anta makānan suwa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلنأتينك بسحر مثله فاجعل بيننا وبينك موعدا لا نخلفه نحن ولا أنت مكانا سوى

verse_text_english: He said, "Your appointed time shall be the day of festivities. Let us all meet in the forenoon."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًى
verse_text_transliterated: qāla mawʿidukum yawmu l-zīnati wa-an yuḥ'shara l-nāsu ḍuḥa
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال موعدكم يوم الزينة وأن يحشر الناس ضحى

verse_text_english: Pharaoh summoned his forces, then came.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fatawallā fir'ʿawnu fajamaʿa kaydahu thumma at
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتولى فرعون فجمع كيده ثم أتى

verse_text_english: Moses said to them, "Woe to you. Do you fabricate lies to fight GOD and thus incur His retribution? Such fabricators will surely fail."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla lahum mūsā waylakum lā taftarū ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fayus'ḥitakum biʿadhābin waqad khāba mani if'tar
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال لهم موسى ويلكم لا تفتروا على الله كذبا فيسحتكم بعذاب وقد خاب من افترى

verse_text_english: They disputed among themselves, as they conferred privately.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fatanāzaʿū amrahum baynahum wa-asarrū l-najw
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتنزعوا أمرهم بينهم وأسروا النجوى

verse_text_english: They said, "These two are no more than magicians who wish to take you out of your land with their magic, and to destroy your ideal way of life.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū in hādhāni lasāḥirāni yurīdāni an yukh'rijākum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihimā wayadhhabā biṭarīqatikumu l-muth'l
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا إن هذن لسحرن يريدان أن يخرجاكم من أرضكم بسحرهما ويذهبا بطريقتكم المثلى

verse_text_english: "Let us agree upon one scheme and face them as a united front. The winner today will have the upper hand."
verse_text_arabic: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّا وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ajmiʿū kaydakum thumma i'tū ṣaffan waqad aflaḥa l-yawma mani is'taʿl
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأجمعوا كيدكم ثم ائتوا صفا وقد أفلح اليوم من استعلى

verse_text_english: They said, "O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an nakūna awwala man alq
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا يموسى إما أن تلقى وإما أن نكون أول من ألقى

verse_text_english: He said, "You throw." Whereupon, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their magic, as if they were moving.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla bal alqū fa-idhā ḥibāluhum waʿiṣiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min siḥ'rihim annahā tasʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال بل ألقوا فإذا حبالهم وعصيهم يخيل إليه من سحرهم أنها تسعى

verse_text_english: Moses harbored some fear.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-awjasa fī nafsihi khīfatan mūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأوجس فى نفسه خيفة موسى

verse_text_english: We said, "Have no fear. You will prevail.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qul'nā lā takhaf innaka anta l-aʿl
verse_text_arabic_clean: قلنا لا تخف إنك أنت الأعلى

verse_text_english: "Throw what you hold in your right hand, and it will swallow what they fabricated. What they fabricated is no more than the scheming of a magician. The magician's work will not succeed."
verse_text_arabic: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alqi mā fī yamīnika talqaf mā ṣanaʿū innamā ṣanaʿū kaydu sāḥirin walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥiru ḥaythu at
verse_text_arabic_clean: وألق ما فى يمينك تلقف ما صنعوا إنما صنعوا كيد سحر ولا يفلح الساحر حيث أتى

verse_text_english: The magicians fell prostrate, saying, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
verse_text_arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sujjadan qālū āmannā birabbi hārūna wamūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: فألقى السحرة سجدا قالوا ءامنا برب هرون وموسى

verse_text_english: He said, "Did you believe in him without my permission? He must be your chief; the one who taught you magic. I will surely sever your hands and feet on alternate sides. I will crucify you on the palm trunks. You will find out which of us can inflict the worst retribution, and who outlasts whom."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra fala-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum fī judhūʿi l-nakhli walataʿlamunna ayyunā ashaddu ʿadhāban wa-abq
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال ءامنتم له قبل أن ءاذن لكم إنه لكبيركم الذى علمكم السحر فلأقطعن أيديكم وأرجلكم من خلف ولأصلبنكم فى جذوع النخل ولتعلمن أينا أشد عذابا وأبقى

verse_text_english: They said, "We will not prefer you over the clear proofs that came to us, and over the One who created us. Therefore, issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū lan nu'thiraka ʿalā mā jāanā mina l-bayināti wa-alladhī faṭaranā fa-iq'ḍi mā anta qāḍin innamā taqḍī hādhihi l-ḥayata l-dun'y
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا لن نؤثرك على ما جاءنا من البينت والذى فطرنا فاقض ما أنت قاض إنما تقضى هذه الحيوة الدنيا
