verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن يكذبوك فقد كذب الذين من قبلهم جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينت وبالزبر وبالكتب المنير

verse_text_english: Subsequently, I punished those who disbelieved; how terrible was My retribution!
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma akhadhtu alladhīna kafarū fakayfa kāna nakīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أخذت الذين كفروا فكيف كان نكير

verse_text_english: Do you not realize that GOD sends down from the sky water, whereby we produce fruits of various colors? Even the mountains have different colors; the peaks are white, or red, or some other color. And the ravens are black.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ
verse_text_transliterated: alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi thamarātin mukh'talifan alwānuhā wamina l-jibāli judadun bīḍun waḥum'run mukh'talifun alwānuhā wagharābību sūdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فأخرجنا به ثمرت مختلفا ألونها ومن الجبال جدد بيض وحمر مختلف ألونها وغرابيب سود

verse_text_english: Also, the people, the animals, and the livestock come in various colors. This is why the people who truly reverence GOD are those who are knowledgeable. GOD is Almighty, Forgiving.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamina l-nāsi wal-dawābi wal-anʿāmi mukh'talifun alwānuhu kadhālika innamā yakhshā l-laha min ʿibādihi l-ʿulamāu inna l-laha ʿazīzun ghafūru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن الناس والدواب والأنعم مختلف ألونه كذلك إنما يخشى الله من عباده العلمؤا إن الله عزيز غفور

verse_text_english: Surely, those who recite the book of GOD, observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them they spend—secretly and publicly—are engaged in an investment that never loses.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَٰرَةً لَّن تَبُورَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna yatlūna kitāba l-lahi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين يتلون كتب الله وأقاموا الصلوة وأنفقوا مما رزقنهم سرا وعلانية يرجون تجرة لن تبور

verse_text_english: He will recompense them generously, and will multiply His blessings upon them. He is Forgiving, Appreciative.
verse_text_arabic: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verse_text_transliterated: liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wayazīdahum min faḍlihi innahu ghafūrun shakūru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليوفيهم أجورهم ويزيدهم من فضله إنه غفور شكور

verse_text_english: What we revealed to you in this scripture is the truth, consummating all previous scriptures. GOD is fully Cognizant of His servants, Seer.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka mina l-kitābi huwa l-ḥaqu muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi inna l-laha biʿibādihi lakhabīrun baṣīru
verse_subtitle_english: Quran: The Consummation of All the Scriptures
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذى أوحينا إليك من الكتب هو الحق مصدقا لما بين يديه إن الله بعباده لخبير بصير

verse_text_english: We passed the scripture from generation to generation, and we allowed whomever we chose from among our servants to receive it. Subsequently, some of them wronged their souls, others upheld it only part of the time, while others were eager to work righteousness in accordance with GOD's will; this is the greatest triumph.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma awrathnā l-kitāba alladhīna iṣ'ṭafaynā min ʿibādinā famin'hum ẓālimun linafsihi wamin'hum muq'taṣidun wamin'hum sābiqun bil-khayrāti bi-idh'ni l-lahi dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أورثنا الكتب الذين اصطفينا من عبادنا فمنهم ظالم لنفسه ومنهم مقتصد ومنهم سابق بالخيرت بإذن الله ذلك هو الفضل الكبير

verse_text_english: They will enter the gardens of Eden, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments in it will be made of silk.
verse_text_arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: جنت عدن يدخلونها يحلون فيها من أساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا ولباسهم فيها حرير

verse_text_english: They will say, "Praise GOD for removing all our worries. Our Lord is Forgiving, Appreciative.
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī adhhaba ʿannā l-ḥazana inna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūru
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا الحمد لله الذى أذهب عنا الحزن إن ربنا لغفور شكور

verse_text_english: "He has admitted us into the abode of eternal bliss, out of His grace. Never do we get bored herein, never do we get tired."
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī aḥallanā dāra l-muqāmati min faḍlihi lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabun walā yamassunā fīhā lughūbu
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى أحلنا دار المقامة من فضله لا يمسنا فيها نصب ولا يمسنا فيها لغوب

verse_text_english: As for those who disbelieve, they have incurred the fire of Hell, where they are never finished by death, nor is the retribution ever commuted for them. We thus requite the unappreciative.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannama lā yuq'ḍā ʿalayhim fayamūtū walā yukhaffafu ʿanhum min ʿadhābihā kadhālika najzī kulla kafūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها كذلك نجزى كل كفور

verse_text_english: They will scream therein, "Our Lord, if you get us out of here, we will work righteousness, instead of the works we used to do." Did we not give you a life-long chance, with continuous reminders for those who would take heed? Did you not receive the warner? Therefore, taste (the consequences). The transgressors will have no one to help them.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wahum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā rabbanā akhrij'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu awalam nuʿammir'kum mā yatadhakkaru fīhi man tadhakkara wajāakumu l-nadhīru fadhūqū famā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīri
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهم يصطرخون فيها ربنا أخرجنا نعمل صلحا غير الذى كنا نعمل أولم نعمركم ما يتذكر فيه من تذكر وجاءكم النذير فذوقوا فما للظلمين من نصير

verse_text_english: GOD is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He is the Knower of all innermost thoughts.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-laha ʿālimu ghaybi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الله علم غيب السموت والأرض إنه عليم بذات الصدور

verse_text_english: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth. Subsequently, whoever chooses to disbelieve does so to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers only augments their Lord's abhorrence towards them. The disbelief of the disbelievers plunges them deeper into loss.
verse_text_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: huwa alladhī jaʿalakum khalāifa fī l-arḍi faman kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum ʿinda rabbihim illā maqtan walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum illā khasāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: هو الذى جعلكم خلئف فى الأرض فمن كفر فعليه كفره ولا يزيد الكفرين كفرهم عند ربهم إلا مقتا ولا يزيد الكفرين كفرهم إلا خسارا

verse_text_english: Say, "Consider the idols you have set up beside GOD; show me what on earth have they created." Do they own any partnership in the heavens? Have we given them a book wherein there is no doubt? Indeed, what the transgressors promise one another is no more than an illusion.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul ara-aytum shurakāakumu alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti am ātaynāhum kitāban fahum ʿalā bayyinatin min'hu bal in yaʿidu l-ẓālimūna baʿḍuhum baʿḍan illā ghurūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أرءيتم شركاءكم الذين تدعون من دون الله أرونى ماذا خلقوا من الأرض أم لهم شرك فى السموت أم ءاتينهم كتبا فهم على بينت منه بل إن يعد الظلمون بعضهم بعضا إلا غرورا

verse_text_english: GOD is the One who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else is to hold them, they will most certainly vanish. He is Clement, Forgiving.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-laha yum'siku l-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā wala-in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadin min baʿdihi innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الله يمسك السموت والأرض أن تزولا ولئن زالتا إن أمسكهما من أحد من بعده إنه كان حليما غفورا

verse_text_english: They swore by GOD solemnly that if a warner went to them, they would be better guided than a certain congregation! However, now that the warner did come to them, this only plunged them deeper into aversion.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in jāahum nadhīrun layakūnunna ahdā min iḥ'dā l-umami falammā jāahum nadhīrun mā zādahum illā nufūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمنهم لئن جاءهم نذير ليكونن أهدى من إحدى الأمم فلما جاءهم نذير ما زادهم إلا نفورا

verse_text_english: They resorted to arrogance on earth, and evil scheming, and the evil schemes only backfire on those who scheme them. Should they then expect anything but the fate of those who did the same things in the past? You will find that GOD's system is never changeable; you will find that GOD's system is immutable.
verse_text_arabic: ٱسْتِكْبَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: is'tik'bāran fī l-arḍi wamakra l-sayi-i walā yaḥīqu l-makru l-sayi-u illā bi-ahlihi fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnata l-awalīna falan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi taḥwīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: استكبارا فى الأرض ومكر السيئ ولا يحيق المكر السيئ إلا بأهله فهل ينظرون إلا سنت الأولين فلن تجد لسنت الله تبديلا ولن تجد لسنت الله تحويلا

verse_text_english: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They were even stronger than they. Nothing can be hidden from GOD in the heavens, nor on earth. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim wakānū ashadda min'hum quwwatan wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿ'jizahu min shayin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi innahu kāna ʿalīman qadīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولم يسيروا فى الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عقبة الذين من قبلهم وكانوا أشد منهم قوة وما كان الله ليعجزه من شىء فى السموت ولا فى الأرض إنه كان عليما قديرا

verse_text_english: If GOD punished the people for their sins, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined interim. Once their interim is fulfilled, then GOD is Seer of His servants.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum fa-inna l-laha kāna biʿibādihi baṣīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو يؤاخذ الله الناس بما كسبوا ما ترك على ظهرها من دابة ولكن يؤخرهم إلى أجل مسمى فإذا جاء أجلهم فإن الله كان بعباده بصيرا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Y. S.*
verse_text_arabic: يسٓ
verse_text_transliterated: ya-seen
verse_footnote_english: *36:1 See Appendix 1 for the detailed explanation of these initials.
verse_text_arabic_clean: يس

verse_text_english: And the Quran that is full of wisdom.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-qur'āni l-ḥakīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: والقرءان الحكيم

verse_text_english: Most assuredly, you (Rashad) are one of the messengers.*
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innaka lamina l-mur'salīn
verse_footnote_english: *36:3 See Appendices 2 & 26 for the irrefutable physical evidence.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنك لمن المرسلين

verse_text_english: On a straight path.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: alaa siratal mustaqeem
verse_text_arabic_clean: على صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: This revelation is from the Almighty, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: tanzīla l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزيل العزيز الرحيم

verse_text_english: To warn people whose parents were never warned, and therefore, they are unaware.
verse_text_arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: litundhira qawman mā undhira ābāuhum fahum ghāfilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لتنذر قوما ما أنذر ءاباؤهم فهم غفلون

verse_text_english: It has been predetermined that most of them do not believe.
verse_text_arabic: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: laqad ḥaqqa l-qawlu ʿalā aktharihim fahum lā yu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد حق القول على أكثرهم فهم لا يؤمنون

verse_text_english: For we place around their necks shackles, up to their chins. Consequently, they become locked in their disbelief.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā jaʿalnā fī aʿnāqihim aghlālan fahiya ilā l-adhqāni fahum muq'maḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا جعلنا فى أعنقهم أغللا فهى إلى الأذقان فهم مقمحون

verse_text_english: And we place a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and thus, we veil them; they cannot see.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalnā min bayni aydīhim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan fa-aghshaynāhum fahum lā yub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنا من بين أيديهم سدا ومن خلفهم سدا فأغشينهم فهم لا يبصرون

verse_text_english: It is the same whether you warn them or not, they cannot believe.*
verse_text_arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wasawāon ʿalayhim a-andhartahum am lam tundhir'hum lā yu'minūn
verse_footnote_english: *36:10 Everyone is already stamped as a believer or a disbeliever. See Appendix 14.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وسواء عليهم ءأنذرتهم أم لم تنذرهم لا يؤمنون

verse_text_english: You will be heeded only by those who uphold this message, and reverence the Most Gracious—even when alone in their privacy. Give them good news of forgiveness and a generous recompense.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innamā tundhiru mani ittabaʿa l-dhik'ra wakhashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi fabashir'hu bimaghfiratin wa-ajrin karīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر وخشى الرحمن بالغيب فبشره بمغفرة وأجر كريم

verse_text_english: We will certainly revive the dead, and we have recorded everything they have done in this life, as well as the consequences that continue after their death. Everything we have counted in a profound record.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī l-mawtā wanaktubu mā qaddamū waāthārahum wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu fī imāmin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا نحن نحى الموتى ونكتب ما قدموا وءاثرهم وكل شىء أحصينه فى إمام مبين

verse_text_english: Cite for them the example of people in a community that received the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathalan aṣḥāba l-qaryati idh jāahā l-mur'salūn
verse_subtitle_english: Rejecting The Messengers: A Tragic Human Trait*
verse_footnote_english: *36:13-27 God's messengers have proof, advocate God alone, and do not ask for money.
verse_text_arabic_clean: واضرب لهم مثلا أصحب القرية إذ جاءها المرسلون

verse_text_english: When we sent to them two (messengers), they disbelieved them. We then supported them by a third. They said, "We are (GOD's) messengers to you."
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: idh arsalnā ilayhimu ith'nayni fakadhabūhumā faʿazzaznā bithālithin faqālū innā ilaykum mur'salūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ أرسلنا إليهم اثنين فكذبوهما فعززنا بثالث فقالوا إنا إليكم مرسلون

verse_text_english: They said, "You are no more than human beings like us. The Most Gracious did not send down anything. You are liars."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū mā antum illā basharun mith'lunā wamā anzala l-raḥmānu min shayin in antum illā takdhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا ما أنتم إلا بشر مثلنا وما أنزل الرحمن من شىء إن أنتم إلا تكذبون

verse_text_english: They said, "Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū rabbunā yaʿlamu innā ilaykum lamur'salūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا ربنا يعلم إنا إليكم لمرسلون

verse_text_english: "Our sole mission is to deliver the message."
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā ʿalaynā illā l-balāghu l-mubīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما علينا إلا البلغ المبين

verse_text_english: They said, "We consider you bad omens. Unless you refrain, we will surely stone you, or afflict you with painful retribution."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum la-in lam tantahū lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minnā ʿadhābun alīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا إنا تطيرنا بكم لئن لم تنتهوا لنرجمنكم وليمسنكم منا عذاب أليم

verse_text_english: They said, "Your omen depends on your response, now that you have been reminded. Indeed, you are transgressing people."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū ṭāirukum maʿakum a-in dhukkir'tum bal antum qawmun mus'rifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا طئركم معكم أئن ذكرتم بل أنتم قوم مسرفون

verse_text_english: A man came from the other end of the city, saying, "O my people, follow the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajāa min aqṣā l-madīnati rajulun yasʿā qāla yāqawmi ittabiʿū l-mur'salīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجاء من أقصا المدينة رجل يسعى قال يقوم اتبعوا المرسلين

verse_text_english: "Follow those who do not ask you for any wage, and are guided.
verse_text_arabic: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ittabiʿū man lā yasalukum ajran wahum muh'tadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: اتبعوا من لا يسـٔلكم أجرا وهم مهتدون

verse_text_english: "Why should I not worship the One who initiated me, and to Him is your ultimate return?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā liya lā aʿbudu alladhī faṭaranī wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما لى لا أعبد الذى فطرنى وإليه ترجعون

verse_text_english: "Shall I set up beside Him gods? If the Most Gracious willed any harm for me, their intercession cannot help me one bit, nor can they rescue me.
verse_text_arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: a-attakhidhu min dūnihi ālihatan in yurid'ni l-raḥmānu biḍurrin lā tugh'ni ʿannī shafāʿatuhum shayan walā yunqidhūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءأتخذ من دونه ءالهة إن يردن الرحمن بضر لا تغن عنى شفعتهم شيـٔا ولا ينقذون

verse_text_english: "In that case, I would be totally astray.
verse_text_arabic: إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innī idhan lafī ḍalālin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنى إذا لفى ضلل مبين

verse_text_english: "I have believed in your Lord; please listen to me."
verse_text_arabic: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: innī āmantu birabbikum fa-is'maʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنى ءامنت بربكم فاسمعون

verse_text_english: (At the time of his death) he was told, "Enter Paradise." He said, "Oh, I wish my people knew.
verse_text_arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qīla ud'khuli l-janata qāla yālayta qawmī yaʿlamūn
verse_subtitle_english: The Righteous Go Straight to Paradise*
verse_footnote_english: *36:26 The righteous do not really die; they simply move on to the same Paradise where Adam & Eve lived. They join the prophets, saints, and martyrs in an active and utopian life (see App. 17).
verse_text_arabic_clean: قيل ادخل الجنة قال يليت قومى يعلمون

verse_text_english: "That my Lord has forgiven me, and made me honorable."
verse_text_arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: bimā ghafara lī rabbī wajaʿalanī mina l-muk'ramīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بما غفر لى ربى وجعلنى من المكرمين

verse_text_english: We did not send down upon his people, after him, soldiers from the sky; we did not need to send them down.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā anzalnā ʿalā qawmihi min baʿdihi min jundin mina l-samāi wamā kunnā munzilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أنزلنا على قومه من بعده من جند من السماء وما كنا منزلين

verse_text_english: All it took was one blow, whereupon they were stilled.
verse_text_arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum khāmidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن كانت إلا صيحة وحدة فإذا هم خمدون

verse_text_english: How sorry is the people's condition! Every time a messenger went to them, they always ridiculed him.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yāḥasratan ʿalā l-ʿibādi mā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verse_subtitle_english: Ridiculing The Messengers: A Tragic Human Trait*
verse_footnote_english: *36:30 If the messenger presents solid proof of messengership, advocates the worship of God alone, and does not ask us for money, why should we not believe? (see Appendix 2)
verse_text_arabic_clean: يحسرة على العباد ما يأتيهم من رسول إلا كانوا به يستهزءون

verse_text_english: Did they not see how many generations we annihilated before them, and how they never return to them?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alam yaraw kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni annahum ilayhim lā yarjiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم يروا كم أهلكنا قبلهم من القرون أنهم إليهم لا يرجعون

verse_text_english: Every one of them will be summoned before us.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in kullun lammā jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن كل لما جميع لدينا محضرون

verse_text_english: One sign for them is the dead land: we revive it and produce from it grains for their food.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waāyatun lahumu l-arḍu l-maytatu aḥyaynāhā wa-akhrajnā min'hā ḥabban famin'hu yakulūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاية لهم الأرض الميتة أحيينها وأخرجنا منها حبا فمنه يأكلون

verse_text_english: We grow in it gardens of date palms, and grapes, and we cause springs to gush out therein.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalnā fīhā jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin wafajjarnā fīhā mina l-ʿuyūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنا فيها جنت من نخيل وأعنب وفجرنا فيها من العيون

verse_text_english: This is to provide them with fruits, and to let them manufacture with their own hands whatever they need. Would they be thankful?
verse_text_arabic: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: liyakulū min thamarihi wamā ʿamilathu aydīhim afalā yashkurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليأكلوا من ثمره وما عملته أيديهم أفلا يشكرون

verse_text_english: Glory be to the One who created all kinds of plants from the earth, as well as themselves, and other creations that they do not even know.
verse_text_arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: sub'ḥāna alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā mimmā tunbitu l-arḍu wamin anfusihim wamimmā lā yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: سبحن الذى خلق الأزوج كلها مما تنبت الأرض ومن أنفسهم ومما لا يعلمون

verse_text_english: Another sign for them is the night: we remove the daylight therefrom, whereupon they are in darkness.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waāyatun lahumu al-laylu naslakhu min'hu l-nahāra fa-idhā hum muẓ'limūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاية لهم اليل نسلخ منه النهار فإذا هم مظلمون

verse_text_english: The sun sets into a specific location, according to the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-shamsu tajrī limus'taqarrin lahā dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: والشمس تجرى لمستقر لها ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم

verse_text_english: The moon we designed to appear in stages, until it becomes like an old curved sheath.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿur'jūni l-qadīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: والقمر قدرنه منازل حتى عاد كالعرجون القديم

verse_text_english: The sun is never to catch up with the moon—the night and the day never deviate—each of them is floating in its own orbit.
verse_text_arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā l-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tud'rika l-qamara walā al-laylu sābiqu l-nahāri wakullun fī falakin yasbaḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا الشمس ينبغى لها أن تدرك القمر ولا اليل سابق النهار وكل فى فلك يسبحون

verse_text_english: Another sign for them is that we carried their ancestors on the loaded ark.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: waāyatun lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاية لهم أنا حملنا ذريتهم فى الفلك المشحون

verse_text_english: Then created the same for them to ride in.
verse_text_arabic: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wakhalaqnā lahum min mith'lihi mā yarkabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وخلقنا لهم من مثله ما يركبون

verse_text_english: If we willed, we could have drowned them, so that their screaming would not be heard, nor could they be saved.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in nasha nugh'riq'hum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن نشأ نغرقهم فلا صريخ لهم ولا هم ينقذون

verse_text_english: Instead, we shower them with mercy, and let them enjoy for awhile.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: illā raḥmatan minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا رحمة منا ومتعا إلى حين

verse_text_english: Yet, when they are told, "Learn from your past, to work righteousness for your future, that you may attain mercy,"
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا قيل لهم اتقوا ما بين أيديكم وما خلفكم لعلكم ترحمون

verse_text_english: No matter what kind of proof is given to them from their Lord, they consistently disregard it.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā tatīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تأتيهم من ءاية من ءايت ربهم إلا كانوا عنها معرضين

verse_text_english: When they are told, "Give from GOD's provisions to you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Why should we give to those whom GOD could feed, if He so willed? You are really far astray."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭ'ʿimu man law yashāu l-lahu aṭʿamahu in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا قيل لهم أنفقوا مما رزقكم الله قال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا أنطعم من لو يشاء الله أطعمه إن أنتم إلا فى ضلل مبين

verse_text_english: They also challenge, "When will that promise come to pass, if you are truthful?"
verse_text_arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صدقين

verse_text_english: All they see will be one blow that overwhelms them, while they dispute.
verse_text_arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan takhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما ينظرون إلا صيحة وحدة تأخذهم وهم يخصمون

verse_text_english: They will not even have time to make a will, nor will they be able to return to their people.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyatan walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا يستطيعون توصية ولا إلى أهلهم يرجعون

verse_text_english: The horn will be blown, whereupon they will rise from the grave and go to their Lord.
verse_text_arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونفخ فى الصور فإذا هم من الأجداث إلى ربهم ينسلون

verse_text_english: They will say, "Woe to us. Who resurrected us from our death? This is what the Most Gracious has promised. The messengers were right."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū yāwaylanā man baʿathanā min marqadinā hādhā mā waʿada l-raḥmānu waṣadaqa l-mur'salūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا يويلنا من بعثنا من مرقدنا هذا ما وعد الرحمن وصدق المرسلون

verse_text_english: All it will take is one blow, whereupon they are summoned before us.
verse_text_arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن كانت إلا صيحة وحدة فإذا هم جميع لدينا محضرون

verse_text_english: On that day, no soul will be wronged in the least. You will be paid precisely for whatever you did.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fal-yawma lā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan walā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاليوم لا تظلم نفس شيـٔا ولا تجزون إلا ما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: The dwellers of Paradise will be, on that day, happily busy.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَٰكِهُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna aṣḥāba l-janati l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن أصحب الجنة اليوم فى شغل فكهون

verse_text_english: They abide with their spouses in beautiful shade, enjoying comfortable furnishings.
verse_text_arabic: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
verse_text_transliterated: hum wa-azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalā l-arāiki muttakiūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هم وأزوجهم فى ظلل على الأرائك متكـٔون

verse_text_english: They will have fruits therein; they will have anything they wish.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lahum fīhā fākihatun walahum mā yaddaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لهم فيها فكهة ولهم ما يدعون

verse_text_english: Greetings of peace from a Most Merciful Lord.
verse_text_arabic: سَلَٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: salāmun qawlan min rabbin raḥīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: سلم قولا من رب رحيم

verse_text_english: As for you, O guilty ones, you will be set aside.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-im'tāzū l-yawma ayyuhā l-muj'rimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وامتزوا اليوم أيها المجرمون

verse_text_english: Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not worship the devil? That he is your most ardent enemy?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama an lā taʿbudū l-shayṭāna innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnu
verse_subtitle_english: The Devil is the Other Alternative
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم أعهد إليكم يبنى ءادم أن لا تعبدوا الشيطن إنه لكم عدو مبين

verse_text_english: And that you shall worship Me alone? This is the right path.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ani uʿ'budūnī hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأن اعبدونى هذا صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: He has misled multitudes of you. Did you not possess any understanding?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran afalam takūnū taʿqilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أضل منكم جبلا كثيرا أفلم تكونوا تعقلون

verse_text_english: This is the Hell that was promised for you.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhihi jahannamu allatī kuntum tūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذه جهنم التى كنتم توعدون

verse_text_english: Today you will burn in it, as a consequence of your disbelief.
verse_text_arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: iṣ'lawhā l-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: اصلوها اليوم بما كنتم تكفرون

verse_text_english: On that day we will seal their mouths; their hands and feet will bear witness to everything they had done.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: اليوم نختم على أفوههم وتكلمنا أيديهم وتشهد أرجلهم بما كانوا يكسبون

verse_text_english: If we will, we can veil their eyes and, consequently, when they seek the path, they will not see.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw nashāu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-is'tabaqū l-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو نشاء لطمسنا على أعينهم فاستبقوا الصرط فأنى يبصرون

verse_text_english: If we will, we can freeze them in place; thus, they can neither move forward, nor go back.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw nashāu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā is'taṭāʿū muḍiyyan walā yarjiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو نشاء لمسخنهم على مكانتهم فما استطعوا مضيا ولا يرجعون

verse_text_english: Whomever we permit to live for a long time, we revert him to weakness. Do they not understand?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waman nuʿammir'hu nunakkis'hu fī l-khalqi afalā yaʿqilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن نعمره ننكسه فى الخلق أفلا يعقلون

verse_text_english: What we taught him (the messenger) was not poetry, nor is he (a poet). This is but a formidable proof,* and a profound Quran.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā ʿallamnāhu l-shiʿ'ra wamā yanbaghī lahu in huwa illā dhik'run waqur'ānun mubīnu
verse_footnote_english: *36:69 The word "Zikr" refers frequently to the Quran's great mathematical code, which is certainly not literary, nor poetry. Please check out 38:1,8; 15:6,9; 16:44; 21:2, 24; 26:5; & 36:11.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما علمنه الشعر وما ينبغى له إن هو إلا ذكر وقرءان مبين

verse_text_english: To preach to those who are alive, and to expose the disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: liyundhira man kāna ḥayyan wayaḥiqqa l-qawlu ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لينذر من كان حيا ويحق القول على الكفرين

verse_text_english: Have they not seen that we created for them, with our own hands, livestock that they own?
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولم يروا أنا خلقنا لهم مما عملت أيدينا أنعما فهم لها ملكون

verse_text_english: And we subdued them for them; some they ride, and some they eat.
verse_text_arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wadhallalnāhā lahum famin'hā rakūbuhum wamin'hā yakulūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وذللنها لهم فمنها ركوبهم ومنها يأكلون

verse_text_english: They derive other benefits from them, as well as drinks. Would they not be appreciative?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu afalā yashkurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولهم فيها منفع ومشارب أفلا يشكرون

verse_text_english: They set up beside GOD other gods, perhaps they can be of help to them!
verse_text_arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan laʿallahum yunṣarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: واتخذوا من دون الله ءالهة لعلهم ينصرون

verse_text_english: On the contrary, they cannot help them; they end up serving them as devoted soldiers.
verse_text_arabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundun muḥ'ḍarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يستطيعون نصرهم وهم لهم جند محضرون

verse_text_english: Therefore, do not be saddened by their utterances. We are fully aware of everything they conceal and everything they declare.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falā yaḥzunka qawluhum innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا يحزنك قولهم إنا نعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون

verse_text_english: Does the human being not see that we created him from a tiny drop, then he turns into an ardent enemy?
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: awalam yara l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولم ير الإنسن أنا خلقنه من نطفة فإذا هو خصيم مبين

verse_text_english: He raises a question to us—while forgetting his initial creation—"Who can resurrect the bones after they had rotted?"
verse_text_arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waḍaraba lanā mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qāla man yuḥ'yī l-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وضرب لنا مثلا ونسى خلقه قال من يحى العظم وهى رميم

verse_text_english: Say, "The One who initiated them in the first place will resurrect them. He is fully aware of every creation."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qul yuḥ'yīhā alladhī ansha-ahā awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل يحييها الذى أنشأها أول مرة وهو بكل خلق عليم

verse_text_english: He is the One who creates for you, from the green trees, fuel which you burn for light.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī jaʿala lakum mina l-shajari l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum min'hu tūqidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى جعل لكم من الشجر الأخضر نارا فإذا أنتم منه توقدون

verse_text_english: Is not the One who created the heavens and the earth able to recreate the same? Yes indeed; He is the Creator, the Omniscient.
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: awalaysa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum balā wahuwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: أوليس الذى خلق السموت والأرض بقدر على أن يخلق مثلهم بلى وهو الخلق العليم

verse_text_english: All He needs to do to carry out any command is say to it, "Be," and it is.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verse_text_transliterated: innamā amruhu idhā arāda shayan an yaqūla lahu kun fayakūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنما أمره إذا أراد شيـٔا أن يقول له كن فيكون

verse_text_english: Therefore, glory be to the One in whose hand is the sovereignty over all things, and to Him you will be returned.*
verse_text_arabic: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasub'ḥāna alladhī biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verse_footnote_english: *36:83 It is noteworthy that the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the gematrical value of "Khalifa" (725), plus the sura number (36), plus the number of verses (83), produces a total that is a multiple of 19 (505+725+36+83=1349=19x71). Also, Sura 36 is number 19 among the 29 initialed suras.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسبحن الذى بيده ملكوت كل شىء وإليه ترجعون

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The arrangers in columns.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ṣāfāti ṣaffa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والصفت صفا

verse_text_english: The blamers of those to be blamed.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-zājirāti zajra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالزجرت زجرا

verse_text_english: The reciters of the messages.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-tāliyāti dhik'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالتليت ذكرا

verse_text_english: Your god is only one.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ilāhakum lawāḥidu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن إلهكم لوحد

verse_text_english: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, and Lord of the easts.*
verse_text_arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
verse_text_transliterated: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu l-mashāriq
verse_footnote_english: *37:5 Every heavenly body rises on the planet earth, and sets. Every rise is called "east."
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب السموت والأرض وما بينهما ورب المشرق

verse_text_english: We have adorned the lowest heaven with adorning planets.*
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bizīnatin l-kawākib
verse_footnote_english: *37:6 We live in the innermost and smallest universe. The jinns are confined to this universe.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا زينا السماء الدنيا بزينة الكواكب

verse_text_english: We guarded it from every evil devil.
verse_text_arabic: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waḥif'ẓan min kulli shayṭānin māridi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحفظا من كل شيطن مارد

verse_text_english: They cannot spy on the High Society; they get bombarded from every side.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yassammaʿūna ilā l-mala-i l-aʿlā wayuq'dhafūna min kulli jānibi
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسمعون إلى الملإ الأعلى ويقذفون من كل جانب

verse_text_english: They have been condemned; they have incurred an eternal retribution.
verse_text_arabic: دُحُورًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
verse_text_transliterated: duḥūran walahum ʿadhābun wāṣibu
verse_text_arabic_clean: دحورا ولهم عذاب واصب

verse_text_english: If any of them ventures to charge the outer limits, he gets struck with a fierce projectile.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
verse_text_transliterated: illā man khaṭifa l-khaṭfata fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا من خطف الخطفة فأتبعه شهاب ثاقب

verse_text_english: Ask them, "Are they more difficult to create, or the other creations?" We created them from wet mud.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-is'taftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnā innā khalaqnāhum min ṭīnin lāzibi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاستفتهم أهم أشد خلقا أم من خلقنا إنا خلقنهم من طين لازب

verse_text_english: While you are awed, they mock.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal ʿajib'ta wayaskharūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل عجبت ويسخرون

verse_text_english: When reminded, they take no heed.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā dhukkirū lā yadhkurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا ذكروا لا يذكرون

verse_text_english: When they see proof, they ridicule it.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā ra-aw āyatan yastaskhirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا رأوا ءاية يستسخرون

verse_text_english: They say, "This is obviously magic!
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين

verse_text_english: "After we die and become dust and bones, do we get resurrected?
verse_text_arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما أءنا لمبعوثون

verse_text_english: "Even our ancient ancestors?"
verse_text_arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: awaābāunā l-awalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أوءاباؤنا الأولون

verse_text_english: Say, "Yes, you will be forcibly summoned."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul naʿam wa-antum dākhirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل نعم وأنتم دخرون

verse_text_english: All it takes is one nudge, whereupon they (stand up) looking.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإنما هى زجرة وحدة فإذا هم ينظرون

verse_text_english: They will say, "Woe to us; this is the Day of Judgment."
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū yāwaylanā hādhā yawmu l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا يويلنا هذا يوم الدين

verse_text_english: This is the day of decision that you used to disbelieve in.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā yawmu l-faṣli alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا يوم الفصل الذى كنتم به تكذبون

verse_text_english: Summon the transgressors, and their spouses, and the idols they worshiped
verse_text_arabic: ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: uḥ'shurū alladhīna ẓalamū wa-azwājahum wamā kānū yaʿbudūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: احشروا الذين ظلموا وأزوجهم وما كانوا يعبدون

verse_text_english: beside GOD, and guide them to the path of Hell.
verse_text_arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: min dūni l-lahi fa-ih'dūhum ilā ṣirāṭi l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: من دون الله فاهدوهم إلى صرط الجحيم

verse_text_english: Stop them, and ask them:
verse_text_arabic: وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waqifūhum innahum masūlūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقفوهم إنهم مسـٔولون

verse_text_english: "Why do you not help one another?"
verse_text_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā lakum lā tanāṣarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما لكم لا تناصرون

verse_text_english: They will be, on that day, totally submitting.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal humu l-yawma mus'taslimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل هم اليوم مستسلمون

verse_text_english: They will come to each other, questioning and blaming one another.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون

verse_text_english: They will say (to their leaders), "You used to come to us from the right side."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū innakum kuntum tatūnanā ʿani l-yamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا إنكم كنتم تأتوننا عن اليمين

verse_text_english: They will respond, "It is you who were not believers.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū bal lam takūnū mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا بل لم تكونوا مؤمنين

verse_text_english: "We never had any power over you; it is you who were wicked.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَٰغِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطن بل كنتم قوما طغين

verse_text_english: "We justly incurred our Lord's judgment; now we have to suffer.
verse_text_arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā innā ladhāiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فحق علينا قول ربنا إنا لذائقون

verse_text_english: "We misled you, only because we were astray."
verse_text_arabic: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aghwaynākum innā kunnā ghāwīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأغوينكم إنا كنا غوين

verse_text_english: Thus, together they will all partake of the retribution on that day.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-innahum yawma-idhin fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإنهم يومئذ فى العذاب مشتركون

verse_text_english: This is how we requite the guilty.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين

verse_text_english: When they were told, "Lã Elãha Ella Allãh (There is no other god beside GOD)," they turned arrogant.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahum kānū idhā qīla lahum lā ilāha illā l-lahu yastakbirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنهم كانوا إذا قيل لهم لا إله إلا الله يستكبرون

verse_text_english: They said, "Shall we leave our gods for the sake of a crazy poet?"
verse_text_arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: wayaqūlūna a-innā latārikū ālihatinā lishāʿirin majnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويقولون أئنا لتاركوا ءالهتنا لشاعر مجنون

verse_text_english: In fact, he has brought the truth, and has confirmed the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal jāa bil-ḥaqi waṣaddaqa l-mur'salīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل جاء بالحق وصدق المرسلين

verse_text_english: Most assuredly, you will taste the most painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: innakum ladhāiqū l-ʿadhābi l-alīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنكم لذائقوا العذاب الأليم

verse_text_english: You are requited only for what you have done.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تجزون إلا ما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: Only GOD's servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (will be saved).
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عباد الله المخلصين

verse_text_english: They have deserved provisions that are reserved specifically for them.
verse_text_arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ulāika lahum riz'qun maʿlūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولئك لهم رزق معلوم

verse_text_english: All kinds of fruits. They will be honored.
verse_text_arabic: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fawākihu wahum muk'ramūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فوكه وهم مكرمون

verse_text_english: In the gardens of bliss.
verse_text_arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fī jannāti l-naʿīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى جنت النعيم

verse_text_english: On furnishings close to one another.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: alaa surur mutaqaabileen
verse_text_arabic_clean: على سرر متقبلين

verse_text_english: Cups of pure drinks will be offered to them.
verse_text_arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: yuṭāfu ʿalayhim bikasin min maʿīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: يطاف عليهم بكأس من معين

verse_text_english: Clear and delicious for the drinkers.
verse_text_arabic: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: bayḍāa ladhatin lilshāribīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بيضاء لذة للشربين

verse_text_english: Never polluted, and never exhausted.
verse_text_arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا فيها غول ولا هم عنها ينزفون

verse_text_english: With them will be wonderful companions.
verse_text_arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi ʿīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعندهم قصرت الطرف عين

verse_text_english: Protected like fragile eggs.
verse_text_arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ka-annahunna bayḍun maknūnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كأنهن بيض مكنون

verse_text_english: They will come to each other, and confer with one another.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūn
verse_subtitle_english: The Dwellers of Heaven Visit the Dwellers of Hell
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون

verse_text_english: One of them will say, "I used to have a friend.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla qāilun min'hum innī kāna lī qarīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال قائل منهم إنى كان لى قرين

verse_text_english: "He used to mock: 'Do you believe all this?
verse_text_arabic: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: yaqūlu a-innaka lamina l-muṣadiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يقول أءنك لمن المصدقين

verse_text_english: " 'After we die and turn into dust and bones, do we get called to account?' "
verse_text_arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamadīnūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما أءنا لمدينون

verse_text_english: He will say, "Just take a look!"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla hal antum muṭṭaliʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال هل أنتم مطلعون

verse_text_english: When he looks, he will see his friend in the heart of Hell.*
verse_text_arabic: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iṭṭalaʿa faraāhu fī sawāi l-jaḥīm
verse_footnote_english: *37:55 People who make it to Heaven will be able to visit their relatives and friends in Hell, without adverse consequences. In the Hereafter, anyone can move downward, but not upward beyond a certain limit. The limit is decided by one's degree of growth and development (App. 5).
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاطلع فرءاه فى سواء الجحيم

verse_text_english: He (will go to him and) say, "By GOD, you almost ruined me.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla tal-lahi in kidtta latur'dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال تالله إن كدت لتردين

verse_text_english: "If it were not for my Lord's blessing, I would have been with you now.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walawlā niʿ'matu rabbī lakuntu mina l-muḥ'ḍarīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولولا نعمة ربى لكنت من المحضرين

verse_text_english: "(Do you still believe) that we die,
verse_text_arabic: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: afamā naḥnu bimayyitīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفما نحن بميتين

verse_text_english: "only the first death, and we never receive any requital?"
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā mawtatanā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا موتتنا الأولى وما نحن بمعذبين

verse_text_english: Such is the greatest triumph.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā lahuwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا لهو الفوز العظيم

verse_text_english: This is what every worker should work for.
verse_text_arabic: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: limith'li hādhā falyaʿmali l-ʿāmilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لمثل هذا فليعمل العملون

verse_text_english: Is this a better destiny, or the tree of bitterness?
verse_text_arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verse_text_transliterated: adhālika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu l-zaqūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: أذلك خير نزلا أم شجرة الزقوم

verse_text_english: We have rendered it a punishment for the transgressors.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā jaʿalnāhā fit'natan lilẓẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا جعلنها فتنة للظلمين

verse_text_english: It is a tree that grows in the heart of Hell.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: innahā shajaratun takhruju fī aṣli l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنها شجرة تخرج فى أصل الجحيم

verse_text_english: Its flowers look like the devils' heads.
verse_text_arabic: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: ṭalʿuhā ka-annahu ruūsu l-shayāṭīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: طلعها كأنه رءوس الشيطين

verse_text_english: They will eat from it until their bellies are filled up.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-innahum laākilūna min'hā famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإنهم لءاكلون منها فمالـٔون منها البطون

verse_text_english: Then they will top it with a hellish drink.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma inna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban min ḥamīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إن لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم

verse_text_english: Then they will return to Hell.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma inna marjiʿahum la-ilā l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إن مرجعهم لإلى الجحيم

verse_text_english: They found their parents astray.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahum alfaw ābāahum ḍāllīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنهم ألفوا ءاباءهم ضالين

verse_text_english: And they blindly followed in their footsteps.
verse_text_arabic: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fahum ʿalā āthārihim yuh'raʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فهم على ءاثرهم يهرعون

verse_text_english: Most of the previous generations have strayed in the same manner.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ḍalla qablahum aktharu l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد ضل قبلهم أكثر الأولين

verse_text_english: We have sent to them warners.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad arsalnā fīhim mundhirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أرسلنا فيهم منذرين

verse_text_english: Note the consequences for those who have been warned.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فانظر كيف كان عقبة المنذرين

verse_text_english: Only GOD's servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (are saved).
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عباد الله المخلصين

verse_text_english: Thus, Noah called upon us, and we were the best responders.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad nādānā nūḥun falaniʿ'ma l-mujībūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد نادىنا نوح فلنعم المجيبون

verse_text_english: We saved him and his family from the great disaster.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونجينه وأهله من الكرب العظيم

verse_text_english: We made his companions the survivors.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalnā dhurriyyatahu humu l-bāqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنا ذريته هم الباقين

verse_text_english: And we preserved his history for subsequent generations.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتركنا عليه فى الءاخرين

verse_text_english: Peace be upon Noah among the peoples.
verse_text_arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: salāmun ʿalā nūḥin fī l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: سلم على نوح فى العلمين

verse_text_english: We thus reward the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كذلك نجزى المحسنين

verse_text_english: He is one of our believing servants.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين

verse_text_english: We drowned all the others.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أغرقنا الءاخرين

verse_text_english: Among his followers was Abraham.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna min shīʿatihi la-ib'rāhīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن من شيعته لإبرهيم

verse_text_english: He came to his Lord wholeheartedly.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: idh jāa rabbahu biqalbin salīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ جاء ربه بقلب سليم

verse_text_english: He said to his father and his people, "What are you worshiping?
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ قال لأبيه وقومه ماذا تعبدون

verse_text_english: "Is it these fabricated gods, instead of GOD, that you want?
verse_text_arabic: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: a-if'kan ālihatan dūna l-lahi turīdūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أئفكا ءالهة دون الله تريدون

verse_text_english: "What do you think of the Lord of the universe?"
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā ẓannukum birabbi l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما ظنكم برب العلمين

verse_text_english: He looked carefully at the stars.
verse_text_arabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: fanaẓara naẓratan fī l-nujūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فنظر نظرة فى النجوم

verse_text_english: Then he gave up and said, "I am tired of this!"
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: faqāla innī saqīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقال إنى سقيم

verse_text_english: They turned away from him.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fatawallaw ʿanhu mud'birīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتولوا عنه مدبرين

verse_text_english: He then turned on their idols, saying, "Would you like to eat?
verse_text_arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: farāgha ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā takulūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فراغ إلى ءالهتهم فقال ألا تأكلون

verse_text_english: "Why do you not speak?"
verse_text_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā lakum lā tanṭiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما لكم لا تنطقون

verse_text_english: He then destroyed them.
verse_text_arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: farāgha ʿalayhim ḍarban bil-yamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فراغ عليهم ضربا باليمين

verse_text_english: They went to him in a great rage.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aqbalū ilayhi yaziffūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأقبلوا إليه يزفون

verse_text_english: He said, "How can you worship what you carve?
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla ataʿbudūna mā tanḥitūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أتعبدون ما تنحتون

verse_text_english: "When GOD has created you, and everything you make!"
verse_text_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-lahu khalaqakum wamā taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والله خلقكم وما تعملون

verse_text_english: They said, "Let us build a great fire, and throw him into it."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū ib'nū lahu bun'yānan fa-alqūhu fī l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا ابنوا له بنينا فألقوه فى الجحيم

verse_text_english: They schemed against him, but we made them the losers.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-asfalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأرادوا به كيدا فجعلنهم الأسفلين

verse_text_english: He said, "I am going to my Lord; He will guide me."
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: waqāla innī dhāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقال إنى ذاهب إلى ربى سيهدين

verse_text_english: "My Lord, grant me righteous children."
verse_text_arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: rabbi hab lī mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب هب لى من الصلحين

verse_text_english: We gave him good news of a good child.
verse_text_arabic: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fabasharnāhu bighulāmin ḥalīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبشرنه بغلم حليم

verse_text_english: When he grew enough to work with him, he said, "My son, I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you. What do you think?" He said, "O my father, do what you are commanded to do. You will find me, GOD willing, patient."
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā balagha maʿahu l-saʿya qāla yābunayya innī arā fī l-manāmi annī adhbaḥuka fa-unẓur mādhā tarā qāla yāabati if'ʿal mā tu'maru satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣābirīn
verse_footnote_english: *37:102 The Most Merciful never advocates evil (7:28). As with Job, Satan claimed that Abraham loved his son too much, and was permitted to put Abraham to that severe test.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما بلغ معه السعى قال يبنى إنى أرى فى المنام أنى أذبحك فانظر ماذا ترى قال يأبت افعل ما تؤمر ستجدنى إن شاء الله من الصبرين

verse_text_english: They both submitted, and he put his forehead down (to sacrifice him).
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā aslamā watallahu lil'jabīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما أسلما وتله للجبين

verse_text_english: We called him: "O Abraham.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: wanādaynāhu an yāib'rāhīm
verse_subtitle_english: God Intervenes to Save Abraham and Ismail
verse_text_arabic_clean: وندينه أن يإبرهيم

verse_text_english: "You have believed the dream." We thus reward the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qad ṣaddaqta l-ru'yā innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قد صدقت الرءيا إنا كذلك نجزى المحسنين

verse_text_english: That was an exacting test indeed.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā lahuwa l-balāu l-mubīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا لهو البلؤا المبين

verse_text_english: We ransomed (Ismail) by substituting an animal sacrifice.
verse_text_arabic: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wafadaynāhu bidhib'ḥin ʿaẓīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفدينه بذبح عظيم

verse_text_english: And we preserved his history for subsequent generations.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتركنا عليه فى الءاخرين

verse_text_english: Peace be upon Abraham.
verse_text_arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: salāmun ʿalā ib'rāhīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: سلم على إبرهيم

verse_text_english: We thus reward the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك نجزى المحسنين

verse_text_english: He is one of our believing servants.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين

verse_text_english: Then we gave him the good news about the birth of Isaac, to be one of the righteous prophets.
verse_text_arabic: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wabasharnāhu bi-is'ḥāqa nabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبشرنه بإسحق نبيا من الصلحين

verse_text_english: We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants, some are righteous, and some are wicked transgressors.
verse_text_arabic: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā is'ḥāqa wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥ'sinun waẓālimun linafsihi mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبركنا عليه وعلى إسحق ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين

verse_text_english: We also blessed Moses and Aaron.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad manannā ʿalā mūsā wahārūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد مننا على موسى وهرون

verse_text_english: We delivered them and their people from the great disaster.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wanajjaynāhumā waqawmahumā mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونجينهما وقومهما من الكرب العظيم

verse_text_english: We supported them, until they became the winners.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wanaṣarnāhum fakānū humu l-ghālibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونصرنهم فكانوا هم الغلبين

verse_text_english: We gave both of them the profound scripture.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waātaynāhumā l-kitāba l-mus'tabīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاتينهما الكتب المستبين

verse_text_english: We guided them in the right path.
verse_text_arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: wahadaynāhumā l-ṣirāṭa l-mus'taqīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهدينهما الصرط المستقيم

verse_text_english: We preserved their history for subsequent generations.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wataraknā ʿalayhimā fī l-ākhirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتركنا عليهما فى الءاخرين

verse_text_english: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
verse_text_arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: salāmun ʿalā mūsā wahārūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: سلم على موسى وهرون

verse_text_english: We thus reward the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كذلك نجزى المحسنين

verse_text_english: Both of them were among our righteous servants.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahumā min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنهما من عبادنا المؤمنين

verse_text_english: Elias was one of the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna il'yāsa lamina l-mur'salīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن إلياس لمن المرسلين

verse_text_english: He said to his people, "Would you not work righteousness?
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: idh qāla liqawmihi alā tattaqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ قال لقومه ألا تتقون

verse_text_english: "Do you worship a statue, instead of the Supreme Creator?
verse_text_arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: atadʿūna baʿlan watadharūna aḥsana l-khāliqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أتدعون بعلا وتذرون أحسن الخلقين

verse_text_english: "GOD; your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!"
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: al-laha rabbakum warabba ābāikumu l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله ربكم ورب ءابائكم الأولين

verse_text_english: They disbelieved him. Consequently, they had to be called to account.
verse_text_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
