verse_text_transliterated: fakadhabūhu fa-innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكذبوه فإنهم لمحضرون

verse_text_english: Only GOD's servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (are saved).
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عباد الله المخلصين

verse_text_english: We preserved his history for subsequent generations.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتركنا عليه فى الءاخرين

verse_text_english: Peace be upon Elias, and all those like Elias.
verse_text_arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: salāmun ʿalā il yāsīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: سلم على إل ياسين

verse_text_english: We thus reward the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كذلك نجزى المحسنين

verse_text_english: He was one of our believing servants.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين

verse_text_english: Lot was one of the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna lūṭan lamina l-mur'salīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن لوطا لمن المرسلين

verse_text_english: We saved him and all his family.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: idh najjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ نجينه وأهله أجمعين

verse_text_english: Only the old woman was doomed.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عجوزا فى الغبرين

verse_text_english: We annihilated all the others.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma dammarnā l-ākharīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم دمرنا الءاخرين

verse_text_english: You still pass by their ruins by day.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innakum latamurrūna ʿalayhim muṣ'biḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنكم لتمرون عليهم مصبحين

verse_text_english: And by night. Would you understand?
verse_text_arabic: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wabi-al-layli afalā taʿqilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وباليل أفلا تعقلون

verse_text_english: Jonah was one of the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna yūnusa lamina l-mur'salīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن يونس لمن المرسلين

verse_text_english: He escaped to the loaded ship.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: idh abaqa ilā l-ful'ki l-mashḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ أبق إلى الفلك المشحون

verse_text_english: He rebelled and thus, he joined the losers.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasāhama fakāna mina l-mud'ḥaḍīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فساهم فكان من المدحضين

verse_text_english: Consequently, the fish swallowed him, and he was the one to blame.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fal-taqamahu l-ḥūtu wahuwa mulīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالتقمه الحوت وهو مليم

verse_text_english: If it were not that he resorted to meditation (on GOD),
verse_text_arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falawlā annahu kāna mina l-musabiḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلولا أنه كان من المسبحين

verse_text_english: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection.
verse_text_arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: للبث فى بطنه إلى يوم يبعثون

verse_text_english: We had him thrown up into the desert, exhausted.
verse_text_arabic: فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fanabadhnāhu bil-ʿarāi wahuwa saqīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فنبذنه بالعراء وهو سقيم

verse_text_english: We had a tree of edible fruit grown for him.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anbatnā ʿalayhi shajaratan min yaqṭīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنبتنا عليه شجرة من يقطين

verse_text_english: Then we sent him to a hundred thousand,* or more.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأرسلنه إلى مائة ألف أو يزيدون

verse_text_english: They did believe, and we let them enjoy this life.
verse_text_arabic: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: faāmanū famattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: فـٔامنوا فمتعنهم إلى حين

verse_text_english: Ask them if your Lord has daughters, while they have sons!
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-is'taftihim alirabbika l-banātu walahumu l-banūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاستفتهم ألربك البنات ولهم البنون

verse_text_english: Did we create the angels to be females? Did they witness that?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم خلقنا الملئكة إنثا وهم شهدون

verse_text_english: Indeed, they grossly blaspheme when they say—
verse_text_arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alā innahum min if'kihim layaqūlūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألا إنهم من إفكهم ليقولون

verse_text_english: "GOD has begotten a son." Indeed, they are liars.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walada l-lahu wa-innahum lakādhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولد الله وإنهم لكذبون

verse_text_english: Did He choose the girls over the boys?
verse_text_arabic: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: aṣṭafā l-banāti ʿalā l-banīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أصطفى البنات على البنين

verse_text_english: What is wrong with your logic?
verse_text_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما لكم كيف تحكمون

verse_text_english: Why do you not take heed?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afalā tadhakkarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفلا تذكرون

verse_text_english: Do you have any proof?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: am lakum sul'ṭānun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لكم سلطن مبين

verse_text_english: Show us your book, if you are truthful.
verse_text_arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fatū bikitābikum in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأتوا بكتبكم إن كنتم صدقين

verse_text_english: They even invented a special relationship between Him and the jinns. The jinns themselves know that they are subservient.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنة نسبا ولقد علمت الجنة إنهم لمحضرون

verse_text_english: GOD be glorified; far above their claims.
verse_text_arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: سبحن الله عما يصفون

verse_text_english: Only GOD's servants who are devoted to Him alone (are saved).
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عباد الله المخلصين

verse_text_english: Indeed, you and what you worship.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-innakum wamā taʿbudūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإنكم وما تعبدون

verse_text_english: Cannot impose anything on Him.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā antum ʿalayhi bifātinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أنتم عليه بفتنين

verse_text_english: Only you will burn in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: illā man huwa ṣāli l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا من هو صال الجحيم

verse_text_english: Each one of us has a specific job.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما منا إلا له مقام معلوم

verse_text_english: We are the arrangers.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innā lanaḥnu l-ṣāfūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنا لنحن الصافون

verse_text_english: We have duly glorified (our Lord).
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innā lanaḥnu l-musabiḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنا لنحن المسبحون

verse_text_english: They used to say,
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in kānū layaqūlūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن كانوا ليقولون

verse_text_english: "Had we received the correct instructions from our parents,
verse_text_arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو أن عندنا ذكرا من الأولين

verse_text_english: "we would have been worshipers; devoted to GOD alone."
verse_text_arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: lakunnā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لكنا عباد الله المخلصين

verse_text_english: But they disbelieved, and they will surely find out.
verse_text_arabic: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fakafarū bihi fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكفروا به فسوف يعلمون

verse_text_english: Our decision is already decreed for our servants the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad sabaqat kalimatunā liʿibādinā l-mur'salīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد سبقت كلمتنا لعبادنا المرسلين

verse_text_english: They are surely the victors.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahum lahumu l-manṣūrūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنهم لهم المنصورون

verse_text_english: Our soldiers are the winners.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna jundanā lahumu l-ghālibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن جندنا لهم الغلبون

verse_text_english: So disregard them for awhile.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fatawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتول عنهم حتى حين

verse_text_english: Watch them; they too will watch.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-abṣir'hum fasawfa yub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأبصرهم فسوف يبصرون

verse_text_english: Do they challenge our retribution?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفبعذابنا يستعجلون

verse_text_english: When it hits them one day, it will be a miserable day; they have been sufficiently warned.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح المنذرين

verse_text_english: Disregard them for awhile.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: watawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتول عنهم حتى حين

verse_text_english: Watch them; they too will watch.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-abṣir fasawfa yub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأبصر فسوف يبصرون

verse_text_english: Glory be to your Lord, the great Lord; far above their claims.
verse_text_arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: سبحن ربك رب العزة عما يصفون

verse_text_english: Peace be upon the messengers.
verse_text_arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wasalāmun ʿalā l-mur'salīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وسلم على المرسلين

verse_text_english: Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والحمد لله رب العلمين

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: S. (Saad),* and the Quran that contains the proof.**
verse_text_arabic: صٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'r
verse_footnote_english:
*38:1 This Initial (Saad) occurs in suras 7, 19, & 38 a total of 152 times, 19x8 (Appendix 1).

**38:1 The word "Zikr" is made distinct from the Quran and clearly points at the Quran's miraculous mathematical code. See 15:6, 9; 16:44; 21:2, 24; 26:5; & 36:11, 69.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ص والقرءان ذى الذكر

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieve have plunged into arrogance and defiance.
verse_text_arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل الذين كفروا فى عزة وشقاق

verse_text_english: Many a generation before them we annihilated. They called for help; in vain.
verse_text_arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص

verse_text_english: They wondered that a warner should come to them, from among them. The disbelievers said, "A magician; a liar.
verse_text_arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم وقال الكفرون هذا سحر كذاب

verse_text_english: "Did he make the gods into one god? This is really strange."
verse_text_arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أجعل الءالهة إلها وحدا إن هذا لشىء عجاب

verse_text_english: The leaders announced, "Go and steadfastly persevere in worshiping your gods. This is what is desired.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurād
verse_text_arabic_clean: وانطلق الملأ منهم أن امشوا واصبروا على ءالهتكم إن هذا لشىء يراد

verse_text_english: "We never heard of this from the religion of our fathers. This is a lie.
verse_text_arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
verse_text_transliterated: mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما سمعنا بهذا فى الملة الءاخرة إن هذا إلا اختلق

verse_text_english: "Why did the proof come down to him, instead of us?" Indeed, they are doubtful of My proof. Indeed, they have not yet tasted My retribution.
verse_text_arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: أءنزل عليه الذكر من بيننا بل هم فى شك من ذكرى بل لما يذوقوا عذاب

verse_text_english: Do they own the treasures of mercy of your Lord, the Almighty, the Grantor?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verse_text_transliterated: am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم عندهم خزائن رحمة ربك العزيز الوهاب

verse_text_english: Do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them? Let them help themselves.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم ملك السموت والأرض وما بينهما فليرتقوا فى الأسبب

verse_text_english: Instead, whatever forces they can muster—even if all their parties banded together—will be defeated.
verse_text_arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الأحزاب

verse_text_english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, 'Ãd, and the mighty Pharaoh.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtād
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الأوتاد

verse_text_english: Also, Thamûd, the people of Lot, the dwellers of the Woods (of Midyan); those were the opponents.
verse_text_arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verse_text_transliterated: wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وثمود وقوم لوط وأصحب لـٔيكة أولئك الأحزاب

verse_text_english: Each of them disbelieved the messengers and thus, My retribution was inevitable.
verse_text_arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن كل إلا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب

verse_text_english: These people can expect a single blow, from which they never recover.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما ينظر هؤلاء إلا صيحة وحدة ما لها من فواق

verse_text_english: They challenged: "Our Lord, why do you not rush the retribution for us, before the Day of Reckoning."
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب

verse_text_english: Be patient in the face of their utterances, and remember our servant David, the resourceful; he was obedient.
verse_text_arabic: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: اصبر على ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داود ذا الأيد إنه أواب

verse_text_english: We committed the mountains in his service, glorifying with him night and day.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāq
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشى والإشراق

verse_text_english: Also the birds were committed to serve him; all were obedient to him.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والطير محشورة كل له أواب

verse_text_english: We strengthened his kingship, and endowed him with wisdom and good logic.
verse_text_arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وشددنا ملكه وءاتينه الحكمة وفصل الخطاب

verse_text_english: Have you received news of the feuding men who sneaked into his sanctuary?
verse_text_arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهل أتىك نبؤا الخصم إذ تسوروا المحراب

verse_text_english: When they entered his room, he was startled. They said, "Have no fear. We are feuding with one another, and we are seeking your fair judgment. Do not wrong us, and guide us in the right path.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verse_text_transliterated: idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭ
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ دخلوا على داود ففزع منهم قالوا لا تخف خصمان بغى بعضنا على بعض فاحكم بيننا بالحق ولا تشطط واهدنا إلى سواء الصرط

verse_text_english: "This brother of mine owns ninety-nine* sheep, while I own one sheep. He wants to mix my sheep with his, and continues to pressure me."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭāb
verse_footnote_english: *38:23 This is the only place where the number 99 occurs. Thirty different numbers are mentioned in the Quran, and their total comes to 162146, 19x8534. See Appendix 1.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا أخى له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولى نعجة وحدة فقال أكفلنيها وعزنى فى الخطاب

verse_text_english: He said, "He is being unfair to you by asking to combine your sheep with his. Most people who combine their properties treat each other unfairly, except those who believe and work righteousness, and these are so few." Afterwards, David wondered if he made the right judgment. He thought that we were testing him. He then implored his Lord for forgiveness, bowed down, and repented.*
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāb
verse_footnote_english: *38:24 In this clear example, 99 on one side vs 1 on the other side, David's extreme care to render the correct judgment caused him to ask forgiveness. Are we this careful?
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال لقد ظلمك بسؤال نعجتك إلى نعاجه وإن كثيرا من الخلطاء ليبغى بعضهم على بعض إلا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وقليل ما هم وظن داود أنما فتنه فاستغفر ربه وخر راكعا وأناب

verse_text_english: We forgave him in this matter. We have granted him a position of honor with us, and a beautiful abode.
verse_text_arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فغفرنا له ذلك وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مـٔاب

verse_text_english: O David, we have made you a ruler on earth. Therefore, you shall judge among the people equitably, and do not follow your personal opinion, lest it diverts you from the way of GOD. Surely, those who stray off the way of GOD incur severe retribution for forgetting the Day of Reckoning.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: يداود إنا جعلنك خليفة فى الأرض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوى فيضلك عن سبيل الله إن الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم الحساب

verse_text_english: We did not create the heaven and the earth, and everything between them, in vain. Such is the thinking of those who disbelieve. Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve; they will suffer in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًا ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما خلقنا السماء والأرض وما بينهما بطلا ذلك ظن الذين كفروا فويل للذين كفروا من النار

verse_text_english: Shall we treat those who believe and lead a righteous life as we treat those who commit evil on earth? Shall we treat the righteous as we treat the wicked?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujār
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم نجعل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت كالمفسدين فى الأرض أم نجعل المتقين كالفجار

verse_text_english: This is a scripture that we sent down to you, that is sacred—perhaps they reflect on its verses. Those who possess intelligence will take heed.
verse_text_arabic: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: كتب أنزلنه إليك مبرك ليدبروا ءايته وليتذكر أولوا الألبب

verse_text_english: To David we granted Solomon; a good and obedient servant.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووهبنا لداود سليمن نعم العبد إنه أواب

verse_text_english: One day he became preoccupied with beautiful horses, until the night fell.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verse_text_transliterated: idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyād
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ عرض عليه بالعشى الصفنت الجياد

verse_text_english: He then said, "I enjoyed the material things more than I enjoyed worshiping my Lord, until the sun was gone.*
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijāb
verse_footnote_english: *38:32 Solomon missed his afternoon prayer because of his horses. To nullify Satan's possible claim that Solomon loved his horses more than loving God, he got rid of his horses.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقال إنى أحببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربى حتى توارت بالحجاب

verse_text_english: "Bring them back." (To bid farewell,) he rubbed their legs and necks.
verse_text_arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verse_text_transliterated: ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāq
verse_text_arabic_clean: ردوها على فطفق مسحا بالسوق والأعناق

verse_text_english: We thus put Solomon to the test; we blessed him with vast material wealth, but he steadfastly submitted.*
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāb
verse_footnote_english: *38:34 & 41 Solomon and Job represent both ends of the testing spectrum. We are put to the test through wealth, health, or lack of them, to see if we worship God alone under all circumstances.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد فتنا سليمن وألقينا على كرسيه جسدا ثم أناب

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingship never attained by anyone else. You are the Grantor."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب اغفر لى وهب لى ملكا لا ينبغى لأحد من بعدى إنك أنت الوهاب

verse_text_english: We (answered his prayer and) committed the wind at his disposal, pouring rain wherever he wanted.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسخرنا له الريح تجرى بأمره رخاء حيث أصاب

verse_text_english: And the devils, building and diving.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: والشيطين كل بناء وغواص

verse_text_english: Others were placed at his disposal.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfād
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاخرين مقرنين فى الأصفاد

verse_text_english: "This is our provision to you; you may give generously, or withhold, without limits."
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا عطاؤنا فامنن أو أمسك بغير حساب

verse_text_english: He has deserved an honorable position with us, and a wonderful abode.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مـٔاب

verse_text_english: Remember our servant Job: he called upon his Lord, "The devil has afflicted me with hardship and pain."
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر عبدنا أيوب إذ نادى ربه أنى مسنى الشيطن بنصب وعذاب

verse_text_english: "Strike the ground with your foot. A spring will give you healing and a drink."
verse_text_arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: اركض برجلك هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب

verse_text_english: We restored his family for him; twice as many. Such is our mercy; a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verse_subtitle_english: God Makes it up to the Believers
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووهبنا له أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة منا وذكرى لأولى الألبب

verse_text_english: "Now, you shall travel the land and preach the message, to fulfill your pledge." We found him steadfast. What a good servant! He was a submitter.
verse_text_arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًا نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث إنا وجدنه صابرا نعم العبد إنه أواب

verse_text_english: Remember also our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. They were resourceful, and possessed vision.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣār
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر عبدنا إبرهيم وإسحق ويعقوب أولى الأيدى والأبصر

verse_text_english: We bestowed upon them a great blessing: awareness of the Hereafter.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dār
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أخلصنهم بخالصة ذكرى الدار

verse_text_english: They were chosen, for they were among the most righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyār
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الأخيار

verse_text_english: Remember Ismail, Elisha, and Zal-Kifl; among the most righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyār
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر إسمعيل واليسع وذا الكفل وكل من الأخيار

verse_text_english: This is a reminder: The righteous have deserved a wonderful destiny.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا ذكر وإن للمتقين لحسن مـٔاب

verse_text_english: The gardens of Eden will open up their gates for them.
verse_text_arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verse_text_transliterated: jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: جنت عدن مفتحة لهم الأبوب

verse_text_english: Relaxing therein, they will be given many kinds of fruits and drinks.
verse_text_arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratin washarābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: متكـٔين فيها يدعون فيها بفكهة كثيرة وشراب

verse_text_english: They will have wonderful spouses.
verse_text_arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi atrābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعندهم قصرت الطرف أتراب

verse_text_english: This is what you have deserved on the Day of Reckoning.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب

verse_text_english: Our provisions are inexhaustible.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min nafādi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد

verse_text_english: As for the transgressors, they have incurred a miserable destiny.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābi
verse_subtitle_english: The Disbelievers: Feuding With One Another
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا وإن للطغين لشر مـٔاب

verse_text_english: Hell is where they burn; what a miserable abode!
verse_text_arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verse_text_transliterated: jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihād
verse_text_arabic_clean: جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد

verse_text_english: What they taste therein will be hellish drinks and bitter food.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqu
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق

verse_text_english: And much more of the same kind.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waākharu min shaklihi azwāju
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاخر من شكله أزوج

verse_text_english: "This is a group to be thrown into Hell with you." They will not be welcomed (by the residents of Hell). They have deserved to burn in the hellfire.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā fawjun muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا فوج مقتحم معكم لا مرحبا بهم إنهم صالوا النار

verse_text_english: The newcomers will respond, "Nor are you welcomed. You are the ones who preceded us and misled us. Therefore, suffer this miserable end."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarār
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا بل أنتم لا مرحبا بكم أنتم قدمتموه لنا فبئس القرار

verse_text_english: They will also say, "Our Lord, these are the ones who led us into this; double the retribution of hellfire for them."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا فى النار

verse_text_english: They will say, "How come we do not see (in Hell) people we used to count among the wicked?
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrār
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا ما لنا لا نرى رجالا كنا نعدهم من الأشرار

verse_text_english: "We used to ridicule them; we used to turn our eyes away from them."
verse_text_arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
verse_text_transliterated: attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣār
verse_text_arabic_clean: أتخذنهم سخريا أم زاغت عنهم الأبصر

verse_text_english: This is a predetermined fact: the people of Hell will feud with one another.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ذلك لحق تخاصم أهل النار

verse_text_english: Say, "I warn you; there is no other god beside GOD, the One, the Supreme.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verse_text_transliterated: qul innamā anā mundhirun wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahār
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنما أنا منذر وما من إله إلا الله الوحد القهار

verse_text_english: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Almighty, the Forgiving."
verse_text_arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verse_text_transliterated: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafār
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب السموت والأرض وما بينهما العزيز الغفر

verse_text_english: Say, "Here is awesome news.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل هو نبؤا عظيم

verse_text_english: "That you are totally oblivious to.
verse_text_arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أنتم عنه معرضون

verse_text_english: "I had no knowledge previously, about the feud in the High Society.*
verse_text_arabic: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūn
verse_footnote_english: *38:69 The feud in the High Society was triggered by Satan's challenge to God's absolute authority. This is definitely the most important event in the history of the human race. We failed to make a firm stand regarding God's absolute authority. This life represents the third and final chance to redeem ourselves (See the Introduction and Appendix 7).
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما كان لى من علم بالملإ الأعلى إذ يختصمون

verse_text_english: "I am inspired that my sole mission is to deliver the warnings to you."
verse_text_arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: in yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن يوحى إلى إلا أنما أنا نذير مبين

verse_text_english: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human being from clay.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṭīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ قال ربك للملئكة إنى خلق بشرا من طين

verse_text_english: "Once I design him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him."
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحى فقعوا له سجدين

verse_text_english: The angels fell prostrate, all of them,
verse_text_arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسجد الملئكة كلهم أجمعون

verse_text_english: except Satan; he refused, and was too arrogant, unappreciative.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا إبليس استكبر وكان من الكفرين

verse_text_english: He said, "O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My hands? Are you too arrogant? Have you rebelled?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال يإبليس ما منعك أن تسجد لما خلقت بيدى أستكبرت أم كنت من العالين

verse_text_english: He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire, and created him from clay."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أنا خير منه خلقتنى من نار وخلقته من طين

verse_text_english: He said, "Therefore, you must be exiled, you will be banished.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم

verse_text_english: "You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن عليك لعنتى إلى يوم الدين

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, respite me till the Day of Resurrection."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب فأنظرنى إلى يوم يبعثون

verse_text_english: He said, "You are respited.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فإنك من المنظرين

verse_text_english: "Until the appointed day."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى يوم الوقت المعلوم

verse_text_english: He said, "I swear by Your majesty, that I will send them all astray.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فبعزتك لأغوينهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: "Except Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين

verse_text_english: He said, "This is the truth, and the truth is all that I utter.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فالحق والحق أقول

verse_text_english: I will fill Hell with you and all those who follow you.
verse_text_arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: la-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لأملأن جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: Say, "I do not ask you for any wage, and I am not an imposter.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل ما أسـٔلكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين

verse_text_english: "This is a reminder for the world.
verse_text_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هو إلا ذكر للعلمين

verse_text_english: "And you will certainly find out in awhile."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولتعلمن نبأه بعد حين

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: This is a revelation of the scripture, from GOD, the Almighty, the Wise.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز الحكيم

verse_text_english: We sent down to you this scripture, truthfully; you shall worship GOD, devoting your religion to Him alone.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi fa-uʿ'budi l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أنزلنا إليك الكتب بالحق فاعبد الله مخلصا له الدين

verse_text_english: Absolutely, the religion shall be devoted to GOD alone. Those who set up idols beside Him say, "We idolize them only to bring us closer to GOD; for they are in a better position!" GOD will judge them regarding their disputes. GOD does not guide such liars, disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
verse_text_transliterated: alā lillahi l-dīnu l-khāliṣu wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa mā naʿbuduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilā l-lahi zul'fā inna l-laha yaḥkumu baynahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa kādhibun kaffāru
verse_subtitle_english: The Idols as Mediators A Common Myth
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألا لله الدين الخالص والذين اتخذوا من دونه أولياء ما نعبدهم إلا ليقربونا إلى الله زلفى إن الله يحكم بينهم فى ما هم فيه يختلفون إن الله لا يهدى من هو كذب كفار

verse_text_english: If GOD wanted to have a son, He could have chosen whomever He willed from among His creations. Be He glorified; He is GOD, the One, the Supreme.
verse_text_arabic: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verse_text_transliterated: law arāda l-lahu an yattakhidha waladan la-iṣ'ṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāu sub'ḥānahu huwa l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahār
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو أراد الله أن يتخذ ولدا لاصطفى مما يخلق ما يشاء سبحنه هو الله الوحد القهار

verse_text_english: He created the heavens and the earth truthfully. He rolls the night over the day, and rolls the day over the night.* He committed the sun and the moon, each running for a finite period. Absolutely, He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
verse_text_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verse_text_transliterated: khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi yukawwiru al-layla ʿalā l-nahāri wayukawwiru l-nahāra ʿalā al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman alā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafār
verse_footnote_english: *39:5 This verse clearly informs us that the earth is round. The Arabic for "He rolls" (Yukawwir) is derived from the Arabic word for "ball" (Kurah). Since the Earth is not exactly round, a specific reference to its shape is given in 79:30. The Quran is replete with scientific information that became known to us centuries after the revelation of the Quran. See Appendix 20.
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلق السموت والأرض بالحق يكور اليل على النهار ويكور النهار على اليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجرى لأجل مسمى ألا هو العزيز الغفر

verse_text_english: He created you from one person, then created from him his mate. He sent down to you eight kinds of livestock. He creates you in your mothers' bellies, creation after creation, in trimesters of darkness. Such is GOD your Lord. To Him belongs all sovereignty. There is no other god beside Him. How could you deviate?
verse_text_arabic: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍ ثَلَٰثٍ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin thumma jaʿala min'hā zawjahā wa-anzala lakum mina l-anʿāmi thamāniyata azwājin yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqan min baʿdi khalqin fī ẓulumātin thalāthin dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tuṣ'rafūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلقكم من نفس وحدة ثم جعل منها زوجها وأنزل لكم من الأنعم ثمنية أزوج يخلقكم فى بطون أمهتكم خلقا من بعد خلق فى ظلمت ثلث ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك لا إله إلا هو فأنى تصرفون

verse_text_english: If you disbelieve, GOD does not need anyone. But He dislikes to see His servants make the wrong decision. If you decide to be appreciative, He is pleased for you. No soul bears the sins of any other soul. Ultimately, to your Lord is your return, then He will inform you of everything you had done. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
verse_text_arabic: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: in takfurū fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ʿankum walā yarḍā liʿibādihi l-kuf'ra wa-in tashkurū yarḍahu lakum walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن تكفروا فإن الله غنى عنكم ولا يرضى لعباده الكفر وإن تشكروا يرضه لكم ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون إنه عليم بذات الصدور

verse_text_english: When the human being is afflicted, he implores his Lord, sincerely devoted to Him. But as soon as He blesses him, he forgets his previous imploring, sets up idols to rank with GOD and to divert others from His path. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief temporarily; you have incurred the hellfire."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ilayhi thumma idhā khawwalahu niʿ'matan min'hu nasiya mā kāna yadʿū ilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillahi andādan liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿ bikuf'rika qalīlan innaka min aṣḥābi l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا مس الإنسن ضر دعا ربه منيبا إليه ثم إذا خوله نعمة منه نسى ما كان يدعوا إليه من قبل وجعل لله أندادا ليضل عن سبيله قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا إنك من أصحب النار

verse_text_english: Is it not better to be one of those who meditate in the night, prostrating and staying up, being aware of the Hereafter, and seeking the mercy of their Lord? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
verse_text_arabic: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: amman huwa qānitun ānāa al-layli sājidan waqāiman yaḥdharu l-ākhirata wayarjū raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawī alladhīna yaʿlamūna wa-alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna innamā yatadhakkaru ulū l-albāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: أمن هو قنت ءاناء اليل ساجدا وقائما يحذر الءاخرة ويرجوا رحمة ربه قل هل يستوى الذين يعلمون والذين لا يعلمون إنما يتذكر أولوا الألبب

verse_text_english: Say, "O My servants who believed, you shall reverence your Lord." For those who worked righteousness in this world, a good reward. GOD's earth is spacious, and those who steadfastly persevere will receive their recompense generously, without limits.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qul yāʿibādi alladhīna āmanū ittaqū rabbakum lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun wa-arḍu l-lahi wāsiʿatun innamā yuwaffā l-ṣābirūna ajrahum bighayri ḥisābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل يعباد الذين ءامنوا اتقوا ربكم للذين أحسنوا فى هذه الدنيا حسنة وأرض الله وسعة إنما يوفى الصبرون أجرهم بغير حساب

verse_text_english: Say, "I have been commanded to worship GOD, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul innī umir'tu an aʿbuda l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنى أمرت أن أعبد الله مخلصا له الدين

verse_text_english: "And I was commanded to be the utmost submitter."
verse_text_arabic: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-umir'tu li-an akūna awwala l-mus'limīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين

verse_text_english: Say, "I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of a great day."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنى أخاف إن عصيت ربى عذاب يوم عظيم

verse_text_english: Say, "GOD is the only One I worship, devoting my religion absolutely to Him alone.
verse_text_arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
verse_text_transliterated: quli l-laha aʿbudu mukh'liṣan lahu dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل الله أعبد مخلصا له دينى

verse_text_english: "Therefore, worship whatever you wish besides Him." Say, "The real losers are those who lose their souls, and their families, on the Day of Resurrection." Most certainly, this is the real loss.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-uʿ'budū mā shi'tum min dūnihi qul inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاعبدوا ما شئتم من دونه قل إن الخسرين الذين خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيمة ألا ذلك هو الخسران المبين

verse_text_english: They will have masses of fire on top of them, and under them. GOD thus alerts His servants: O My servants, you shall reverence Me.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: lahum min fawqihim ẓulalun mina l-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun dhālika yukhawwifu l-lahu bihi ʿibādahu yāʿibādi fa-ittaqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لهم من فوقهم ظلل من النار ومن تحتهم ظلل ذلك يخوف الله به عباده يعباد فاتقون

verse_text_english: As for those who discard the worship of all idols, and devote themselves totally to GOD alone, they have deserved happiness. Give good news to My servants.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna ij'tanabū l-ṭāghūta an yaʿbudūhā wa-anābū ilā l-lahi lahumu l-bush'rā fabashir ʿibād
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين اجتنبوا الطغوت أن يعبدوها وأنابوا إلى الله لهم البشرى فبشر عباد

verse_text_english: They are the ones who examine all words, then follow the best. These are the ones whom GOD has guided; these are the ones who possess intelligence.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna yastamiʿūna l-qawla fayattabiʿūna aḥsanahu ulāika alladhīna hadāhumu l-lahu wa-ulāika hum ulū l-albāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه أولئك الذين هدىهم الله وأولئك هم أولوا الألبب

verse_text_english: With regard to those who have deserved the retribution, can you save those who are already in Hell?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: afaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimatu l-ʿadhābi afa-anta tunqidhu man fī l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفمن حق عليه كلمة العذاب أفأنت تنقذ من فى النار

verse_text_english: As for those who reverence their Lord, they will have mansions upon mansions constructed for them, with flowing streams. This is GOD's promise, and GOD never breaks His promise.
verse_text_arabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verse_text_transliterated: lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihā ghurafun mabniyyatun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waʿda l-lahi lā yukh'lifu l-lahu l-mīʿād
verse_text_arabic_clean: لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم غرف من فوقها غرف مبنية تجرى من تحتها الأنهر وعد الله لا يخلف الله الميعاد

verse_text_english: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water, then places it into underground wells, then produces with it plants of various colors, then they grow until they turn yellow, then He turns them into hay? This should be a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًا إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fī l-arḍi thumma yukh'riju bihi zarʿan mukh'talifan alwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فسلكه ينبيع فى الأرض ثم يخرج به زرعا مختلفا ألونه ثم يهيج فترىه مصفرا ثم يجعله حطما إن فى ذلك لذكرى لأولى الألبب

verse_text_english: If GOD renders one's heart content with Submission, he will be following a light from his Lord. Therefore, woe to those whose hearts are hardened against GOD's message; they have gone far astray.
verse_text_arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: afaman sharaḥa l-lahu ṣadrahu lil'is'lāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin min rabbihi fawaylun lil'qāsiyati qulūbuhum min dhik'ri l-lahi ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفمن شرح الله صدره للإسلم فهو على نور من ربه فويل للقسية قلوبهم من ذكر الله أولئك فى ضلل مبين

verse_text_english: GOD has revealed herein the best Hadith; a book that is consistent, and points out both ways (to Heaven and Hell). The skins of those who reverence their Lord cringe therefrom, then their skins and their hearts soften up for GOD's message. Such is GOD's guidance; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. As for those sent astray by GOD, nothing can guide them.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبًا مُّتَشَٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu nazzala aḥsana l-ḥadīthi kitāban mutashābihan mathāniya taqshaʿirru min'hu julūdu alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ilā dhik'ri l-lahi dhālika hudā l-lahi yahdī bihi man yashāu waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādi
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله نزل أحسن الحديث كتبا متشبها مثانى تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم إلى ذكر الله ذلك هدى الله يهدى به من يشاء ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد

verse_text_english: What is better than saving one's face from the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection? The transgressors will be told, "Taste the consequences of what you earned."
verse_text_arabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afaman yattaqī biwajhihi sūa l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqū mā kuntum taksibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفمن يتقى بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيمة وقيل للظلمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون

verse_text_english: Others before them have disbelieved and, consequently, the retribution afflicted them whence they never expected.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذب الذين من قبلهم فأتىهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون

verse_text_english: GOD has condemned them to humiliation in this life, and the retribution in the Hereafter will be far worse, if they only knew.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-adhāqahumu l-lahu l-khiz'ya fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأذاقهم الله الخزى فى الحيوة الدنيا ولعذاب الءاخرة أكبر لو كانوا يعلمون

verse_text_english: We have cited for the people every kind of example in this Quran, that they may take heed.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin laʿallahum yatadhakkarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد ضربنا للناس فى هذا القرءان من كل مثل لعلهم يتذكرون

verse_text_english: An Arabic Quran, without any ambiguity, that they may be righteous.
verse_text_arabic: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhī ʿiwajin laʿallahum yattaqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قرءانا عربيا غير ذى عوج لعلهم يتقون

verse_text_english: GOD cites the example of a man who deals with disputing partners (Hadith), compared to a man who deals with only one consistent source (Quran). Are they the same? Praise be to GOD; most of them do not know.
verse_text_arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulan fīhi shurakāu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء متشكسون ورجلا سلما لرجل هل يستويان مثلا الحمد لله بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون

verse_text_english: You (Muhammad) will surely die, just like they will die.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innaka mayyitun wa-innahum mayyitūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنك ميت وإنهم ميتون

verse_text_english: On the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, you people will feud with one another.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إنكم يوم القيمة عند ربكم تختصمون

verse_text_english: Who is more evil than one who attributes lies to GOD, while disbelieving in the truth that has come to him? Is Hell not a just requital for the disbelievers?
verse_text_arabic: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: faman aẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā l-lahi wakadhaba bil-ṣid'qi idh jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن أظلم ممن كذب على الله وكذب بالصدق إذ جاءه أليس فى جهنم مثوى للكفرين

verse_text_english: As for those who promote the truth, and believe therein, they are the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhī jāa bil-ṣid'qi waṣaddaqa bihi ulāika humu l-mutaqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذى جاء بالصدق وصدق به أولئك هم المتقون

verse_text_english: They will get everything they wish, at their Lord. Such is the reward for the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika jazāu l-muḥ'sinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ذلك جزاء المحسنين

verse_text_english: GOD remits their sinful works, and rewards them generously for their good works.
verse_text_arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: liyukaffira l-lahu ʿanhum aswa-a alladhī ʿamilū wayajziyahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani alladhī kānū yaʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليكفر الله عنهم أسوأ الذى عملوا ويجزيهم أجرهم بأحسن الذى كانوا يعملون

verse_text_english: Is GOD not sufficient for His servant? They frighten you with the idols they set up beside Him. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verse_text_transliterated: alaysa l-lahu bikāfin ʿabdahu wayukhawwifūnaka bi-alladhīna min dūnihi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādi
verse_text_arabic_clean: أليس الله بكاف عبده ويخوفونك بالذين من دونه ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد

verse_text_english: And whomever GOD guides, nothing can send him astray. Is GOD not Almighty, Avenger?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waman yahdi l-lahu famā lahu min muḍillin alaysa l-lahu biʿazīzin dhī intiqāmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن يهد الله فما له من مضل أليس الله بعزيز ذى انتقام

verse_text_english: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they will say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you set up idols beside GOD? If GOD willed any adversity for me, can they relieve such an adversity? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they prevent such a blessing?" Say, "GOD is sufficient for me." In Him the trusters shall trust.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوْ أَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu qul afara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi in arādaniya l-lahu biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi aw arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mum'sikātu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya l-lahu ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakilūn
verse_subtitle_english: They Believe in God Yet, They Are Going to Hell
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولئن سألتهم من خلق السموت والأرض ليقولن الله قل أفرءيتم ما تدعون من دون الله إن أرادنى الله بضر هل هن كشفت ضره أو أرادنى برحمة هل هن ممسكت رحمته قل حسبى الله عليه يتوكل المتوكلون

verse_text_english: Say, "O my people, do your best and I will do my best; you will surely find out.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَٰمِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul yāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل يقوم اعملوا على مكانتكم إنى عمل فسوف تعلمون

verse_text_english: "(You will find out) who has incurred shameful punishment, and has deserved an eternal retribution."
verse_text_arabic: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: من يأتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم

verse_text_english: We have revealed the scripture through you for the people, truthfully. Then, whoever is guided is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray goes astray to his own detriment. You are not their advocate.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba lilnnāsi bil-ḥaqi famani ih'tadā falinafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīli
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أنزلنا عليك الكتب للناس بالحق فمن اهتدى فلنفسه ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها وما أنت عليهم بوكيل

verse_text_english: GOD puts the souls to death when the end of their life comes, and also at the time of sleep. Thus, He takes some back during their sleep, while others are allowed to continue living until the end of their predetermined interim. This should provide lessons for people who reflect.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu yatawaffā l-anfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-allatī lam tamut fī manāmihā fayum'siku allatī qaḍā ʿalayhā l-mawta wayur'silu l-ukh'rā ilā ajalin musamman inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله يتوفى الأنفس حين موتها والتى لم تمت فى منامها فيمسك التى قضى عليها الموت ويرسل الأخرى إلى أجل مسمى إن فى ذلك لءايت لقوم يتفكرون

verse_text_english: Have they invented intercessors to mediate between them and GOD? Say, "What if they do not possess any power, nor understanding?"
verse_text_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ami ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi shufaʿāa qul awalaw kānū lā yamlikūna shayan walā yaʿqilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم اتخذوا من دون الله شفعاء قل أولو كانوا لا يملكون شيـٔا ولا يعقلون

verse_text_english: Say, "All intercession belongs to GOD." To Him belongs all sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, then to Him you will be returned.
verse_text_arabic: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul lillahi l-shafāʿatu jamīʿan lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi thumma ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل لله الشفعة جميعا له ملك السموت والأرض ثم إليه ترجعون

verse_text_english: When GOD ALONE is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion. But when others are mentioned beside Him, they become satisfied.*
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā dhukira l-lahu waḥdahu ish'ma-azzat qulūbu alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati wa-idhā dhukira alladhīna min dūnihi idhā hum yastabshirūn
verse_footnote_english: *39:45 Despite the clear commandment in 3:18 that the First Pillar of Submission is proclaiming: "Ash-hadu An Lã Elãha Ellã Allãh (there is no other god beside God)," the majority of "Muslims" insist upon adding the name of Muhammad. This Greatest Criterion alerts us that rejoicing in adding the name of Muhammad, or any other name, exposes disbelief in the Hereafter. See also Footnote 17:46.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا ذكر الله وحده اشمأزت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالءاخرة وإذا ذكر الذين من دونه إذا هم يستبشرون

verse_text_english: Proclaim: "Our god, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of all secrets and declarations, You are the only One who judges among Your servants regarding their disputes."
verse_text_arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: quli l-lahuma fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ʿālima l-ghaybi wal-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fī mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل اللهم فاطر السموت والأرض علم الغيب والشهدة أنت تحكم بين عبادك فى ما كانوا فيه يختلفون

verse_text_english: If those who transgressed owned everything on earth, even twice as much, they would readily give it up to avoid the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection. They will be shown by GOD what they never expected.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw anna lilladhīna ẓalamū mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan wamith'lahu maʿahu la-if'tadaw bihi min sūi l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati wabadā lahum mina l-lahi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو أن للذين ظلموا ما فى الأرض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به من سوء العذاب يوم القيمة وبدا لهم من الله ما لم يكونوا يحتسبون

verse_text_english: The sinful works they had earned will be shown to them, and the very things they used to mock will come back to haunt them.
verse_text_arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā kasabū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبدا لهم سيـٔات ما كسبوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون

verse_text_english: If the human is touched by adversity, he implores us, but as soon as we bestow a blessing upon him, he says, "I attained this because of my cleverness!" Indeed, this is only a test, but most of them do not know.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma idhā khawwalnāhu niʿ'matan minnā qāla innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿil'min bal hiya fit'natun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا مس الإنسن ضر دعانا ثم إذا خولنه نعمة منا قال إنما أوتيته على علم بل هى فتنة ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون

verse_text_english: Those before them have uttered the same thing, and their earnings did not help them in the least.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qad qālahā alladhīna min qablihim famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قد قالها الذين من قبلهم فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون

verse_text_english: They suffered the consequences of their evil works. Similarly, the transgressors among the present generation will suffer the consequences of their evil works; they cannot escape.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā kasabū wa-alladhīna ẓalamū min hāulāi sayuṣībuhum sayyiātu mā kasabū wamā hum bimuʿ'jizīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأصابهم سيـٔات ما كسبوا والذين ظلموا من هؤلاء سيصيبهم سيـٔات ما كسبوا وما هم بمعجزين

verse_text_english: Do they not realize that GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses, and withholds? These are lessons for people who believe.
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: awalam yaʿlamū anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولم يعلموا أن الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر إن فى ذلك لءايت لقوم يؤمنون

verse_text_english: Proclaim: "O My servants who exceeded the limits, never despair of GOD's mercy. For GOD forgives all sins. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: qul yāʿibādiya alladhīna asrafū ʿalā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati l-lahi inna l-laha yaghfiru l-dhunūba jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل يعبادى الذين أسرفوا على أنفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا إنه هو الغفور الرحيم

verse_text_english: You shall obey your Lord, and submit to Him totally, before the retribution overtakes you, then you cannot be helped.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anībū ilā rabbikum wa-aslimū lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūn
