verse_text_arabic: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waman aḥsanu qawlan mimman daʿā ilā l-lahi waʿamila ṣāliḥan waqāla innanī mina l-mus'limīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن أحسن قولا ممن دعا إلى الله وعمل صلحا وقال إننى من المسلمين

verse_text_english: Not equal is the good response and the bad response. You shall resort to the nicest possible response. Thus, the one who used to be your enemy, may become your best friend.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: walā tastawī l-ḥasanatu walā l-sayi-atu id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu fa-idhā alladhī baynaka wabaynahu ʿadāwatun ka-annahu waliyyun ḥamīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا تستوى الحسنة ولا السيئة ادفع بالتى هى أحسن فإذا الذى بينك وبينه عدوة كأنه ولى حميم

verse_text_english: None can attain this except those who steadfastly persevere. None can attain this except those who are extremely fortunate.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yulaqqāhā illā alladhīna ṣabarū wamā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يلقىها إلا الذين صبروا وما يلقىها إلا ذو حظ عظيم

verse_text_english: When the devil whispers an idea to you, you shall seek refuge in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإما ينزغنك من الشيطن نزغ فاستعذ بالله إنه هو السميع العليم

verse_text_english: Among His proofs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate before the sun, nor the moon; you shall fall prostrate before the GOD who created them, if you truly worship Him alone.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin āyātihi al-laylu wal-nahāru wal-shamsu wal-qamaru lā tasjudū lilshamsi walā lil'qamari wa-us'judū lillahi alladhī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن ءايته اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر لا تسجدوا للشمس ولا للقمر واسجدوا لله الذى خلقهن إن كنتم إياه تعبدون

verse_text_english: If they are too arrogant to do this, then those at your Lord glorify Him night and day, without ever tiring.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ini is'takbarū fa-alladhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahu bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wahum lā yasamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإن استكبروا فالذين عند ربك يسبحون له باليل والنهار وهم لا يسـٔمون

verse_text_english: Among His proofs is that you see the land still, then, as soon as we shower it with water, it vibrates with life. Surely, the One who revived it can revive the dead. He is Omnipotent.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَٰشِعَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin āyātihi annaka tarā l-arḍa khāshiʿatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat inna alladhī aḥyāhā lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن ءايته أنك ترى الأرض خشعة فإذا أنزلنا عليها الماء اهتزت وربت إن الذى أحياها لمحى الموتى إنه على كل شىء قدير

verse_text_english: Surely, those who distort our revelations are not hidden from us. Is one who gets thrown into Hell better, or one who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you wish; He is Seer of everything you do.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā afaman yul'qā fī l-nāri khayrun am man yatī āminan yawma l-qiyāmati iʿ'malū mā shi'tum innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين يلحدون فى ءايتنا لا يخفون علينا أفمن يلقى فى النار خير أم من يأتى ءامنا يوم القيمة اعملوا ما شئتم إنه بما تعملون بصير

verse_text_english: Those who have rejected the Quran's proof * when it came to them, have also rejected an Honorable book.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū bil-dhik'ri lammā jāahum wa-innahu lakitābun ʿazīzu
verse_footnote_english: *41:41 The word "Zikr" refers to the Quran's mathematical code, as made clear in 38:1.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين كفروا بالذكر لما جاءهم وإنه لكتب عزيز

verse_text_english: No falsehood could enter it, in the past or in the future;* a revelation from a Most Wise, Praiseworthy.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yatīhi l-bāṭilu min bayni yadayhi walā min khalfihi tanzīlun min ḥakīmin ḥamīdi
verse_footnote_english: *41:42 One of the major functions of the Quran's mathematical miracle is to guard every letter and every aspect of the Quran. Thus, any tampering is immediately recognized (Apps. 1 & 24).
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يأتيه البطل من بين يديه ولا من خلفه تنزيل من حكيم حميد

verse_text_english: What is said to you is precisely what was said to the previous messengers. Your Lord possesses forgiveness, and He also possesses painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratin wadhū ʿiqābin alīmi
verse_footnote_english: *41:43 Mathematical proof shows that this verse refers to God's Messenger of the Covenant. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus this verse number (43), we get 505+725+43=1273=19x67. See Appendix 2.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما يقال لك إلا ما قد قيل للرسل من قبلك إن ربك لذو مغفرة وذو عقاب أليم

verse_text_english: If we made it a non-Arabic Quran they would have said, "Why did it come down in that language?" Whether it is Arabic or non-Arabic, say, "For those who believe, it is a guide and healing. As for those who disbelieve, they will be deaf and blind to it, as if they are being addressed from faraway."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ وَعَرَبِىٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan aʿjamiyyan laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuhu āʿ'jamiyyun waʿarabiyyun qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudan washifāon wa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna fī ādhānihim waqrun wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿaman ulāika yunādawna min makānin baʿīdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو جعلنه قرءانا أعجميا لقالوا لولا فصلت ءايته ءاعجمى وعربى قل هو للذين ءامنوا هدى وشفاء والذين لا يؤمنون فى ءاذانهم وقر وهو عليهم عمى أولئك ينادون من مكان بعيد

verse_text_english: We have given Moses the scripture and it was also disputed. If it were not for your Lord's predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, they harbor too many doubts.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد ءاتينا موسى الكتب فاختلف فيه ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضى بينهم وإنهم لفى شك منه مريب

verse_text_english: Whoever works righteousness, does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. Your Lord is never unjust towards the people.
verse_text_arabic: مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā wamā rabbuka biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: من عمل صلحا فلنفسه ومن أساء فعليها وما ربك بظلم للعبيد

verse_text_english: With Him is the knowledge about the Hour (end of the world).* No fruits emerge from their sheaths, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. The day will come when He asks them: "Where are those idols that you set up beside Me?" They will say, "We proclaim to You that none of us bears witness to that."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: ilayhi yuraddu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wamā takhruju min thamarātin min akmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wayawma yunādīhim ayna shurakāī qālū ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīdi
verse_footnote_english: *41:47 God has revealed this knowledge through His Messenger of the Covenant (Appendix 25).
verse_text_arabic_clean: إليه يرد علم الساعة وما تخرج من ثمرت من أكمامها وما تحمل من أنثى ولا تضع إلا بعلمه ويوم يناديهم أين شركاءى قالوا ءاذنك ما منا من شهيد

verse_text_english: The idols they had idolized will disown them, and they will realize that there will be no escape.
verse_text_arabic: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yadʿūna min qablu waẓannū mā lahum min maḥīṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وضل عنهم ما كانوا يدعون من قبل وظنوا ما لهم من محيص

verse_text_english: The human being never tires of imploring for good things. And when adversity befalls him, he turns despondent, desperate.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌ قَنُوطٌ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yasamu l-insānu min duʿāi l-khayri wa-in massahu l-sharu fayaūsun qanūṭu
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسـٔم الإنسن من دعاء الخير وإن مسه الشر فيـٔوس قنوط

verse_text_english: And when we bless him after suffering some adversity, he says, "This belongs to me. I do not believe that the Hour will ever come to pass. Even if I am returned to my Lord, I will find at Him better things." Most certainly, we will inform the disbelievers of all their works, and will commit them to severe retribution.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wala-in adhaqnāhu raḥmatan minnā min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lī wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rujiʿ'tu ilā rabbī inna lī ʿindahu lalḥus'nā falanunabbi-anna alladhīna kafarū bimā ʿamilū walanudhīqannahum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولئن أذقنه رحمة منا من بعد ضراء مسته ليقولن هذا لى وما أظن الساعة قائمة ولئن رجعت إلى ربى إن لى عنده للحسنى فلننبئن الذين كفروا بما عملوا ولنذيقنهم من عذاب غليظ

verse_text_english: When we bless the human being, he turns away, and drifts farther and farther away, and when he suffers any affliction, he implores loudly.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu fadhū duʿāin ʿarīḍi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا أنعمنا على الإنسن أعرض ونـٔا بجانبه وإذا مسه الشر فذو دعاء عريض

verse_text_english: Proclaim: "What if this is truly from GOD, then you decide to reject it? Who are farther astray than those who decide to oppose this?"
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi thumma kafartum bihi man aḍallu mimman huwa fī shiqāqin baʿīdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أرءيتم إن كان من عند الله ثم كفرتم به من أضل ممن هو فى شقاق بعيد

verse_text_english: We will show them our proofs in the horizons, and within themselves, until they realize that this is the truth.* Is your Lord not sufficient, as a witness of all things?
verse_text_arabic: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْءَافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: sanurīhim āyātinā fī l-āfāqi wafī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahu l-ḥaqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdu
verse_footnote_english: *41:53 The letters that compose this verse are 19, and their gematrical values add up to 1387, 19x73. This great prophecy, together with 9:33, 48:28, 61:9 & 110:2, informs us that the whole world is destined to accept the Quran as God's unaltered message (See Appendix 38).
verse_text_arabic_clean: سنريهم ءايتنا فى الءافاق وفى أنفسهم حتى يتبين لهم أنه الحق أولم يكف بربك أنه على كل شىء شهيد

verse_text_english: Indeed, they are doubtful about meeting their Lord. He is fully aware of all things.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌۢ
verse_text_transliterated: alā innahum fī mir'yatin min liqāi rabbihim alā innahu bikulli shayin muḥīṭu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألا إنهم فى مرية من لقاء ربهم ألا إنه بكل شىء محيط

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: H.M.*
verse_text_arabic: حمٓ
verse_text_transliterated: hha-meem
verse_footnote_english: *42:1 These initials constitute a significant part of the Quran's miracle (Footnote 40:1).
verse_text_arabic_clean: حم

verse_text_english: A. S. Q.*
verse_text_arabic: عٓسٓقٓ
verse_text_transliterated: ain-seen-qaaf
verse_footnote_english: *42:2 This is the only sura where we see the initials 'A.S.Q. ('Ayn Seen Qaf), and the total occurrence of these three letters in this sura is 209, 19x11. Also, the letter "Q" occurs in this sura 57 times, 19x3. The only other sura where we see the initial "Q" is Sura 50, and this letter occurs in that sura also 57 times (See Appendix 1).
verse_text_arabic_clean: عسق

verse_text_english: Inspiring you, and those before you, is GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhālika yūḥī ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك يوحى إليك وإلى الذين من قبلك الله العزيز الحكيم

verse_text_english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and He is the Most High, the Great.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: له ما فى السموت وما فى الأرض وهو العلى العظيم

verse_text_english: The heavens above them almost shatter, out of reverence for Him, and the angels praise and glorify their Lord, and they ask forgiveness for those on earth. Absolutely, GOD is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wal-malāikatu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fī l-arḍi alā inna l-laha huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: تكاد السموت يتفطرن من فوقهن والملئكة يسبحون بحمد ربهم ويستغفرون لمن فى الأرض ألا إن الله هو الغفور الرحيم

verse_text_english: Those who set up other lords beside Him, GOD is the One in charge of them; you are not their advocate.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa l-lahu ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīli
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين اتخذوا من دونه أولياء الله حفيظ عليهم وما أنت عليهم بوكيل

verse_text_english: We thus reveal to you an Arabic Quran to warn the central community and all around it, and to warn about the Day of Summoning that is inevitable. Some will end up in Heaven, and some in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan litundhira umma l-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawma l-jamʿi lā rayba fīhi farīqun fī l-janati wafarīqun fī l-saʿīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذلك أوحينا إليك قرءانا عربيا لتنذر أم القرى ومن حولها وتنذر يوم الجمع لا ريب فيه فريق فى الجنة وفريق فى السعير

verse_text_english: Had GOD willed, He could have made them one community. But He redeems into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the transgressors, they have no master, nor a helper.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalahum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimūna mā lahum min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو شاء الله لجعلهم أمة وحدة ولكن يدخل من يشاء فى رحمته والظلمون ما لهم من ولى ولا نصير

verse_text_english: Did they find other lords beside Him? GOD is the only Lord and Master. He is the One who resurrects the dead, and He is the Omnipotent One.
verse_text_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa fal-lahu huwa l-waliyu wahuwa yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم اتخذوا من دونه أولياء فالله هو الولى وهو يحى الموتى وهو على كل شىء قدير

verse_text_english: If you dispute any part of this message, the judgment for doing this rests with GOD. Such is GOD my Lord. In Him I trust, and to Him I submit.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā ikh'talaftum fīhi min shayin faḥuk'muhu ilā l-lahi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbī ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unīb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما اختلفتم فيه من شىء فحكمه إلى الله ذلكم الله ربى عليه توكلت وإليه أنيب

verse_text_english: Initiator of the heavens and the earth. He created for you from among yourselves spouses—and also for the animals. He thus provides you with the means to multiply. There is nothing that equals Him. He is the Hearer, the Seer.
verse_text_arabic: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: fāṭiru l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wamina l-anʿāmi azwājan yadhra-ukum fīhi laysa kamith'lihi shayon wahuwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاطر السموت والأرض جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزوجا ومن الأنعم أزوجا يذرؤكم فيه ليس كمثله شىء وهو السميع البصير

verse_text_english: To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth. He is the One who increases the provision for whomever He wills, or reduces it. He is fully aware of all things.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: له مقاليد السموت والأرض يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر إنه بكل شىء عليم

verse_text_english: He decreed for you the same religion decreed for Noah, and what we inspired to you, and what we decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: "You shall uphold this one religion, and do not divide it."The idol worshipers will greatly resent what you invite them to do. GOD redeems to Himself whomever He wills; He guides to Himself only those who totally submit.
verse_text_arabic: شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
verse_text_transliterated: sharaʿa lakum mina l-dīni mā waṣṣā bihi nūḥan wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihi ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā an aqīmū l-dīna walā tatafarraqū fīhi kabura ʿalā l-mush'rikīna mā tadʿūhum ilayhi l-lahu yajtabī ilayhi man yashāu wayahdī ilayhi man yunīb
verse_subtitle_english: Only One Religion, Monotheists vs Idol Worshipers
verse_text_arabic_clean: شرع لكم من الدين ما وصى به نوحا والذى أوحينا إليك وما وصينا به إبرهيم وموسى وعيسى أن أقيموا الدين ولا تتفرقوا فيه كبر على المشركين ما تدعوهم إليه الله يجتبى إليه من يشاء ويهدى إليه من ينيب

verse_text_english: Ironically, they broke up into sects only after the knowledge had come to them, due to jealousy and resentment among themselves. If it were not for a predetermined decision from your Lord to respite them for a definite interim, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the later generations who inherited the scripture are full of doubts.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā tafarraqū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ilā ajalin musamman laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna alladhīna ūrithū l-kitāba min baʿdihim lafī shakkin min'hu murībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تفرقوا إلا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك إلى أجل مسمى لقضى بينهم وإن الذين أورثوا الكتب من بعدهم لفى شك منه مريب

verse_text_english: This is what you shall preach, and steadfastly maintain what you are commanded to do, and do not follow their wishes. And proclaim: "I believe in all the scriptures sent down by GOD. I was commanded to judge among you equitably. GOD is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no argument between us and you. GOD will gather us all together; to Him is the ultimate destiny."
verse_text_arabic: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٍ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: falidhālika fa-ud'ʿu wa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta walā tattabiʿ ahwāahum waqul āmantu bimā anzala l-lahu min kitābin wa-umir'tu li-aʿdila baynakumu l-lahu rabbunā warabbukum lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum lā ḥujjata baynanā wabaynakumu l-lahu yajmaʿu baynanā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīr
verse_subtitle_english: Message to the Christians and the Jews
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلذلك فادع واستقم كما أمرت ولا تتبع أهواءهم وقل ءامنت بما أنزل الله من كتب وأمرت لأعدل بينكم الله ربنا وربكم لنا أعملنا ولكم أعملكم لا حجة بيننا وبينكم الله يجمع بيننا وإليه المصير

verse_text_english: Those who argue about GOD, after receiving His message, their argument is nullified at their Lord. They have incurred condemnation, and have deserved a severe retribution.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna yuḥājjūna fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā us'tujība lahu ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabun walahum ʿadhābun shadīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين يحاجون فى الله من بعد ما استجيب له حجتهم داحضة عند ربهم وعليهم غضب ولهم عذاب شديد

verse_text_english: GOD is the One who sent down the scripture, to deliver the truth and the law. For all that you know, the Hour (Day of Judgment) may be very close.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu alladhī anzala l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi wal-mīzāna wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata qarību
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله الذى أنزل الكتب بالحق والميزان وما يدريك لعل الساعة قريب

verse_text_english: Challenging it are those who do not believe in it. As for those who believe, they are concerned about it, and they know that it is the truth. Absolutely, those who deny the Hour have gone far astray.
verse_text_arabic: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: yastaʿjilu bihā alladhīna lā yu'minūna bihā wa-alladhīna āmanū mush'fiqūna min'hā wayaʿlamūna annahā l-ḥaqu alā inna alladhīna yumārūna fī l-sāʿati lafī ḍalālin baʿīdi
verse_subtitle_english: The Believers Mindful of the Day of Judgment
verse_text_arabic_clean: يستعجل بها الذين لا يؤمنون بها والذين ءامنوا مشفقون منها ويعلمون أنها الحق ألا إن الذين يمارون فى الساعة لفى ضلل بعيد

verse_text_english: GOD is fully aware of all His creatures; He provides for whomever He wills. He is the Powerful, the Almighty.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu laṭīfun biʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashāu wahuwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīz
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله لطيف بعباده يرزق من يشاء وهو القوى العزيز

verse_text_english: Whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we multiply the rewards for him. And whoever seeks the materials of this world, we give him therefrom, then he receives no share in the Hereafter.
verse_text_arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: man kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-ākhirati nazid lahu fī ḥarthihi waman kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-dun'yā nu'tihi min'hā wamā lahu fī l-ākhirati min naṣībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: من كان يريد حرث الءاخرة نزد له فى حرثه ومن كان يريد حرث الدنيا نؤته منها وما له فى الءاخرة من نصيب

verse_text_english: They follow idols who decree for them religious laws never authorized by GOD. If it were not for the predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the transgressors have incurred a painful retribution.*
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum shurakāu sharaʿū lahum mina l-dīni mā lam yadhan bihi l-lahu walawlā kalimatu l-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verse_subtitle_english: The Idols: Innovating New Religious Laws*
verse_footnote_english: *42:21 The Islam of today's Muslim world has been so distorted, it has become a Satanic cult. The Ulama, or religious scholars, have added many extraneous laws, prohibitions, dress codes, dietary regulations, and religious practices never authorized by God. This is one of the main reasons for sending God's Messenger of the Covenant (9:31, 33:67, and Appendix 33).
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم شركؤا شرعوا لهم من الدين ما لم يأذن به الله ولولا كلمة الفصل لقضى بينهم وإن الظلمين لهم عذاب أليم

verse_text_english: You will see the transgressors worried about everything they had committed; everything will come back and haunt them. As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they will be in the gardens of Paradise. They will receive whatever they wish from their Lord. This is the great blessing.
verse_text_arabic: تَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: tarā l-ẓālimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā kasabū wahuwa wāqiʿun bihim wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī rawḍāti l-janāti lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ترى الظلمين مشفقين مما كسبوا وهو واقع بهم والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فى روضات الجنات لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ذلك هو الفضل الكبير

verse_text_english: This is the good news from GOD to His servants who believe and lead a righteous life. Say, "I do not ask you for any wage. I do ask each of you to take care of your own relatives." Anyone who does a righteous work, we multiply his reward for it. GOD is Forgiver, Appreciative.
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verse_text_transliterated: dhālika alladhī yubashiru l-lahu ʿibādahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti qul lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran illā l-mawadata fī l-qur'bā waman yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahu fīhā ḥus'nan inna l-laha ghafūrun shakūru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذلك الذى يبشر الله عباده الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت قل لا أسـٔلكم عليه أجرا إلا المودة فى القربى ومن يقترف حسنة نزد له فيها حسنا إن الله غفور شكور

verse_text_english: Are they saying, "He (Rashad)* has fabricated lies about GOD!"? If GOD willed, He could have sealed your mind, but GOD erases the falsehood and affirms the truth with His words. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: am yaqūlūna if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fa-in yasha-i l-lahu yakhtim ʿalā qalbika wayamḥu l-lahu l-bāṭila wayuḥiqqu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verse_subtitle_english: God Erases the Falsehood and Affirms the Truth*
verse_footnote_english: *42:24 The disbelievers added 2 false statements at the end of Sura 9 to commemorate their idol, the prophet Muhammad. God has revealed overwhelming evidence to erase this blasphemy and establish the truth. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the verse number (24), we get 1254, 19x66 (please see Appendices 2 & 24 for the details).
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يقولون افترى على الله كذبا فإن يشإ الله يختم على قلبك ويمح الله البطل ويحق الحق بكلمته إنه عليم بذات الصدور

verse_text_english: He is the One who accepts the repentance from His servants, and remits the sins. He is fully aware of everything you do.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yaqbalu l-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wayaʿfū ʿani l-sayiāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهو الذى يقبل التوبة عن عباده ويعفوا عن السيـٔات ويعلم ما تفعلون

verse_text_english: Responding to Him are those who believe and lead a righteous life. He will shower them with His blessings. As for the disbelievers, they have incurred a severe retribution.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wayastajību alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum min faḍlihi wal-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويستجيب الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت ويزيدهم من فضله والكفرون لهم عذاب شديد

verse_text_english: If GOD increased the provision for His servants, they would transgress on earth. This is why He sends it precisely measured to whomever He wills. He is fully Cognizant and Seer of His servants.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw basaṭa l-lahu l-riz'qa liʿibādihi labaghaw fī l-arḍi walākin yunazzilu biqadarin mā yashāu innahu biʿibādihi khabīrun baṣīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو بسط الله الرزق لعباده لبغوا فى الأرض ولكن ينزل بقدر ما يشاء إنه بعباده خبير بصير

verse_text_english: He is the One who sends down the rain after they had despaired, and spreads His mercy. He is the only Master, Most Praiseworthy.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verse_text_transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yunazzilu l-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭū wayanshuru raḥmatahu wahuwa l-waliyu l-ḥamīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهو الذى ينزل الغيث من بعد ما قنطوا وينشر رحمته وهو الولى الحميد

verse_text_english: Among His proofs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the creatures He spreads in them. He is able to summon them, when He wills.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā batha fīhimā min dābbatin wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim idhā yashāu qadīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن ءايته خلق السموت والأرض وما بث فيهما من دابة وهو على جمعهم إذا يشاء قدير

verse_text_english: Anything bad that happens to you is a consequence of your own deeds, and He overlooks many (of your sins).
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aydīkum wayaʿfū ʿan kathīri
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أصبكم من مصيبة فبما كسبت أيديكم ويعفوا عن كثير

verse_text_english: You can never escape, and you have none beside GOD as a Lord and Master.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أنتم بمعجزين فى الأرض وما لكم من دون الله من ولى ولا نصير

verse_text_english: Among His proofs are the ships that sail the sea with sails like flags.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin āyātihi l-jawāri fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlām
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن ءايته الجوار فى البحر كالأعلم

verse_text_english: If He willed, He could have stilled the winds, leaving them motionless on top of the water. These are proofs for those who are steadfast, appreciative.
verse_text_arabic: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: in yasha yus'kini l-rīḥa fayaẓlalna rawākida ʿalā ẓahrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن يشأ يسكن الريح فيظللن رواكد على ظهره إن فى ذلك لءايت لكل صبار شكور

verse_text_english: He can annihilate them, as a consequence of their own works. Instead, He overlooks many (of their sins).
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: aw yūbiq'hunna bimā kasabū wayaʿfu ʿan kathīri
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو يوبقهن بما كسبوا ويعف عن كثير

verse_text_english: Those who argue against our proofs will find out that they have no basis.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wayaʿlama alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātinā mā lahum min maḥīṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويعلم الذين يجدلون فى ءايتنا ما لهم من محيص

verse_text_english: Whatever you are given is no more than temporary material of this life. What GOD possesses is far better and everlasting, for those who believe and trust in their Lord.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā ūtītum min shayin famatāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamā ʿinda l-lahi khayrun wa-abqā lilladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما أوتيتم من شىء فمتع الحيوة الدنيا وما عند الله خير وأبقى للذين ءامنوا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون

verse_text_english: They avoid gross sins and vice, and when angered they forgive.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha wa-idhā mā ghaḍibū hum yaghfirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين يجتنبون كبئر الإثم والفوحش وإذا ما غضبوا هم يغفرون

verse_text_english: They respond to their Lord by observing the Contact Prayers (Salat). Their affairs are decided after due consultation among themselves, and from our provisions to them they give (to charity).
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna is'tajābū lirabbihim wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-amruhum shūrā baynahum wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين استجابوا لربهم وأقاموا الصلوة وأمرهم شورى بينهم ومما رزقنهم ينفقون

verse_text_english: When gross injustice befalls them, they stand up for their rights.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna idhā aṣābahumu l-baghyu hum yantaṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين إذا أصابهم البغى هم ينتصرون

verse_text_english: Although the just requital for an injustice is an equivalent retribution, those who pardon and maintain righteousness are rewarded by GOD. He does not love the unjust.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajazāu sayyi-atin sayyi-atun mith'luhā faman ʿafā wa-aṣlaḥa fa-ajruhu ʿalā l-lahi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجزؤا سيئة سيئة مثلها فمن عفا وأصلح فأجره على الله إنه لا يحب الظلمين

verse_text_english: Certainly, those who stand up for their rights, when injustice befalls them, are not committing any error.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walamani intaṣara baʿda ẓul'mihi fa-ulāika mā ʿalayhim min sabīli
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولمن انتصر بعد ظلمه فأولئك ما عليهم من سبيل

verse_text_english: The wrong ones are those who treat the people unjustly, and resort to aggression without provocation. These have incurred a painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: innamā l-sabīlu ʿalā alladhīna yaẓlimūna l-nāsa wayabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنما السبيل على الذين يظلمون الناس ويبغون فى الأرض بغير الحق أولئك لهم عذاب أليم

verse_text_english: Resorting to patience and forgiveness reflects a true strength of character.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaman ṣabara waghafara inna dhālika lamin ʿazmi l-umūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولمن صبر وغفر إن ذلك لمن عزم الأمور

verse_text_english: Whomever GOD sends astray will never find any other lord, and you will see such transgressors, when they see the retribution, saying, "Can we get another chance?"
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min waliyyin min baʿdihi watarā l-ẓālimīna lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddin min sabīli
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن يضلل الله فما له من ولى من بعده وترى الظلمين لما رأوا العذاب يقولون هل إلى مرد من سبيل

verse_text_english: You will see them facing it, humiliated and debased, and looking, yet trying to avoid looking. Those who believed will proclaim: "The real losers are those who lost their souls and their families on the Day of Resurrection. The transgressors have deserved an everlasting retribution."
verse_text_arabic: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: watarāhum yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna mina l-dhuli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyyin waqāla alladhīna āmanū inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā inna l-ẓālimīna fī ʿadhābin muqīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وترىهم يعرضون عليها خشعين من الذل ينظرون من طرف خفى وقال الذين ءامنوا إن الخسرين الذين خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيمة ألا إن الظلمين فى عذاب مقيم

verse_text_english: There will be no allies to help them against GOD. Whomever GOD sends astray can never be guided.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā kāna lahum min awliyāa yanṣurūnahum min dūni l-lahi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min sabīli
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما كان لهم من أولياء ينصرونهم من دون الله ومن يضلل الله فما له من سبيل

verse_text_english: You shall respond to your Lord before a day comes which is decreed inevitable by GOD. There will be no refuge for you on that day, nor an advocate.
verse_text_arabic: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: is'tajībū lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi mā lakum min malja-in yawma-idhin wamā lakum min nakīri
verse_text_arabic_clean: استجيبوا لربكم من قبل أن يأتى يوم لا مرد له من الله ما لكم من ملجإ يومئذ وما لكم من نكير

verse_text_english: If they turn away, we did not send you as their guardian. Your sole mission is delivering the message. When we shower the human beings with mercy, they become proud, and when adversity afflicts them, as a consequence of their own deeds, the human beings turn into disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-in aʿraḍū famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan in ʿalayka illā l-balāghu wa-innā idhā adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim fa-inna l-insāna kafūru
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإن أعرضوا فما أرسلنك عليهم حفيظا إن عليك إلا البلغ وإنا إذا أذقنا الإنسن منا رحمة فرح بها وإن تصبهم سيئة بما قدمت أيديهم فإن الإنسن كفور

verse_text_english: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills, granting daughters to whomever He wills, and granting sons to whomever He wills.
verse_text_arabic: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
verse_text_transliterated: lillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yakhluqu mā yashāu yahabu liman yashāu ināthan wayahabu liman yashāu l-dhukūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: لله ملك السموت والأرض يخلق ما يشاء يهب لمن يشاء إنثا ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور

verse_text_english: Or, He may have the males and the females marry each other, then render whomever He wills sterile. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَٰثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: aw yuzawwijuhum dhuk'rānan wa-ināthan wayajʿalu man yashāu ʿaqīman innahu ʿalīmun qadīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو يزوجهم ذكرانا وإنثا ويجعل من يشاء عقيما إنه عليم قدير

verse_text_english: No human being can communicate with GOD except through inspiration, or from behind a barrier, or by sending a messenger through whom He reveals what He wills. He is the Most High, Most Wise.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā kāna libasharin an yukallimahu l-lahu illā waḥyan aw min warāi ḥijābin aw yur'sila rasūlan fayūḥiya bi-idh'nihi mā yashāu innahu ʿaliyyun ḥakīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما كان لبشر أن يكلمه الله إلا وحيا أو من ورائ حجاب أو يرسل رسولا فيوحى بإذنه ما يشاء إنه على حكيم

verse_text_english: Thus, we inspired to you a revelation proclaiming our commandments. You had no idea about the scripture, or faith. Yet, we made this a beacon to guide whomever we choose from among our servants. Surely, you guide in a straight path.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka rūḥan min amrinā mā kunta tadrī mā l-kitābu walā l-īmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nahdī bihi man nashāu min ʿibādinā wa-innaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذلك أوحينا إليك روحا من أمرنا ما كنت تدرى ما الكتب ولا الإيمن ولكن جعلنه نورا نهدى به من نشاء من عبادنا وإنك لتهدى إلى صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: The path of GOD, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Absolutely, all matters are controlled by GOD.
verse_text_arabic: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verse_text_transliterated: ṣirāṭi l-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi alā ilā l-lahi taṣīru l-umūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: صرط الله الذى له ما فى السموت وما فى الأرض ألا إلى الله تصير الأمور

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: H. M.*
verse_text_arabic: حمٓ
verse_text_transliterated: hha-meem
verse_footnote_english: *43:1 See Footnote 40:1. The frequency of occurrence of the letters "H" (Hã) and "M" (Mîm) in the seven H.M.-initialed suras is 292, and 1855, respectively. This adds up to 2147, or 19x113.
verse_text_arabic_clean: حم

verse_text_english: And the enlightening scripture.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-kitābi l-mubīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والكتب المبين

verse_text_english: We have rendered it an Arabic Quran, that you may understand.*
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūn
verse_footnote_english: *43:3 Arabic is the most efficient language, especially in expressing commandments, statutes and exacting laws. Hence the revelation of the Quran in Arabic for the clear understanding of all peoples, regardless of their tongues. See Appendix 4 for the details.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا جعلنه قرءنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون

verse_text_english: It is preserved with us in the original master, honorable and full of wisdom.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu fī ummi l-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه فى أم الكتب لدينا لعلى حكيم

verse_text_english: Should we just ignore the fact that you have transgressed the limits?*
verse_text_arabic: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: afanaḍribu ʿankumu l-dhik'ra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawman mus'rifīn
verse_footnote_english: *43:5 This refers to our original sin as detailed in the Introduction and Appendix 7.
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفنضرب عنكم الذكر صفحا أن كنتم قوما مسرفين

verse_text_english: We have sent many a prophet to the previous generations.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wakam arsalnā min nabiyyin fī l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكم أرسلنا من نبى فى الأولين

verse_text_english: Every time a prophet went to them, they ridiculed him.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yatīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يأتيهم من نبى إلا كانوا به يستهزءون

verse_text_english: Consequently, we annihilated people who were even more powerful than these. We thus set the examples from the previous communities.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ahlaknā ashadda min'hum baṭshan wamaḍā mathalu l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأهلكنا أشد منهم بطشا ومضى مثل الأولين

verse_text_english: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth," they would say, "The Almighty, the Omniscient has created them."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولئن سألتهم من خلق السموت والأرض ليقولن خلقهن العزيز العليم

verse_text_english: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and created for you roads therein, that you may follow the right way.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulan laʿallakum tahtadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى جعل لكم الأرض مهدا وجعل لكم فيها سبلا لعلكم تهتدون

verse_text_english: He is the One who sends down from the sky water, in exact measure, to revive dead lands therewith. Similarly, you will be resurrected.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhī nazzala mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika tukh'rajūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذى نزل من السماء ماء بقدر فأنشرنا به بلدة ميتا كذلك تخرجون

verse_text_english: He is the One who created all kinds, in pairs (male and female), and He created for you ships and livestock to ride.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mina l-ful'ki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذى خلق الأزوج كلها وجعل لكم من الفلك والأنعم ما تركبون

verse_text_english: As you rest on top of them, you shall appreciate such a blessing from your Lord, and say, "Glory be to the One who subdued this for us. We could not have controlled them by ourselves.
verse_text_arabic: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurū niʿ'mata rabbikum idhā is'tawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū sub'ḥāna alladhī sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muq'rinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لتستوا على ظهوره ثم تذكروا نعمة ربكم إذا استويتم عليه وتقولوا سبحن الذى سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين

verse_text_english: "We ultimately return to our Lord."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنا إلى ربنا لمنقلبون

verse_text_english: They even assigned for Him a share from His own creation! Surely, the human being is profoundly unappreciative.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalū lahu min ʿibādihi juz'an inna l-insāna lakafūrun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلوا له من عباده جزءا إن الإنسن لكفور مبين

verse_text_english: Has He chosen from among His creations daughters for Himself, while blessing you with sons?
verse_text_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: ami ittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātin wa-aṣfākum bil-banīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم اتخذ مما يخلق بنات وأصفىكم بالبنين

verse_text_english: When one of them is given news (of a daughter) as they claimed for the Most Gracious, his face is darkened with misery and anger!
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا بشر أحدهم بما ضرب للرحمن مثلا ظل وجهه مسودا وهو كظيم

verse_text_english: (They say,) "What is good about an offspring that is brought up to be beautiful, and cannot help in war?"
verse_text_arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: awaman yunasha-u fī l-ḥil'yati wahuwa fī l-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: أومن ينشؤا فى الحلية وهو فى الخصام غير مبين

verse_text_english: They claimed that the angels, who are servants of the Most Gracious, are females! Have they witnessed their creation? Their claims are recorded, and they will be asked.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalū l-malāikata alladhīna hum ʿibādu l-raḥmāni ināthan ashahidū khalqahum satuk'tabu shahādatuhum wayus'alūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلوا الملئكة الذين هم عبد الرحمن إنثا أشهدوا خلقهم ستكتب شهدتهم ويسـٔلون

verse_text_english: They even said, "If the Most Gracious willed, we would not have worshiped them." They have no basis for such a claim; they only conjecture.*
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū law shāa l-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum mā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yakhruṣūn
verse_footnote_english: *43:20 The idol worshipers cannot blame God for their idolatry, since we have absolute freedom of choice to worship God alone, or not.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا لو شاء الرحمن ما عبدنهم ما لهم بذلك من علم إن هم إلا يخرصون

verse_text_english: Have we given them a book before this, and they are upholding it?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am ātaynāhum kitāban min qablihi fahum bihi mus'tamsikūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم ءاتينهم كتبا من قبله فهم به مستمسكون

verse_text_english: The fact is: they said, "We found our parents carrying on certain practices, and we are following in their footsteps."
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muh'tadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل قالوا إنا وجدنا ءاباءنا على أمة وإنا على ءاثرهم مهتدون

verse_text_english: Invariably, when we sent a warner to any community, the leaders of that community would say, "We found our parents following certain practices, and we will continue in their footsteps."
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muq'tadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذلك ما أرسلنا من قبلك فى قرية من نذير إلا قال مترفوها إنا وجدنا ءاباءنا على أمة وإنا على ءاثرهم مقتدون

verse_text_english: (The messenger) would say, "What if I brought to you better guidance than what you inherited from your parents?" They would say, "We are disbelievers in the message you brought."
verse_text_arabic: قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāakum qālū innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أولو جئتكم بأهدى مما وجدتم عليه ءاباءكم قالوا إنا بما أرسلتم به كفرون

verse_text_english: Consequently, we requited them. Note the consequences for the rejectors.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فانتقمنا منهم فانظر كيف كان عقبة المكذبين

verse_text_english: Abraham said to his father and his people, "I disown what you worship.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi waqawmihi innanī barāon mimmā taʿbudūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذ قال إبرهيم لأبيه وقومه إننى براء مما تعبدون

verse_text_english: "Only the One who initiated me can guide me."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: illā alladhī faṭaranī fa-innahu sayahdīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا الذى فطرنى فإنه سيهدين

verse_text_english: This example (of Abraham) was rendered an everlasting lesson for subsequent generations; perhaps they redeem their souls.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalahā kalimatan bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلها كلمة باقية فى عقبه لعلهم يرجعون

verse_text_english: Indeed, I have given these people and their ancestors sufficient chances, then the truth came to them, and a clarifying messenger.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: bal mattaʿtu hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā jāahumu l-ḥaqu warasūlun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل متعت هؤلاء وءاباءهم حتى جاءهم الحق ورسول مبين

verse_text_english: When the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and we are disbelievers therein."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu qālū hādhā siḥ'run wa-innā bihi kāfirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولما جاءهم الحق قالوا هذا سحر وإنا به كفرون

verse_text_english: They said, "If only this Quran was sent down through another man from the two communities (Mecca or Yathrib) who is prominent!"
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhā l-qur'ānu ʿalā rajulin mina l-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا لولا نزل هذا القرءان على رجل من القريتين عظيم

verse_text_english: Are they the ones who assign your Lord's mercy? We have assigned their shares in this life, raising some of them above others in ranks, in order to let them serve one another. The mercy from your Lord is far better than any material they may hoard.
verse_text_arabic: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukh'riyyan waraḥmatu rabbika khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أهم يقسمون رحمت ربك نحن قسمنا بينهم معيشتهم فى الحيوة الدنيا ورفعنا بعضهم فوق بعض درجت ليتخذ بعضهم بعضا سخريا ورحمت ربك خير مما يجمعون

verse_text_english: If it were not that all the people might become one (disbelieving) congregation, we would have granted everyone who disbelieves in the Most Gracious mansions with silver roofs, and stairs upon which they could climb.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walawlā an yakūna l-nāsu ummatan wāḥidatan lajaʿalnā liman yakfuru bil-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufan min fiḍḍatin wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūn
verse_subtitle_english: Materials of This World: All That The Disbelievers Get
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولولا أن يكون الناس أمة وحدة لجعلنا لمن يكفر بالرحمن لبيوتهم سقفا من فضة ومعارج عليها يظهرون

verse_text_english: Their mansions would have impressive gates, and luxurious furnishings.
verse_text_arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walibuyūtihim abwāban wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولبيوتهم أبوبا وسررا عليها يتكـٔون

verse_text_english: Also many ornaments. All these are the temporary materials of this lowly life. The Hereafter—at your Lord—is far better for the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَزُخْرُفًا وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wazukh'rufan wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil'muttaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وزخرفا وإن كل ذلك لما متع الحيوة الدنيا والءاخرة عند ربك للمتقين

verse_text_english: Anyone who disregards the message of the Most Gracious, we appoint a devil to be his constant companion.*
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waman yaʿshu ʿan dhik'ri l-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnu
verse_footnote_english: *43:36-39 Each one of us has a representative of Satan as a constant companion (App. 7).
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن يعش عن ذكر الرحمن نقيض له شيطنا فهو له قرين

verse_text_english: Such companions will divert them from the path, yet make them believe that they are guided.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani l-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنهم ليصدونهم عن السبيل ويحسبون أنهم مهتدون

verse_text_english: When he comes before us he will say, "Oh I wish you were as far from me as the two easts.* What a miserable companion!"
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā idhā jāanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿ'da l-mashriqayni fabi'sa l-qarīn
verse_footnote_english: *43:38 The "easts" imply the locations of sunrise, moonrise, and the rising of heavenly bodies.
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى إذا جاءنا قال يليت بينى وبينك بعد المشرقين فبئس القرين

verse_text_english: It will not console you on that day, as transgressors, that both of you will share in the retribution.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walan yanfaʿakumu l-yawma idh ẓalamtum annakum fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولن ينفعكم اليوم إذ ظلمتم أنكم فى العذاب مشتركون

verse_text_english: Can you make the deaf hear; can you make the blind see, or those who are far astray?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma aw tahdī l-ʿum'ya waman kāna fī ḍalālin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفأنت تسمع الصم أو تهدى العمى ومن كان فى ضلل مبين

verse_text_english: Whether we let you die before it or not, we will surely requite them.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā min'hum muntaqimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإما نذهبن بك فإنا منهم منتقمون

verse_text_english: Or, we may show you (the retribution) we promised for them. We are in full control over them.
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: aw nuriyannaka alladhī waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim muq'tadirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو نرينك الذى وعدنهم فإنا عليهم مقتدرون

verse_text_english: You shall steadfastly preach what is revealed to you; you are in the right path.*
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-is'tamsik bi-alladhī ūḥiya ilayka innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verse_footnote_english: *43:43 The sum of the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230) plus 43 is 1273, 19x67.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاستمسك بالذى أوحى إليك إنك على صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: This is a message for you and your people; all of you will be questioned.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu ladhik'run laka waliqawmika wasawfa tus'alūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه لذكر لك ولقومك وسوف تسـٔلون

verse_text_english: Check the messengers we sent before you: "Have we ever appointed any other gods—beside the Most Gracious—to be worshiped?"
verse_text_arabic: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wasal man arsalnā min qablika min rusulinā ajaʿalnā min dūni l-raḥmāni ālihatan yuʿ'badūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وسـٔل من أرسلنا من قبلك من رسلنا أجعلنا من دون الرحمن ءالهة يعبدون

verse_text_english: For example, we sent Moses with our proofs to Pharaoh and his elders, proclaiming: "I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faqāla innī rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أرسلنا موسى بـٔايتنا إلى فرعون وملإيه فقال إنى رسول رب العلمين

verse_text_english: When he showed them our proofs, they laughed at them.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā jāahum biāyātinā idhā hum min'hā yaḍḥakūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما جاءهم بـٔايتنا إذا هم منها يضحكون

verse_text_english: Every sign we showed them was bigger than the one before it. We afflicted them with the plagues, perhaps they repent.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukh'tihā wa-akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما نريهم من ءاية إلا هى أكبر من أختها وأخذنهم بالعذاب لعلهم يرجعون

verse_text_english: They said, "O you magician, implore your Lord on our behalf, since you have an agreement with Him (to relieve this plague); we will then be guided."
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū yāayyuha l-sāḥiru ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka innanā lamuh'tadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا يأيه الساحر ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك إننا لمهتدون

verse_text_english: But as soon as we relieved their affliction, they reverted.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما كشفنا عنهم العذاب إذا هم ينكثون

verse_text_english: Pharaoh announced to his people, "O my people, do I not possess the kingship over Egypt, and these flowing rivers belong to me? Do you not see?
verse_text_arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wanādā fir'ʿawnu fī qawmihi qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mul'ku miṣ'ra wahādhihi l-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī afalā tub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونادى فرعون فى قومه قال يقوم أليس لى ملك مصر وهذه الأنهر تجرى من تحتى أفلا تبصرون

verse_text_english: "Which one is better; me or that one who is lowly and can hardly speak?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: am anā khayrun min hādhā alladhī huwa mahīnun walā yakādu yubīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم أنا خير من هذا الذى هو مهين ولا يكاد يبين

verse_text_english: "How come he does not possess a treasure of gold; how come the angels do not accompany him?"
verse_text_arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falawlā ul'qiya ʿalayhi aswiratun min dhahabin aw jāa maʿahu l-malāikatu muq'tarinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلولا ألقى عليه أسورة من ذهب أو جاء معه الملئكة مقترنين

verse_text_english: He thus fooled his people, and they obeyed him; they were wicked people.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-is'takhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاستخف قومه فأطاعوه إنهم كانوا قوما فسقين

verse_text_english: When they persisted in opposing us, we punished them and drowned them all.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā āsafūnā intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما ءاسفونا انتقمنا منهم فأغرقنهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: We rendered them a precedent and an example for the others.
verse_text_arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْءَاخِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fajaʿalnāhum salafan wamathalan lil'ākhirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فجعلنهم سلفا ومثلا للءاخرين

verse_text_english: When the son of Mary was cited as an example, your people disregarded it.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walammā ḍuriba ub'nu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka min'hu yaṣiddūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولما ضرب ابن مريم مثلا إذا قومك منه يصدون

verse_text_english: They said, "Is it better to worship our gods, or to worship him?" They said this only to argue with you. Indeed, they are people who have joined the opposition.
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū aālihatunā khayrun am huwa mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalan bal hum qawmun khaṣimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا ءألهتنا خير أم هو ما ضربوه لك إلا جدلا بل هم قوم خصمون

verse_text_english: He was no more than a servant whom we blessed, and we sent him as an example for the Children of Israel.
verse_text_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse_text_transliterated: in huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalan libanī is'rāīl
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هو إلا عبد أنعمنا عليه وجعلنه مثلا لبنى إسرءيل

verse_text_english: If we willed, we could have made you angels who colonize and reproduce on earth.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw nashāu lajaʿalnā minkum malāikatan fī l-arḍi yakhlufūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو نشاء لجعلنا منكم ملئكة فى الأرض يخلفون

verse_text_english: He is to serve as a marker for knowing the end of the world,* so you can no longer harbor any doubt about it. You shall follow Me; this is the right path.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu laʿil'mun lilssāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wa-ittabiʿūni hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmu
verse_subtitle_english: Jesus and the End of the World*
verse_footnote_english: *43:61 As detailed in Appendix 25, the End of the World is given in the Quran, and the birth date of Jesus provided one of the significant signs that the calculations are correct. We learn that the world will end in the year 2280 (19x120) after the birth of Jesus (see 47:18). Additionally, both the lunar year (1710) & the solar year (2280) are divisible by 570 (19x30), the number of years from the birth of Jesus to the birth of Muhammad. Thus, the birth date of Jesus is a marker.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه لعلم للساعة فلا تمترن بها واتبعون هذا صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: Let not the devil repel you; he is your most ardent enemy.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: walā yaṣuddannakumu l-shayṭānu innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا يصدنكم الشيطن إنه لكم عدو مبين

verse_text_english: When Jesus went with the proofs, he said, "I bring to you wisdom, and to clarify some of the matters in which you dispute. You shall reverence GOD and obey me.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: walammā jāa ʿīsā bil-bayināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥik'mati wali-ubayyina lakum baʿḍa alladhī takhtalifūna fīhi fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولما جاء عيسى بالبينت قال قد جئتكم بالحكمة ولأبين لكم بعض الذى تختلفون فيه فاتقوا الله وأطيعون

verse_text_english: "GOD is my Lord and your Lord, you shall worship Him alone. This is the right path."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-laha huwa rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الله هو ربى وربكم فاعبدوه هذا صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: The opponents disputed among themselves. Woe to those who transgress from the retribution of a painful day.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاختلف الأحزاب من بينهم فويل للذين ظلموا من عذاب يوم أليم

verse_text_english: Are they waiting for the Hour (Day of Judgment) to come to them suddenly when they least expect it?
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: hal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل ينظرون إلا الساعة أن تأتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون

verse_text_english: The close friends on that day will become enemies of one another, except for the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: al-akhilāu yawma-idhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illā l-mutaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الأخلاء يومئذ بعضهم لبعض عدو إلا المتقين

verse_text_english: O My servants, you will have no fear on that day, nor will you grieve.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu l-yawma walā antum taḥzanūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يعباد لا خوف عليكم اليوم ولا أنتم تحزنون

verse_text_english: They are the ones who believed in our revelations, and were submitters.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna āmanū biāyātinā wakānū mus'limīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين ءامنوا بـٔايتنا وكانوا مسلمين

verse_text_english: Enter Paradise, together with your spouses, and rejoice.
verse_text_arabic: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ud'khulū l-janata antum wa-azwājukum tuḥ'barūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ادخلوا الجنة أنتم وأزوجكم تحبرون

verse_text_english: Offered to them will be golden trays and cups, and they will find everything the hearts desire and the eyes wish for. You live therein forever.
verse_text_arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfin min dhahabin wa-akwābin wafīhā mā tashtahīhi l-anfusu wataladhu l-aʿyunu wa-antum fīhā khālidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يطاف عليهم بصحاف من ذهب وأكواب وفيها ما تشتهيه الأنفس وتلذ الأعين وأنتم فيها خلدون

verse_text_english: Such is the Paradise that you inherit, in return for your works.
verse_text_arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: watil'ka l-janatu allatī ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتلك الجنة التى أورثتموها بما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: You will have in it all kinds of fruits, from which you eat.
verse_text_arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratun min'hā takulūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لكم فيها فكهة كثيرة منها تأكلون

verse_text_english: Surely, the guilty will abide in the retribution of Gehenna forever.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-muj'rimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المجرمين فى عذاب جهنم خلدون
