verse_text_english: Published in books.
verse_text_arabic: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fī raqqin manshūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى رق منشور

verse_text_english: The frequented Shrine.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-bayti l-maʿmūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: والبيت المعمور

verse_text_english: The exalted ceiling.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-saqfi l-marfūʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسقف المرفوع

verse_text_english: The sea that is set aflame.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-baḥri l-masjūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: والبحر المسجور

verse_text_english: Your Lord's requital is unavoidable.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن عذاب ربك لوقع

verse_text_english: No force in the universe can stop it.
verse_text_arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
verse_text_transliterated: mā lahu min dāfiʿi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما له من دافع

verse_text_english: The day will come when the sky will violently thunder.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma tamūru l-samāu mawra
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم تمور السماء مورا

verse_text_english: The mountains will be wiped out.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: watasīru l-jibālu sayra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتسير الجبال سيرا

verse_text_english: Woe on that day to the disbelievers—
verse_text_arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fawaylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: who are in their blundering, heedless.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna hum fī khawḍin yalʿabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين هم فى خوض يلعبون

verse_text_english: They will be herded into Gehenna, forcibly.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يدعون إلى نار جهنم دعا

verse_text_english: This is the Fire in which you used to disbelieve.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhihi l-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذه النار التى كنتم بها تكذبون

verse_text_english: Is this magic, or do you not see?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفسحر هذا أم أنتم لا تبصرون

verse_text_english: Suffer the burning. Whether you are patient or impatient, it will be the same for you. This is the just requital for what you did.
verse_text_arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: اصلوها فاصبروا أو لا تصبروا سواء عليكم إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: The righteous have deserved gardens and bliss.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaʿīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المتقين فى جنت ونعيم

verse_text_english: They enjoy what their Lord has reserved for them; their Lord has spared them the retribution of Hell.
verse_text_arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكهين بما ءاتىهم ربهم ووقىهم ربهم عذاب الجحيم

verse_text_english: Eat and drink happily, in return for your works.
verse_text_arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلوا واشربوا هنيـٔا بما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: They relax on luxurious furnishings, and we match them with beautiful spouses.
verse_text_arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: muttakiīna ʿalā sururin maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: متكـٔين على سرر مصفوفة وزوجنهم بحور عين

verse_text_english: For those who believed, and their children also followed them in belief, we will have their children join them. We never fail to reward them for any work. Every person is paid for what he did.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين ءامنوا واتبعتهم ذريتهم بإيمن ألحقنا بهم ذريتهم وما ألتنهم من عملهم من شىء كل امرئ بما كسب رهين

verse_text_english: We will supply them with fruits and meats that they love.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatin walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأمددنهم بفكهة ولحم مما يشتهون

verse_text_english: They will enjoy drinks that are never polluted, and never sinful to drink.
verse_text_arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasan lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: يتنزعون فيها كأسا لا لغو فيها ولا تأثيم

verse_text_english: Serving them will be servants like protected pearls.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānun lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-on maknūnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويطوف عليهم غلمان لهم كأنهم لؤلؤ مكنون

verse_text_english: They will meet each other and reminisce among themselves.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون

verse_text_english: They will say, "We used to be kind and humble among our people.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا إنا كنا قبل فى أهلنا مشفقين

verse_text_english: "GOD has blessed us, and has spared us the agony of ill winds.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba l-samūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن الله علينا ووقىنا عذاب السموم

verse_text_english: "We used to implore Him; He is the Most Kind, Most Merciful."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كنا من قبل ندعوه إنه هو البر الرحيم

verse_text_english: You shall remind the people. With your Lord's blessings upon you, you are neither a soothsayer, nor crazy.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذكر فما أنت بنعمت ربك بكاهن ولا مجنون

verse_text_english: They may say, "He is a poet; let us just wait until he is dead."
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يقولون شاعر نتربص به ريب المنون

verse_text_english: Say, "Go on waiting; I will wait along with you."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل تربصوا فإنى معكم من المتربصين

verse_text_english: Is it their dreams that dictate their behavior, or are they naturally wicked?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم تأمرهم أحلمهم بهذا أم هم قوم طاغون

verse_text_english: Do they say, "He made it all up?" Instead, they are simply disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يقولون تقوله بل لا يؤمنون

verse_text_english: Let them produce a Hadith like this, if they are truthful.
verse_text_arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falyatū biḥadīthin mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فليأتوا بحديث مثله إن كانوا صدقين

verse_text_english: Were they created from nothing? Are they the creators?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم خلقوا من غير شىء أم هم الخلقون

verse_text_english: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Indeed, they have no certainty.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am khalaqū l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم خلقوا السموت والأرض بل لا يوقنون

verse_text_english: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord? Are they in control?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم عندهم خزائن ربك أم هم المصيطرون

verse_text_english: Do they climb a ladder that enables them to listen? Let their listeners show their proof.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم سلم يستمعون فيه فليأت مستمعهم بسلطن مبين

verse_text_english: Does He have daughters, while you have sons?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم له البنت ولكم البنون

verse_text_english: Are you asking them for any wage, and they are burdened thereby?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم تسـٔلهم أجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون

verse_text_english: Do they know the future, and have it recorded?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون

verse_text_english: Are they plotting and scheming? The disbelievers' schemes backfire against them.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يريدون كيدا فالذين كفروا هم المكيدون

verse_text_english: Do they have another god besides GOD? GOD be glorified, far above having partners.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم إله غير الله سبحن الله عما يشركون

verse_text_english: When they see masses falling from the sky, they will say, "Piled clouds!"
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in yaraw kis'fan mina l-samāi sāqiṭan yaqūlū saḥābun markūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن يروا كسفا من السماء ساقطا يقولوا سحاب مركوم

verse_text_english: Disregard them until they meet the day in which they are struck.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذرهم حتى يلقوا يومهم الذى فيه يصعقون

verse_text_english: On that day, their schemes will not protect them, nor will they be helped.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayan walā hum yunṣarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم لا يغنى عنهم كيدهم شيـٔا ولا هم ينصرون

verse_text_english: Those who transgress suffer retribution here, but most of them do not know.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن للذين ظلموا عذابا دون ذلك ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون

verse_text_english: You shall steadfastly persevere in carrying out your Lord's command—you are in our eyes—and glorify and praise your Lord when you get up.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: واصبر لحكم ربك فإنك بأعيننا وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم

verse_text_english: Also during the night glorify Him, and at dawn as the stars fade away.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن اليل فسبحه وإدبر النجوم

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: As the stars fell away.*
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-najmi idhā haw
verse_footnote_english: *53:1-18 Muhammad was summoned to the highest universe to receive this Quran into his heart. The stars fell away as he traveled through them at millions of times the speed of light. Subsequently, the Quran was gradually released to his memory. App. 28.
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنجم إذا هوى

verse_text_english: Your friend (Muhammad) was not astray, nor was he deceived.
verse_text_arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: mā ḍalla ṣāḥibukum wamā ghaw
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوى

verse_text_english: Nor was he speaking out of a personal desire.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yanṭiqu ʿani l-haw
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما ينطق عن الهوى

verse_text_english: It was divine inspiration.
verse_text_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: in huwa illā waḥyun yūḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هو إلا وحى يوحى

verse_text_english: Dictated by the Most Powerful.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: ilmahu sheedun alqawi
verse_text_arabic_clean: علمه شديد القوى

verse_text_english: Possessor of all authority. From His highest height.
verse_text_arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: dhū mirratin fa-is'taw
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذو مرة فاستوى

verse_text_english: At the highest horizon.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wahuwa bil-ufuqi l-aʿl
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهو بالأفق الأعلى

verse_text_english: He drew nearer by moving down.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma danā fatadall
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم دنا فتدلى

verse_text_english: Until He became as close as possible.
verse_text_arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fakāna qāba qawsayni aw adn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكان قاب قوسين أو أدنى

verse_text_english: He then revealed to His servant what was to be revealed.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-awḥā ilā ʿabdihi mā awḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأوحى إلى عبده ما أوحى

verse_text_english: The mind never made up what it saw.
verse_text_arabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: mā kadhaba l-fuādu mā ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما كذب الفؤاد ما رأى

verse_text_english: Are you doubting what he saw?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: afatumārūnahu ʿalā mā yar
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفتمرونه على ما يرى

verse_text_english: He saw him in another descent.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad raāhu nazlatan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد رءاه نزلة أخرى

verse_text_english: At the ultimate point.
verse_text_arabic: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: enda widratin almutenaaha
verse_text_arabic_clean: عند سدرة المنتهى

verse_text_english: Where the eternal Paradise is located.
verse_text_arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: endahaa jannatun almaawa
verse_text_arabic_clean: عندها جنة المأوى

verse_text_english: The whole place was overwhelmed.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh yaghshā l-sid'rata mā yaghsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ يغشى السدرة ما يغشى

verse_text_english: The eyes did not waver, nor go blind.
verse_text_arabic: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: mā zāgha l-baṣaru wamā ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما زاغ البصر وما طغى

verse_text_english: He saw great signs of his Lord.
verse_text_arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: laqad raā min āyāti rabbihi l-kub'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد رأى من ءايت ربه الكبرى

verse_text_english: Compare this with the female idols Allaat and Al-'Uzzah.
verse_text_arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: afara-aytumu l-lāta wal-ʿuz
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفرءيتم اللت والعزى

verse_text_english: And Manaat, the third one.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wamanata l-thālithata l-ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومنوة الثالثة الأخرى

verse_text_english: Do you have sons, while He has these as daughters?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alakumu l-dhakaru walahu l-unth
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألكم الذكر وله الأنثى

verse_text_english: What a disgraceful distribution!
verse_text_arabic: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: til'ka idhan qis'matun ḍīz
verse_text_arabic_clean: تلك إذا قسمة ضيزى

verse_text_english: These are but names that you made up, you and your forefathers. GOD never authorized such a blasphemy. They follow conjecture, and personal desire, when the true guidance has come to them herein from their Lord.
verse_text_arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: in hiya illā asmāon sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā anzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wamā tahwā l-anfusu walaqad jāahum min rabbihimu l-hud
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هى إلا أسماء سميتموها أنتم وءاباؤكم ما أنزل الله بها من سلطن إن يتبعون إلا الظن وما تهوى الأنفس ولقد جاءهم من ربهم الهدى

verse_text_english: What is it that the human being desires?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: am lil'insāni mā tamann
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم للإنسن ما تمنى

verse_text_english: To GOD belongs both the Hereafter, and this world.
verse_text_arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: falillahi l-ākhiratu wal-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلله الءاخرة والأولى

verse_text_english: Not even the angels in heaven possess authority to intercede. The only ones permitted by GOD are those who act in accordance with His will and His approval.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wakam min malakin fī l-samāwāti lā tugh'nī shafāʿatuhum shayan illā min baʿdi an yadhana l-lahu liman yashāu wayarḍ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكم من ملك فى السموت لا تغنى شفعتهم شيـٔا إلا من بعد أن يأذن الله لمن يشاء ويرضى

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieve in the Hereafter have given the angels feminine names.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati layusammūna l-malāikata tasmiyata l-unth
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين لا يؤمنون بالءاخرة ليسمون الملئكة تسمية الأنثى

verse_text_english: They had no knowledge about this; they only conjectured. Conjecture is no substitute for the truth.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
verse_text_transliterated: wamā lahum bihi min ʿil'min in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shaya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما لهم به من علم إن يتبعون إلا الظن وإن الظن لا يغنى من الحق شيـٔا

verse_text_english: You shall disregard those who turn away from our message, and become preoccupied with this worldly life.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aʿriḍ ʿan man tawallā ʿan dhik'rinā walam yurid illā l-ḥayata l-dun'y
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأعرض عن من تولى عن ذكرنا ولم يرد إلا الحيوة الدنيا

verse_text_english: This is the extent of their knowledge. Your Lord is fully aware of those who strayed away from His path, and He is fully aware of those who are guided.
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: dhālika mablaghuhum mina l-ʿil'mi inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bimani ih'tad
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذلك مبلغهم من العلم إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو أعلم بمن اهتدى

verse_text_english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. He will requite those who commit evil for their works, and will reward the righteous for their righteousness.
verse_text_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
verse_text_transliterated: walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi liyajziya alladhīna asāū bimā ʿamilū wayajziya alladhīna aḥsanū bil-ḥus'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولله ما فى السموت وما فى الأرض ليجزى الذين أسـٔوا بما عملوا ويجزى الذين أحسنوا بالحسنى

verse_text_english: They avoid gross sins and transgressions, except for minor offenses. Your Lord's forgiveness is immense. He has been fully aware of you since He initiated you from the earth, and while you were embryos in your mothers' bellies. Therefore, do not exalt yourselves; He is fully aware of the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha illā l-lamama inna rabbaka wāsiʿu l-maghfirati huwa aʿlamu bikum idh ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-idh antum ajinnatun fī buṭūni ummahātikum falā tuzakkū anfusakum huwa aʿlamu bimani ittaq
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين يجتنبون كبئر الإثم والفوحش إلا اللمم إن ربك وسع المغفرة هو أعلم بكم إذ أنشأكم من الأرض وإذ أنتم أجنة فى بطون أمهتكم فلا تزكوا أنفسكم هو أعلم بمن اتقى

verse_text_english: Have you noted the one who turned away?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: afara-ayta alladhī tawall
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفرءيت الذى تولى

verse_text_english: Rarely did he give to charity, and then very little.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aʿṭā qalīlan wa-akd
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأعطى قليلا وأكدى

verse_text_english: Did he possess knowledge of the future? Could he see it?
verse_text_arabic: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: aʿindahu ʿil'mu l-ghaybi fahuwa yar
verse_text_arabic_clean: أعنده علم الغيب فهو يرى

verse_text_english: Was he not informed of the teachings in the scripture of Moses?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: am lam yunabba bimā fī ṣuḥufi mūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لم ينبأ بما فى صحف موسى

verse_text_english: And Abraham who fulfilled?
verse_text_arabic: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ib'rāhīma alladhī waff
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإبرهيم الذى وفى

verse_text_english: No soul bears the sins of another soul.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: allā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى

verse_text_english: Every human being is responsible for his own works.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-an laysa lil'insāni illā mā saʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأن ليس للإنسن إلا ما سعى

verse_text_english: And everyone's works will be shown.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anna saʿyahu sawfa yur
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأن سعيه سوف يرى

verse_text_english: Then they will be paid fully for such works.

verse_text_transliterated: wa-annahu huwa aghnā wa-aqn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنه هو أغنى وأقنى

verse_text_english: Which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?

verse_text_english: The inevitable is imminent.

verse_text_arabic_clean: أزفت الءازفة

verse_text_english: None besides GOD can relieve it.

verse_text_english: Are you questioning this matter?

verse_text_arabic_clean: أفمن هذا الحديث تعجبون

verse_text_english: Are you laughing, instead of crying?

verse_text_transliterated: wataḍḥakūna walā tabkūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتضحكون ولا تبكون

verse_text_english: Are you insisting on your ways?

verse_text_transliterated: wa-antum sāmidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنتم سمدون

verse_text_english: You shall fall prostrate before GOD, and worship.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟
verse_text_transliterated: fa-us'judū lillahi wa-uʿ'bud
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاسجدوا لله واعبدوا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

verse_text_english: The Hour has come closer, and the moon has split.*
verse_text_arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamar
verse_footnote_english: *54:1 This important sign of the approaching end of the world came to pass in 1969 when humans landed on the moon and brought pieces of the moon to earth. At the same time, God's mathematical Miracle of the Quran was being gradually unveiled. Traditional Muslims opposed it, since it exposed the fallacy of their practices (App. 25).
verse_text_arabic_clean: اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر

verse_text_english: Then they saw a miracle; but they turned away and said, "Old magic."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن يروا ءاية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر

verse_text_english: They disbelieved, followed their opinions, and adhered to their old traditions.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirru

verse_text_english: Sufficient warnings have been delivered to alert them.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

verse_text_english: Great wisdom; but all the warnings have been in vain.

verse_text_english: Ignore them; the day will come when the caller will announce a terrible disaster.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

verse_text_english: With their eyes humiliated, they come out of the graves like scattered locusts.
verse_text_arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

verse_text_english: As they respond to the caller, the disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult day."
verse_text_arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

verse_text_english: We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

verse_text_arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: "Did the message come down to him, instead of us? He is a flagrant liar."
verse_text_arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

verse_text_english: They will find out tomorrow who the flagrant liar is.
verse_text_arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

verse_text_english: We are sending the camel as a test for them. Watch them and be patient.

verse_text_english: But they persuaded their friend to kill (the camel), and he obliged.
verse_text_arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطى فعقر

verse_text_english: Consequently, how terrible was My retribution! They have been warned.
verse_text_arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: We sent upon them one blow, whereupon they became like harvested hay.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓir
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أرسلنا عليهم صيحة وحدة فكانوا كهشيم المحتظر

verse_text_english: We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر

verse_text_english: We showered them with rocks. Only Lot's family was saved at dawn.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥari
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أرسلنا عليهم حاصبا إلا ءال لوط نجينهم بسحر

verse_text_english: We blessed him and his family; we thus reward the appreciative.
verse_text_arabic: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakar
verse_text_arabic_clean: نعمة من عندنا كذلك نجزى من شكر

verse_text_english: He warned them about our requital, but they ridiculed the warnings.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أنذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر

verse_text_english: They negotiated with him about his guests; we blinded them. Suffer My retribution; you have been warned.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد رودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا أعينهم فذوقوا عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: Early the next morning, a devastating retribution struck them.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر

verse_text_english: Suffer My retribution; you have been warned.
verse_text_arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذوقوا عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: Pharaoh's people were warned.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد جاء ءال فرعون النذر

verse_text_english: They rejected all our signs. Consequently, we requited them as an Almighty, Omnipotent should.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبوا بـٔايتنا كلها فأخذنهم أخذ عزيز مقتدر

verse_text_english: Are your disbelievers better than those disbelievers? Have you been absolved by the scripture?
verse_text_arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zubur
verse_text_arabic_clean: أكفاركم خير من أولئكم أم لكم براءة فى الزبر

verse_text_english: Perhaps they think, "We will be the winners."
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣiru
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يقولون نحن جميع منتصر

verse_text_english: All of them will be defeated; they will turn around and flee.
verse_text_arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verse_text_transliterated: sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubur
verse_text_arabic_clean: سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر

verse_text_english: The Hour is awaiting them, and the Hour is far worse and more painful.
verse_text_arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verse_text_transliterated: bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarr
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل الساعة موعدهم والساعة أدهى وأمر

verse_text_english: Certainly, the guilty are astray, and will end up in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿuri
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المجرمين فى ضلل وسعر

verse_text_english: They will be dragged into the hellfire, forcibly. Suffer the agony of retribution.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يسحبون فى النار على وجوههم ذوقوا مس سقر

verse_text_english: Everything we created is precisely measured.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadari
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كل شىء خلقنه بقدر

verse_text_english: Our commands are done within the blink of an eye.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣar
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أمرنا إلا وحدة كلمح بالبصر

verse_text_english: We annihilated your counterparts. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أهلكنا أشياعكم فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: Everything they did is recorded in the scriptures.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zubur
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكل شىء فعلوه فى الزبر

verse_text_english: Everything, small or large, is written down.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭaru
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر

verse_text_english: Surely, the righteous have deserved gardens and rivers.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanahari
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المتقين فى جنت ونهر

verse_text_english: In a position of honor, at an Omnipotent King.
verse_text_arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى مقعد صدق عند مليك مقتدر

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The Most Gracious.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
verse_text_transliterated: al-raḥmān
verse_text_arabic_clean: الرحمن

verse_text_english: Teacher of the Quran.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
verse_text_transliterated: alimul alqur'aan
verse_text_arabic_clean: علم القرءان

verse_text_english: Creator of the human beings.
verse_text_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
verse_text_transliterated: khalaqa l-insān
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلق الإنسن

verse_text_english: He taught them how to distinguish.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
verse_text_transliterated: almahu alabayaana
verse_text_arabic_clean: علمه البيان

verse_text_english: The sun and the moon are perfectly calculated.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
verse_text_transliterated: al-shamsu wal-qamaru biḥus'bāni
verse_text_arabic_clean: الشمس والقمر بحسبان

verse_text_english: The stars and the trees prostrate.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-najmu wal-shajaru yasjudān
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنجم والشجر يسجدان

verse_text_english: He constructed the sky and established the law.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-samāa rafaʿahā wawaḍaʿa l-mīzān
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسماء رفعها ووضع الميزان

verse_text_english: You shall not transgress the law.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: allā taṭghaw fī l-mīzān
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألا تطغوا فى الميزان

verse_text_english: You shall establish justice; do not violate the law.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aqīmū l-wazna bil-qis'ṭi walā tukh'sirū l-mīzān
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأقيموا الوزن بالقسط ولا تخسروا الميزان

verse_text_english: He created the earth for all creatures.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-arḍa waḍaʿahā lil'anām
verse_text_arabic_clean: والأرض وضعها للأنام

verse_text_english: In it there are fruits, and date palms with their hanging fruit.*
verse_text_arabic: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
verse_text_transliterated: fīhā fākihatun wal-nakhlu dhātu l-akmām
verse_footnote_english: *55:11 Compare the spaceship Earth's renewable systems and reproducing astronauts, with the most sophisticated spaceships that we launch into space. God be glorified.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيها فكهة والنخل ذات الأكمام

verse_text_english: Also grains and the spices.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ḥabu dhū l-ʿaṣfi wal-rayḥān
verse_text_arabic_clean: والحب ذو العصف والريحان

verse_text_english: (O humans and jinns,) which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
verse_text_arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibān
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان

verse_text_english: He created the human from aged clay, like the potter's clay.
verse_text_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: khalaqa l-insāna min ṣalṣālin kal-fakhār
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلق الإنسن من صلصل كالفخار

verse_text_english: And created the jinns from blazing fire.
verse_text_arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wakhalaqa l-jāna min mārijin min nāri
verse_text_arabic_clean: وخلق الجان من مارج من نار

verse_text_english: (O humans and jinns,) which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
verse_text_arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibān
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان

verse_text_english: Lord of the two easts and the two wests.
verse_text_arabic: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
verse_text_transliterated: rabbu l-mashriqayni warabbu l-maghribayn
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب المشرقين ورب المغربين

verse_text_english: Which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
verse_text_arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibān
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان

verse_text_english: He separates the two seas where they meet.
verse_text_arabic: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: maraja l-baḥrayni yaltaqiyān
verse_text_arabic_clean: مرج البحرين يلتقيان

verse_text_english: A barrier is placed between them, to prevent them from transgressing.
verse_text_arabic: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: baynahumā barzakhun lā yabghiyān
verse_text_arabic_clean: بينهما برزخ لا يبغيان

verse_text_english: Which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
verse_text_arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibān
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان

verse_text_english: Out of both of them you get pearls and coral.
verse_text_arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
verse_text_transliterated: yakhruju min'humā l-lu'lu-u wal-marjān
verse_text_arabic_clean: يخرج منهما اللؤلؤ والمرجان

verse_text_english: Which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
verse_text_arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibān
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان

verse_text_english: He gave you ships that roam the sea like flags.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
verse_text_transliterated: walahu l-jawāri l-munshaātu fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlām
verse_text_arabic_clean: وله الجوار المنشـٔات فى البحر كالأعلم

verse_text_english: Which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
verse_text_arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verse_text_transliterated: fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibān
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان

verse_text_english: Everyone on earth perishes.
verse_text_arabic: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kullu man ʿalayhā fāni

verse_footnote_english: *56:13-40 People who believe and nourish their souls through worshiping God alone are destined for the High Heaven. The contemporary followers of each messenger invariably suffer persecution from the traditionalists and adherents of the corrupted religion. Thus, they have a special place reserved for them in the High Heaven. All people who die before the age of 40 go to the Lower Heaven, at least (46:15).
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثلة من الأولين

verse_text_english: Few from the later generations.

verse_text_arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: law nashāu lajaʿalnāhu ḥuṭāman faẓaltum tafakkahūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو نشاء لجعلنه حطما فظلتم تفكهون

verse_text_english: "We lost.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā lamugh'ramūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا لمغرمون

verse_text_english: "We are deprived."
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal naḥnu maḥrūmūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل نحن محرومون

verse_text_english: Have you noted the water you drink?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afara-aytumu l-māa alladhī tashrabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفرءيتم الماء الذى تشربون

verse_text_english: Did you send it down from the clouds, or did we?
verse_text_arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: a-antum anzaltumūhu mina l-muz'ni am naḥnu l-munzilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءأنتم أنزلتموه من المزن أم نحن المنزلون

verse_text_english: If we will, we can make it salty. You should be thankful.
verse_text_arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: law nashāu jaʿalnāhu ujājan falawlā tashkurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو نشاء جعلنه أجاجا فلولا تشكرون

verse_text_english: Have you noted the fire you ignite?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afara-aytumu l-nāra allatī tūrūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفرءيتم النار التى تورون

verse_text_english: Did you initiate its tree, or did we?
verse_text_arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
verse_text_transliterated: a-antum anshatum shajaratahā am naḥnu l-munshiūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءأنتم أنشأتم شجرتها أم نحن المنشـٔون

verse_text_english: We rendered it a reminder, and a useful tool for the users.
verse_text_arabic: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَٰعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: naḥnu jaʿalnāhā tadhkiratan wamatāʿan lil'muq'wīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: نحن جعلنها تذكرة ومتعا للمقوين

verse_text_english: You shall glorify the name of your Lord, the Great.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fasabbiḥ bi-is'mi rabbika l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم

verse_text_english: I swear by the positions of the stars.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: falā uq'simu bimawāqiʿi l-nujūm
verse_subtitle_english: Only the Sincere Can Understand the Quran
verse_footnote_english: *56:75-76 Our universe, the smallest and innermost of seven universes, contains a billion galaxies, a billion trillion stars, spanning billions of light years. These uncountable decillions of heavenly bodies maintain their orbits in a divinely controlled precision. The more we learn, the more we realize how awesome this oath is. See Appendix 6.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا أقسم بموقع النجوم

verse_text_english: This is an oath, if you only knew, that is awesome.*
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu laqasamun law taʿlamūna ʿaẓīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم

verse_text_english: This is an honorable Quran.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌ كَرِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu laqur'ānun karīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه لقرءان كريم

verse_text_english: In a protected book.
verse_text_arabic: فِى كِتَٰبٍ مَّكْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fī kitābin maknūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى كتب مكنون

verse_text_english: None can grasp it except the sincere.*
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yamassuhu illā l-muṭaharūn
verse_footnote_english: *56:79 The insincere who are not satisfied with the Quran alone are divinely prevented from understanding the Quran. This concept is repeated throughout the Quran (17:45, 18:57). Consequently, they cannot understand this verse. For example, compare this translation of 7:3, 17:46, 41:44, & 56:79 with other translations.
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يمسه إلا المطهرون

verse_text_english: A revelation from the Lord of the universe.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: tanzīlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزيل من رب العلمين

verse_text_english: Are you disregarding this narration?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afabihādhā l-ḥadīthi antum mud'hinūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفبهذا الحديث أنتم مدهنون

verse_text_english: Do you make it your business that you disbelieve?
verse_text_arabic: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: watajʿalūna riz'qakum annakum tukadhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتجعلون رزقكم أنكم تكذبون

verse_text_english: When the time comes and it (your soul) reaches your throat—
verse_text_arabic: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
verse_text_transliterated: falawlā idhā balaghati l-ḥul'qūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلولا إذا بلغت الحلقوم

verse_text_english: you will then look around.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-antum ḥīna-idhin tanẓurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون

verse_text_english: We are closer to it than you are, but you do not see.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walākin lā tub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونحن أقرب إليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون

verse_text_english: If it is true that you do not owe any accounting—
verse_text_arabic: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falawlā in kuntum ghayra madīnīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلولا إن كنتم غير مدينين

verse_text_english: why do you not restore (your soul), if you are truthful?
verse_text_arabic: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: tarjiʿūnahā in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ترجعونها إن كنتم صدقين

verse_text_english: If he is one of those close to Me—
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā in kāna mina l-muqarabīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما إن كان من المقربين

verse_text_english: then joy, flowers, and gardens of bliss.
verse_text_arabic: فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: farawḥun warayḥānun wajannatu naʿīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فروح وريحان وجنت نعيم

verse_text_english: And if he is one of the right—
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā in kāna min aṣḥābi l-yamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما إن كان من أصحب اليمين

verse_text_english: peace is the lot of those on the right.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَلَٰمٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: fasalāmun laka min aṣḥābi l-yamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسلم لك من أصحب اليمين

verse_text_english: But if he is one of the disbelievers, the strayers—
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā in kāna mina l-mukadhibīna l-ḍālīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما إن كان من المكذبين الضالين

verse_text_english: then an abode of inferno—
verse_text_arabic: فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fanuzulun min ḥamīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فنزل من حميم

verse_text_english: and burning in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wataṣliyatu jaḥīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتصلية جحيم

verse_text_english: This is the absolute truth.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā lahuwa ḥaqqu l-yaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا لهو حق اليقين

verse_text_english: You shall glorify the name of your Lord, the Great.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fasabbiḥ bi-is'mi rabbika l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Glorifying GOD is everything in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.
verse_text_arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: سبح لله ما فى السموت والأرض وهو العزيز الحكيم

verse_text_english: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He controls life and death. He is Omnipotent.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yuḥ'yī wayumītu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: له ملك السموت والأرض يحى ويميت وهو على كل شىء قدير

verse_text_english: He is the Alpha and the Omega. He is the Outermost and the Innermost. He is fully aware of all things.
verse_text_arabic: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: huwa l-awalu wal-ākhiru wal-ẓāhiru wal-bāṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: هو الأول والءاخر والظهر والباطن وهو بكل شىء عليم

verse_text_english: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days,* then assumed all authority. He knows everything that enters into the earth, and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky, and everything that climbs into it. He is with you wherever you may be. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
verse_text_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: huwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa maʿakum ayna mā kuntum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīru
verse_footnote_english: *57:4 The six days of creation are simply a yardstick to inform us of the relative importance of various components, to emphasize the significance of the planet Earth, and to let us know that the Earth is the only inhabited planet. See Footnote 41:9-10.
verse_text_arabic_clean: هو الذى خلق السموت والأرض فى ستة أيام ثم استوى على العرش يعلم ما يلج فى الأرض وما يخرج منها وما ينزل من السماء وما يعرج فيها وهو معكم أين ما كنتم والله بما تعملون بصير

verse_text_english: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. All matters are controlled by GOD.
verse_text_arabic: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verse_text_transliterated: lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: له ملك السموت والأرض وإلى الله ترجع الأمور

verse_text_english: He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
verse_text_arabic: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wahuwa ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: يولج اليل فى النهار ويولج النهار فى اليل وهو عليم بذات الصدور

verse_text_english: Believe in GOD and His messenger, and give from what He has bestowed upon you. Those among you who believe and give (to charity) have deserved a great recompense.
verse_text_arabic: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: āminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wa-anfiqū mimmā jaʿalakum mus'takhlafīna fīhi fa-alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-anfaqū lahum ajrun kabīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءامنوا بالله ورسوله وأنفقوا مما جعلكم مستخلفين فيه فالذين ءامنوا منكم وأنفقوا لهم أجر كبير

verse_text_english: Why should you not believe in GOD when the messenger is inviting you to believe in your Lord? He has taken a pledge from you, if you are believers.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā lakum lā tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-rasūlu yadʿūkum litu'minū birabbikum waqad akhadha mīthāqakum in kuntum mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما لكم لا تؤمنون بالله والرسول يدعوكم لتؤمنوا بربكم وقد أخذ ميثقكم إن كنتم مؤمنين

verse_text_english: He is the One who sends down to His servant clear revelations, in order to lead you out of the darkness into the light. GOD is Compassionate towards you, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: huwa alladhī yunazzilu ʿalā ʿabdihi āyātin bayyinātin liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wa-inna l-laha bikum laraūfun raḥīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: هو الذى ينزل على عبده ءايت بينت ليخرجكم من الظلمت إلى النور وإن الله بكم لرءوف رحيم

verse_text_english: Why do you not spend in the cause of GOD, when GOD possesses all wealth in the heavens and the earth? Distinguished from the rest are those among you who spend before the victory and strive. They attain a greater rank than those who spend after the victory and strive. For each, GOD promises salvation. GOD is Cognizant of everything you do.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā lakum allā tunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā yastawī minkum man anfaqa min qabli l-fatḥi waqātala ulāika aʿẓamu darajatan mina alladhīna anfaqū min baʿdu waqātalū wakullan waʿada l-lahu l-ḥus'nā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما لكم ألا تنفقوا فى سبيل الله ولله ميرث السموت والأرض لا يستوى منكم من أنفق من قبل الفتح وقتل أولئك أعظم درجة من الذين أنفقوا من بعد وقتلوا وكلا وعد الله الحسنى والله بما تعملون خبير

verse_text_english: Who would like to loan GOD a loan of righteousness, to have it multiplied for him manifold, and end up with a generous recompense?
verse_text_arabic: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: man dhā alladhī yuq'riḍu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahu lahu walahu ajrun karīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: من ذا الذى يقرض الله قرضا حسنا فيضعفه له وله أجر كريم

verse_text_english: The day will come when you see the believing men and women with their lights radiating ahead of them and to their right. Good news is yours that, on that day, you will have gardens with flowing streams. You will abide therein forever. This is the great triumph.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma tarā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti yasʿā nūruhum bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim bush'rākumu l-yawma jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم ترى المؤمنين والمؤمنت يسعى نورهم بين أيديهم وبأيمنهم بشرىكم اليوم جنت تجرى من تحتها الأنهر خلدين فيها ذلك هو الفوز العظيم

verse_text_english: On that day, the hypocrite men and women will say to those who believed, "Please allow us to absorb some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you, and seek light." A barrier will be set up between them, whose gate separates mercy on the inner side, from retribution on the outer side.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wal-munāfiqātu lilladhīna āmanū unẓurūnā naqtabis min nūrikum qīla ir'jiʿū warāakum fal-tamisū nūran faḍuriba baynahum bisūrin lahu bābun bāṭinuhu fīhi l-raḥmatu waẓāhiruhu min qibalihi l-ʿadhāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يقول المنفقون والمنفقت للذين ءامنوا انظرونا نقتبس من نوركم قيل ارجعوا وراءكم فالتمسوا نورا فضرب بينهم بسور له باب باطنه فيه الرحمة وظهره من قبله العذاب

verse_text_english: They will call upon them, "Were we not with you?" They will answer, "Yes, but you cheated your souls, hesitated, doubted, and became misled by wishful thinking, until GOD's judgment came. You were diverted from GOD by illusions.
verse_text_arabic: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verse_text_transliterated: yunādūnahum alam nakun maʿakum qālū balā walākinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbaṣtum wa-ir'tabtum wagharratkumu l-amāniyu ḥattā jāa amru l-lahi wagharrakum bil-lahi l-gharūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ينادونهم ألم نكن معكم قالوا بلى ولكنكم فتنتم أنفسكم وتربصتم وارتبتم وغرتكم الأمانى حتى جاء أمر الله وغركم بالله الغرور

verse_text_english: "Therefore, today no ransom can be taken from you, nor from those who disbelieved. Your abode is the fire; it is your lord, and miserable abode."
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: fal-yawma lā yu'khadhu minkum fid'yatun walā mina alladhīna kafarū mawākumu l-nāru hiya mawlākum wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاليوم لا يؤخذ منكم فدية ولا من الذين كفروا مأوىكم النار هى مولىكم وبئس المصير

verse_text_english: Is it not time for those who believed to open up their hearts for GOD's message, and the truth that is revealed herein? They should not be like the followers of previous scriptures whose hearts became hardened with time and, consequently, many of them turned wicked.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alam yani lilladhīna āmanū an takhshaʿa qulūbuhum lidhik'ri l-lahi wamā nazala mina l-ḥaqi walā yakūnū ka-alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablu faṭāla ʿalayhimu l-amadu faqasat qulūbuhum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم يأن للذين ءامنوا أن تخشع قلوبهم لذكر الله وما نزل من الحق ولا يكونوا كالذين أوتوا الكتب من قبل فطال عليهم الأمد فقست قلوبهم وكثير منهم فسقون

verse_text_english: Know that GOD revives the land after it had died. We thus explain the revelations for you, that you may understand.
verse_text_arabic: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā qad bayyannā lakumu l-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: اعلموا أن الله يحى الأرض بعد موتها قد بينا لكم الءايت لعلكم تعقلون

verse_text_english: Surely, the charitable men and women have loaned GOD a loan of goodness. They will receive their reward multiplied manifold; they have deserved a generous recompense.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-muṣadiqīna wal-muṣadiqāti wa-aqraḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum walahum ajrun karīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المصدقين والمصدقت وأقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا يضعف لهم ولهم أجر كريم

verse_text_english: Those who believed in GOD and His messengers are the saints and martyrs. Reserved for them at their Lord are their rewards and their light. As for those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations, they have incurred Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi ulāika humu l-ṣidīqūna wal-shuhadāu ʿinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanūruhum wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين ءامنوا بالله ورسله أولئك هم الصديقون والشهداء عند ربهم لهم أجرهم ونورهم والذين كفروا وكذبوا بـٔايتنا أولئك أصحب الجحيم

verse_text_english: Know that this worldly life is no more than play and games, and boasting among you, and hoarding of money and children. It is like abundant rain that produces plants and pleases the disbelievers. But then the plants turn into useless hay, and are blown away by the wind. In the Hereafter there is either severe retribution, or forgiveness from GOD and approval. This worldly life is no more than a temporary illusion.
verse_text_arabic: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمًا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: iʿ'lamū annamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wazīnatun watafākhurun baynakum watakāthurun fī l-amwāli wal-awlādi kamathali ghaythin aʿjaba l-kufāra nabātuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yakūnu ḥuṭāman wafī l-ākhirati ʿadhābun shadīdun wamaghfiratun mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānun wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: اعلموا أنما الحيوة الدنيا لعب ولهو وزينة وتفاخر بينكم وتكاثر فى الأمول والأولد كمثل غيث أعجب الكفار نباته ثم يهيج فترىه مصفرا ثم يكون حطما وفى الءاخرة عذاب شديد ومغفرة من الله ورضون وما الحيوة الدنيا إلا متع الغرور

verse_text_english: Therefore, you shall race towards forgiveness from your Lord, and a Paradise whose width encompasses the heaven and the earth. It awaits those who believed in GOD and His messengers. Such is GOD's grace that He bestows upon whomever He wills. GOD is Possessor of Infinite Grace.
verse_text_arabic: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: sābiqū ilā maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhā kaʿarḍi l-samāi wal-arḍi uʿiddat lilladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi dhālika faḍlu l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: سابقوا إلى مغفرة من ربكم وجنة عرضها كعرض السماء والأرض أعدت للذين ءامنوا بالله ورسله ذلك فضل الله يؤتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم

verse_text_english: Anything that happens on earth, or to you, has already been recorded, even before the creation. This is easy for GOD to do.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: mā aṣāba min muṣībatin fī l-arḍi walā fī anfusikum illā fī kitābin min qabli an nabra-ahā inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīru
verse_footnote_english: *57:22 We are absolutely free to side with God, or with Satan. God happens to know precisely what kind of decision each of us will make. The video tape of your life, from birth to death, is already recorded. See Appendix 14.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أصاب من مصيبة فى الأرض ولا فى أنفسكم إلا فى كتب من قبل أن نبرأها إن ذلك على الله يسير

verse_text_english: Thus, you should not grieve over anything you miss, nor be proud of anything He has bestowed upon you. GOD does not love those who are boastful, proud.
verse_text_arabic: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: likaylā tasaw ʿalā mā fātakum walā tafraḥū bimā ātākum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: لكيلا تأسوا على ما فاتكم ولا تفرحوا بما ءاتىكم والله لا يحب كل مختال فخور

verse_text_english: They are stingy, and enjoin the people to be stingy. If one turns away, then GOD is the Rich, the Praiseworthy.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna yabkhalūna wayamurūna l-nāsa bil-bukh'li waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين يبخلون ويأمرون الناس بالبخل ومن يتول فإن الله هو الغنى الحميد

verse_text_english: We sent our messengers supported by clear proofs, and we sent down to them the scripture and the law, that the people may uphold justice. And we sent down the iron, wherein there is strength, and many benefits for the people. All this in order for GOD to distinguish those who would support Him and His messengers, on faith. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.
verse_text_arabic: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verse_text_transliterated: laqad arsalnā rusulanā bil-bayināti wa-anzalnā maʿahumu l-kitāba wal-mīzāna liyaqūma l-nāsu bil-qis'ṭi wa-anzalnā l-ḥadīda fīhi basun shadīdun wamanāfiʿu lilnnāsi waliyaʿlama l-lahu man yanṣuruhu warusulahu bil-ghaybi inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzu
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد أرسلنا رسلنا بالبينت وأنزلنا معهم الكتب والميزان ليقوم الناس بالقسط وأنزلنا الحديد فيه بأس شديد ومنفع للناس وليعلم الله من ينصره ورسله بالغيب إن الله قوى عزيز

verse_text_english: We sent Noah and Abraham, and we granted their descendants prophethood and the scripture. Some of them were guided, while many were wicked.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad arsalnā nūḥan wa-ib'rāhīma wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihimā l-nubuwata wal-kitāba famin'hum muh'tadin wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أرسلنا نوحا وإبرهيم وجعلنا فى ذريتهما النبوة والكتب فمنهم مهتد وكثير منهم فسقون

verse_text_english: Subsequent to them, we sent our messengers. We sent Jesus the son of Mary, and we gave him the Injeel (Gospel), and we placed in the hearts of his followers kindness and mercy. But they invented hermitism which we never decreed for them. All we asked them to do was to uphold the commandments approved by GOD. But they did not uphold the message as they should have. Consequently, we gave those who believed among them their recompense, while many of them were wicked.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma qaffaynā ʿalā āthārihim birusulinā waqaffaynā biʿīsā ib'ni maryama waātaynāhu l-injīla wajaʿalnā fī qulūbi alladhīna ittabaʿūhu rafatan waraḥmatan warahbāniyyatan ib'tadaʿūhā mā katabnāhā ʿalayhim illā ib'tighāa riḍ'wāni l-lahi famā raʿawhā ḥaqqa riʿāyatihā faātaynā alladhīna āmanū min'hum ajrahum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم قفينا على ءاثرهم برسلنا وقفينا بعيسى ابن مريم وءاتينه الإنجيل وجعلنا فى قلوب الذين اتبعوه رأفة ورحمة ورهبانية ابتدعوها ما كتبنها عليهم إلا ابتغاء رضون الله فما رعوها حق رعايتها فـٔاتينا الذين ءامنوا منهم أجرهم وكثير منهم فسقون

verse_text_english: O you who believe, you shall reverence GOD and believe in His messenger. He will then grant you double the reward from His mercy, endow you with light to guide you, and forgive you. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waāminū birasūlihi yu'tikum kif'layni min raḥmatihi wayajʿal lakum nūran tamshūna bihi wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله وءامنوا برسوله يؤتكم كفلين من رحمته ويجعل لكم نورا تمشون به ويغفر لكم والله غفور رحيم

verse_text_english: Thus, the followers of previous scripture should know that they have not monopolized GOD's mercy and grace, and that all grace is in GOD's hand. He bestows it upon whomever He wills. GOD is Possessor of Infinite Grace.
verse_text_arabic: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: li-allā yaʿlama ahlu l-kitābi allā yaqdirūna ʿalā shayin min faḍli l-lahi wa-anna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: لئلا يعلم أهل الكتب ألا يقدرون على شىء من فضل الله وأن الفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: GOD has heard the woman who debated with you about her husband, and complained to GOD. GOD heard everything the two of you discussed. GOD is Hearer, Seer.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qad samiʿa l-lahu qawla allatī tujādiluka fī zawjihā watashtakī ilā l-lahi wal-lahu yasmaʿu taḥāwurakumā inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: قد سمع الله قول التى تجدلك فى زوجها وتشتكى إلى الله والله يسمع تحاوركما إن الله سميع بصير

verse_text_english: Those among you who estrange their wives (by declaring them as forbidden in sex) as their mothers know full well that they are not their mothers.* Their mothers are the women who gave birth to them. Indeed, they are committing a blasphemy and a falsehood. GOD is Pardoner, Forgiver.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna yuẓāhirūna minkum min nisāihim mā hunna ummahātihim in ummahātuhum illā allāī waladnahum wa-innahum layaqūlūna munkaran mina l-qawli wazūran wa-inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūru
verse_footnote_english: *58:2 Estranging a wife by declaring that she is like one's mother was an ancient tradition in Arabia. This is the only sura where the word "Allah" occurs in every verse.
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين يظهرون منكم من نسائهم ما هن أمهتهم إن أمهتهم إلا الـٔى ولدنهم وإنهم ليقولون منكرا من القول وزورا وإن الله لعفو غفور

verse_text_english: Those who estrange their wives in this manner, then reconcile thereafter, shall atone by freeing a slave before resuming their sexual relations. This is to enlighten you. GOD is Cognizant of everything you do.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna yuẓāhirūna min nisāihim thumma yaʿūdūna limā qālū fataḥrīru raqabatin min qabli an yatamāssā dhālikum tūʿaẓūna bihi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين يظهرون من نسائهم ثم يعودون لما قالوا فتحرير رقبة من قبل أن يتماسا ذلكم توعظون به والله بما تعملون خبير

verse_text_english: If you cannot find a slave to free, you shall fast two consecutive months before resuming sexual relations. If you cannot fast, then you shall feed sixty poor people. You shall believe in GOD and His messenger. These are GOD's laws. The disbelievers have incurred a painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu shahrayni mutatābiʿayni min qabli an yatamāssā faman lam yastaṭiʿ fa-iṭ'ʿāmu sittīna mis'kīnan dhālika litu'minū bil-lahi warasūlihi watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun alīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين من قبل أن يتماسا فمن لم يستطع فإطعام ستين مسكينا ذلك لتؤمنوا بالله ورسوله وتلك حدود الله وللكفرين عذاب أليم

verse_text_english: Surely, those who fight GOD and His messenger are committed to defeat, like their previous counterparts were committed to defeat. We have sent down clear proofs, and the rejectors have incurred a shameful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu kubitū kamā kubita alladhīna min qablihim waqad anzalnā āyātin bayyinātin walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun muhīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين يحادون الله ورسوله كبتوا كما كبت الذين من قبلهم وقد أنزلنا ءايت بينت وللكفرين عذاب مهين

verse_text_english: The day will come when GOD will resurrect them all, then inform them of everything they had done. GOD has recorded everything, while they have forgotten it. GOD witnesses all things.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū aḥṣāhu l-lahu wanasūhu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdu
