verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā balaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikūhunna bimaʿrūfin aw fāriqūhunna bimaʿrūfin wa-ashhidū dhaway ʿadlin minkum wa-aqīmū l-shahādata lillahi dhālikum yūʿaẓu bihi man kāna yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu makhraja
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا بلغن أجلهن فأمسكوهن بمعروف أو فارقوهن بمعروف وأشهدوا ذوى عدل منكم وأقيموا الشهدة لله ذلكم يوعظ به من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الءاخر ومن يتق الله يجعل له مخرجا

verse_text_english: And will provide for him whence he never expected. Anyone who trusts in GOD, He suffices him. GOD's commands are done. GOD has decreed for everything its fate.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayarzuq'hu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasibu waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fahuwa ḥasbuhu inna l-laha bālighu amrihi qad jaʿala l-lahu likulli shayin qadra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويرزقه من حيث لا يحتسب ومن يتوكل على الله فهو حسبه إن الله بلغ أمره قد جعل الله لكل شىء قدرا

verse_text_english: As for the women who have reached menopause, if you have any doubts, their interim shall be three months. As for those who do not menstruate, and discover that they are pregnant, their interim ends upon giving birth. Anyone who reverences GOD, He makes everything easy for him.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-allāī ya-is'na mina l-maḥīḍi min nisāikum ini ir'tabtum faʿiddatuhunna thalāthatu ashhurin wa-allāī lam yaḥiḍ'na wa-ulātu l-aḥmāli ajaluhunna an yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu min amrihi yus'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: والـٔى يئسن من المحيض من نسائكم إن ارتبتم فعدتهن ثلثة أشهر والـٔى لم يحضن وأولت الأحمال أجلهن أن يضعن حملهن ومن يتق الله يجعل له من أمره يسرا

verse_text_english: This is GOD's command that He sends down to you. Anyone who reverences GOD, He remits his sins, and rewards him generously.
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: dhālika amru l-lahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi l-laha yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayuʿ'ẓim lahu ajra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذلك أمر الله أنزله إليكم ومن يتق الله يكفر عنه سيـٔاته ويعظم له أجرا

verse_text_english: You shall allow them to live in the same home in which they lived with you, and do not make life so miserable for them that they leave on their own. If they are pregnant, you shall spend on them until they give birth. If they nurse the infant, you shall pay them for this service. You shall maintain the amicable relations among you. If you disagree, you may hire another woman to nurse the child.
verse_text_arabic: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَٰتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: askinūhunna min ḥaythu sakantum min wuj'dikum walā tuḍārrūhunna lituḍayyiqū ʿalayhinna wa-in kunna ulāti ḥamlin fa-anfiqū ʿalayhinna ḥattā yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna fa-in arḍaʿna lakum faātūhunna ujūrahunna watamirū baynakum bimaʿrūfin wa-in taʿāsartum fasatur'ḍiʿu lahu ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: أسكنوهن من حيث سكنتم من وجدكم ولا تضاروهن لتضيقوا عليهن وإن كن أولت حمل فأنفقوا عليهن حتى يضعن حملهن فإن أرضعن لكم فـٔاتوهن أجورهن وأتمروا بينكم بمعروف وإن تعاسرتم فسترضع له أخرى

verse_text_english: The rich husband shall provide support in accordance with his means, and the poor shall provide according to the means that GOD bestowed upon him. GOD does not impose on any soul more than He has given it. GOD will provide ease after difficulty.
verse_text_arabic: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: liyunfiq dhū saʿatin min saʿatihi waman qudira ʿalayhi riz'quhu falyunfiq mimmā ātāhu l-lahu lā yukallifu l-lahu nafsan illā mā ātāhā sayajʿalu l-lahu baʿda ʿus'rin yus'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: لينفق ذو سعة من سعته ومن قدر عليه رزقه فلينفق مما ءاتىه الله لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا ما ءاتىها سيجعل الله بعد عسر يسرا

verse_text_english: Many a community rebelled against the commands of its Lord and against His messengers. Consequently, we held them strictly accountable, and requited them a terrible requital.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: waka-ayyin min qaryatin ʿatat ʿan amri rabbihā warusulihi faḥāsabnāhā ḥisāban shadīdan waʿadhabnāhā ʿadhāban nuk'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكأين من قرية عتت عن أمر ربها ورسله فحاسبنها حسابا شديدا وعذبنها عذابا نكرا

verse_text_english: They suffered the consequences of their decisions; a profound loss.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fadhāqat wabāla amrihā wakāna ʿāqibatu amrihā khus'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذاقت وبال أمرها وكان عقبة أمرها خسرا

verse_text_english: GOD has prepared for them severe retribution. Therefore, you shall reverence GOD, O you who possess intelligence and believed. GOD has sent down to you a message—*
verse_text_arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan fa-ittaqū l-laha yāulī l-albābi alladhīna āmanū qad anzala l-lahu ilaykum dhik'ra
verse_footnote_english: *65:10-11 The "Messenger" here is clearly the Quran. Verse 10 talks about "sending down a message," and this points to the Quran as the messenger in 65:11 (App. 20).
verse_text_arabic_clean: أعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا فاتقوا الله يأولى الألبب الذين ءامنوا قد أنزل الله إليكم ذكرا

verse_text_english: a messenger* who recites to you GOD's revelations, clearly, to lead those who believe and work righteousness out of the darkness into the light. Anyone who believes in GOD and leads a righteous life, He will admit him into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. GOD will generously reward him.
verse_text_arabic: رَّسُولًا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا
verse_text_transliterated: rasūlan yatlū ʿalaykum āyāti l-lahi mubayyinātin liyukh'rija alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan qad aḥsana l-lahu lahu riz'qa
verse_text_arabic_clean: رسولا يتلوا عليكم ءايت الله مبينت ليخرج الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت من الظلمت إلى النور ومن يؤمن بالله ويعمل صلحا يدخله جنت تجرى من تحتها الأنهر خلدين فيها أبدا قد أحسن الله له رزقا

verse_text_english: GOD created seven universes and the same number of earths. The commands flow among them. This is to let you know that GOD is Omnipotent, and that GOD is fully aware of all things.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin wamina l-arḍi mith'lahunna yatanazzalu l-amru baynahunna litaʿlamū anna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun wa-anna l-laha qad aḥāṭa bikulli shayin ʿil'ma
verse_footnote_english: *65:12 Although God created six other planets that are identical to our Earth, there is life only on our planet. Thus, the evolutionists will be shown on the Day of Judgment that life did not just "evolve" on the planet because of its particular circumstances.
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله الذى خلق سبع سموت ومن الأرض مثلهن يتنزل الأمر بينهن لتعلموا أن الله على كل شىء قدير وأن الله قد أحاط بكل شىء علما

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: O you prophet, why do you prohibit what GOD has made lawful for you, just to please your wives? GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.*
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu lima tuḥarrimu mā aḥalla l-lahu laka tabtaghī marḍāta azwājika wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verse_footnote_english: *66:1 Mohammedans around the world believe that Muhammad was infallible. This verse teaches us that he was indeed a fallible human being (18:110, 33:37, 40:66, 80:1).
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها النبى لم تحرم ما أحل الله لك تبتغى مرضات أزوجك والله غفور رحيم

verse_text_english: GOD has decreed for you the laws dealing with your oaths. GOD is your Lord, and He is the Omniscient, Most Wise.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: qad faraḍa l-lahu lakum taḥillata aymānikum wal-lahu mawlākum wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: قد فرض الله لكم تحلة أيمنكم والله مولىكم وهو العليم الحكيم

verse_text_english: The prophet had trusted some of his wives with a certain statement, then one of them spread it, and GOD let him know about it. He then informed his wife of part of the issue, and disregarded part. She asked him, "Who informed you of this?" He said, "I was informed by the Omniscient, Most Cognizant."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idh asarra l-nabiyu ilā baʿḍi azwājihi ḥadīthan falammā nabba-at bihi wa-aẓharahu l-lahu ʿalayhi ʿarrafa baʿḍahu wa-aʿraḍa ʿan baʿḍin falammā nabba-ahā bihi qālat man anba-aka hādhā qāla nabba-aniya l-ʿalīmu l-khabīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذ أسر النبى إلى بعض أزوجه حديثا فلما نبأت به وأظهره الله عليه عرف بعضه وأعرض عن بعض فلما نبأها به قالت من أنبأك هذا قال نبأنى العليم الخبير

verse_text_english: If the two of you repent to GOD, then your hearts have listened. But if you band together against him, then GOD is his ally, and so is Gabriel and the righteous believers. Also, the angels are his helpers.
verse_text_arabic: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: in tatūbā ilā l-lahi faqad ṣaghat qulūbukumā wa-in taẓāharā ʿalayhi fa-inna l-laha huwa mawlāhu wajib'rīlu waṣāliḥu l-mu'minīna wal-malāikatu baʿda dhālika ẓahīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن تتوبا إلى الله فقد صغت قلوبكما وإن تظهرا عليه فإن الله هو مولىه وجبريل وصلح المؤمنين والملئكة بعد ذلك ظهير

verse_text_english: If he divorces you, his Lord will substitute other wives in your place who are better than you; submitters (Muslims), believers (Mu'mins), obedient, repentant, worshipers, pious, either previously married, or virgins.
verse_text_arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتٍ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٍ قَٰنِتَٰتٍ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٍ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٍ ثَيِّبَٰتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: Aasa rabbuhu in tallaqakunnaan yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatinmu/minatin qanitatin ta-ibatinAAabidatin sa-ihatin thayyibatinwaabkaran
verse_text_arabic_clean: عسى ربه إن طلقكن أن يبدله أزوجا خيرا منكن مسلمت مؤمنت قنتت تئبت عبدت سئحت ثيبت وأبكارا

verse_text_english: O you who believe, protect yourselves and your families from the Hellfire whose fuel is people and rocks. Guarding it are stern and powerful angels who never disobey GOD; they do whatever they are commanded to do.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū qū anfusakum wa-ahlīkum nāran waqūduhā l-nāsu wal-ḥijāratu ʿalayhā malāikatun ghilāẓun shidādun lā yaʿṣūna l-laha mā amarahum wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها الذين ءامنوا قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا وقودها الناس والحجارة عليها ملئكة غلاظ شداد لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون

verse_text_english: O you who disbelieved, do not apologize today. You are being requited only for what you did.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna kafarū lā taʿtadhirū l-yawma innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها الذين كفروا لا تعتذروا اليوم إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: O you who believe, you shall repent to GOD a firm repentance. Your Lord will then remit your sins and admit you into gardens with flowing streams. On that day, GOD will not disappoint the prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will radiate in front of them and to their right. They will say, "Our Lord, perfect our light for us, and forgive us; You are Omnipotent."
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū tūbū ilā l-lahi tawbatan naṣūḥan ʿasā rabbukum an yukaffira ʿankum sayyiātikum wayud'khilakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yawma lā yukh'zī l-lahu l-nabiya wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu nūruhum yasʿā bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-igh'fir lanā innaka ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها الذين ءامنوا توبوا إلى الله توبة نصوحا عسى ربكم أن يكفر عنكم سيـٔاتكم ويدخلكم جنت تجرى من تحتها الأنهر يوم لا يخزى الله النبى والذين ءامنوا معه نورهم يسعى بين أيديهم وبأيمنهم يقولون ربنا أتمم لنا نورنا واغفر لنا إنك على كل شىء قدير

verse_text_english: O prophet, struggle against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be stern with them. Their abode is Gehenna, and a miserable destiny.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu jāhidi l-kufāra wal-munāfiqīna wa-ugh'luẓ ʿalayhim wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها النبى جهد الكفار والمنفقين واغلظ عليهم ومأوىهم جهنم وبئس المصير

verse_text_english: GOD cites as examples of those who disbelieved the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were married to two of our righteous servants, but they betrayed them and, consequently, they could not help them at all against GOD. The two of them were told, "Enter the Hellfire with those who deserved it."
verse_text_arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna kafarū im'ra-ata nūḥin wa-im'ra-ata lūṭin kānatā taḥta ʿabdayni min ʿibādinā ṣāliḥayni fakhānatāhumā falam yugh'niyā ʿanhumā mina l-lahi shayan waqīla ud'khulā l-nāra maʿa l-dākhilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ضرب الله مثلا للذين كفروا امرأت نوح وامرأت لوط كانتا تحت عبدين من عبادنا صلحين فخانتاهما فلم يغنيا عنهما من الله شيـٔا وقيل ادخلا النار مع الدخلين

verse_text_english: And GOD cites as an example of those who believed the wife of Pharaoh. She said, "My Lord, build a home for me at You in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works; save me from the transgressing people."
verse_text_arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna āmanū im'ra-ata fir'ʿawna idh qālat rabbi ib'ni lī ʿindaka baytan fī l-janati wanajjinī min fir'ʿawna waʿamalihi wanajjinī mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verse_subtitle_english: Examples of the Believers Pharaoh's Wife
verse_text_arabic_clean: وضرب الله مثلا للذين ءامنوا امرأت فرعون إذ قالت رب ابن لى عندك بيتا فى الجنة ونجنى من فرعون وعمله ونجنى من القوم الظلمين

verse_text_english: Also Mary, the Amramite. She maintained her chastity, then we blew into her from our spirit. She believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures; she was obedient.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamaryama ib'nata ʿim'rāna allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhi min rūḥinā waṣaddaqat bikalimāti rabbihā wakutubihi wakānat mina l-qānitīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومريم ابنت عمرن التى أحصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيه من روحنا وصدقت بكلمت ربها وكتبه وكانت من القنتين

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Most exalted is the One in whose hands is all kingship, and He is Omnipotent.
verse_text_arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: تبرك الذى بيده الملك وهو على كل شىء قدير

verse_text_english: The One who created death and life for the purpose of distinguishing those among you who would do better.* He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūr
verse_footnote_english: *67:2 See the Introduction and Appendix 7 for details of the purpose behind this world.
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى خلق الموت والحيوة ليبلوكم أيكم أحسن عملا وهو العزيز الغفور

verse_text_english: He created seven universes in layers. You do not see any imperfection in the creation by the Most Gracious. Keep looking; do you see any flaw?
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi l-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى خلق سبع سموت طباقا ما ترى فى خلق الرحمن من تفوت فارجع البصر هل ترى من فطور

verse_text_english: Look again and again; your eyes will come back stumped and conquered.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-an wahuwa ḥasīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم ارجع البصر كرتين ينقلب إليك البصر خاسئا وهو حسير

verse_text_english: We adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and guarded its borders with projectiles against the devils; we prepared for them a retribution in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba l-saʿīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد زينا السماء الدنيا بمصبيح وجعلنها رجوما للشيطين وأعتدنا لهم عذاب السعير

verse_text_english: For those who disbelieved in their Lord, the retribution of Gehenna. What a miserable destiny.
verse_text_arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وللذين كفروا بربهم عذاب جهنم وبئس المصير

verse_text_english: When they get thrown therein, they hear its furor as it fumes.
verse_text_arabic: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
verse_text_transliterated: idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا ألقوا فيها سمعوا لها شهيقا وهى تفور

verse_text_english: It almost explodes from rage. Whenever a group is thrown therein, its guards would ask them, "Did you not receive a warner?"
verse_text_arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: تكاد تميز من الغيظ كلما ألقى فيها فوج سألهم خزنتها ألم يأتكم نذير

verse_text_english: They would answer, "Yes indeed; a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved and said, 'GOD did not reveal anything. You are totally astray.'"
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīri
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا بلى قد جاءنا نذير فكذبنا وقلنا ما نزل الله من شىء إن أنتم إلا فى ضلل كبير

verse_text_english: They also say, "If we heard or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of Hell!"
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi l-saʿīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا لو كنا نسمع أو نعقل ما كنا فى أصحب السعير

verse_text_english: Thus, they confessed their sins. Woe to the dwellers of Hell.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qan li-aṣḥābi l-saʿīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاعترفوا بذنبهم فسحقا لأصحب السعير

verse_text_english: As for those who reverence their Lord, when alone in their privacy, they have attained forgiveness and a great recompense.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب لهم مغفرة وأجر كبير

verse_text_english: Whether you keep your utterances secret, or declare them, He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأسروا قولكم أو اجهروا به إنه عليم بذات الصدور

verse_text_english: Should He not know what He created? He is the Sublime, Most Cognizant.
verse_text_arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألا يعلم من خلق وهو اللطيف الخبير

verse_text_english: He is the One who put the Earth at your service. Roam its corners, and eat from His provisions. To Him is the final summoning.
verse_text_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verse_text_transliterated: huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū min riz'qihi wa-ilayhi l-nushūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: هو الذى جعل لكم الأرض ذلولا فامشوا فى مناكبها وكلوا من رزقه وإليه النشور

verse_text_english: Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not strike the earth and cause it to tumble?
verse_text_arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
verse_text_transliterated: a-amintum man fī l-samāi an yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءأمنتم من فى السماء أن يخسف بكم الأرض فإذا هى تمور

verse_text_english: Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not send upon you a violent storm? Will you then appreciate the value of My warning?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: am amintum man fī l-samāi an yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم أمنتم من فى السماء أن يرسل عليكم حاصبا فستعلمون كيف نذير

verse_text_english: Others before them have disbelieved; how terrible was My requital!
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد كذب الذين من قبلهم فكيف كان نكير

verse_text_english: Have they not seen the birds above them lined up in columns and spreading their wings? The Most Gracious is the One who holds them in the air. He is Seer of all things.
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: awalam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولم يروا إلى الطير فوقهم صفت ويقبضن ما يمسكهن إلا الرحمن إنه بكل شىء بصير

verse_text_english: Where are those soldiers who can help you against the Most Gracious? Indeed, the disbelievers are deceived.
verse_text_arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni l-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: أمن هذا الذى هو جند لكم ينصركم من دون الرحمن إن الكفرون إلا فى غرور

verse_text_english: Who is there to provide for you, if He withholds His provisions? Indeed, they have plunged deep into transgression and aversion.
verse_text_arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wanufūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: أمن هذا الذى يرزقكم إن أمسك رزقه بل لجوا فى عتو ونفور

verse_text_english: Is one who walks while slumped over on his face better guided, or one who walks straight on the right path?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: afaman yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفمن يمشى مكبا على وجهه أهدى أمن يمشى سويا على صرط مستقيم

verse_text_english: Say, "He is the One who initiated you, and granted you the hearing, the eyes, and the brains. Rarely are you appreciative."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل هو الذى أنشأكم وجعل لكم السمع والأبصر والأفـٔدة قليلا ما تشكرون

verse_text_english: Say, "He is the One who placed you on earth, and before Him you will be summoned."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل هو الذى ذرأكم فى الأرض وإليه تحشرون

verse_text_english: They challenge: "When will that prophecy come to pass, if you are truthful?"
verse_text_arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صدقين

verse_text_english: Say, "Such knowledge is with GOD; I am no more than a manifest warner."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنما العلم عند الله وإنما أنا نذير مبين

verse_text_english: When they see it happening, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn miserable, and it will be proclaimed: "This is what you used to mock."
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما رأوه زلفة سيـٔت وجوه الذين كفروا وقيل هذا الذى كنتم به تدعون

verse_text_english: Say, "Whether GOD decides to annihilate me and those with me, or to shower us with His mercy, who is there to protect the disbelievers from a painful retribution?"
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu waman maʿiya aw raḥimanā faman yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أرءيتم إن أهلكنى الله ومن معى أو رحمنا فمن يجير الكفرين من عذاب أليم

verse_text_english: Say, "He is the Most Gracious; we believe in Him, and we trust in Him. You will surely find out who is really far astray."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qul huwa l-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل هو الرحمن ءامنا به وعليه توكلنا فستعلمون من هو فى ضلل مبين

verse_text_english: Say, "What if your water sinks away, who will provide you with pure water?"
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran faman yatīkum bimāin maʿīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أرءيتم إن أصبح ماؤكم غورا فمن يأتيكم بماء معين

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: NuN,* the pen, and what they (the people) write.
verse_text_arabic: نُونْ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: noon wal-qalami wamā yasṭurūn
verse_footnote_english: *68:1 "NuN" is unique among the Quran's miraculous initials. See Appendix 1.
verse_text_arabic_clean: نون والقلم وما يسطرون

verse_text_english: You have attained a great blessing from your Lord; you are not crazy.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: mā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bimajnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أنت بنعمة ربك بمجنون

verse_text_english: You have attained a recompense that is well deserved.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna laka la-ajran ghayra mamnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن لك لأجرا غير ممنون

verse_text_english: You are blessed with a great moral character.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innaka laʿalā khuluqin ʿaẓīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنك لعلى خلق عظيم

verse_text_english: You will see, and they will see.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasatub'ṣiru wayub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فستبصر ويبصرون

verse_text_english: Which of you are condemned.
verse_text_arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
verse_text_transliterated: bi-ayyikumu l-maftūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بأييكم المفتون

verse_text_english: Your Lord is fully aware of those who strayed off His path, and He is fully aware of those who are guided.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو أعلم بالمهتدين

verse_text_english: Do not obey the rejectors.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falā tuṭiʿi l-mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا تطع المكذبين

verse_text_english: They wish that you compromise, so they too can compromise.
verse_text_arabic: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waddū law tud'hinu fayud'hinūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون

verse_text_english: Do not obey every lowly swearer.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walā tuṭiʿ kulla ḥallāfin mahīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين

verse_text_english: A slanderer, a backbiter.
verse_text_arabic: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hammāzin mashāin binamīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: هماز مشاء بنميم

verse_text_english: Forbidder of charity, a transgressor, a sinner.
verse_text_arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin athīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: مناع للخير معتد أثيم

verse_text_english: Unappreciative, and greedy.
verse_text_arabic: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: autullin baAAda thalika zaneemin
verse_text_arabic_clean: عتل بعد ذلك زنيم

verse_text_english: Even though he possessed enough money and children.
verse_text_arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: an kāna dhā mālin wabanīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن كان ذا مال وبنين

verse_text_english: When our revelations are recited to him, he says, "Tales from the past!"
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا تتلى عليه ءايتنا قال أسطير الأولين

verse_text_english: We will mark his face.
verse_text_arabic: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: sanasimuhu ʿalā l-khur'ṭūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: سنسمه على الخرطوم

verse_text_english: We have tested them like we tested the owners of the garden who swore that they will harvest it in the morning.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā balawnāhum kamā balawnā aṣḥāba l-janati idh aqsamū layaṣrimunnahā muṣ'biḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا بلونهم كما بلونا أصحب الجنة إذ أقسموا ليصرمنها مصبحين

verse_text_english: They were so absolutely sure.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walā yastathnūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا يستثنون

verse_text_english: A passing (storm) from your Lord passed by it while they were asleep.
verse_text_arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: faṭāfa ʿalayhā ṭāifun min rabbika wahum nāimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فطاف عليها طائف من ربك وهم نائمون

verse_text_english: By morning, it was barren.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aṣbaḥat kal-ṣarīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأصبحت كالصريم

verse_text_english: They called on each other in the morning.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fatanādaw muṣ'biḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتنادوا مصبحين

verse_text_english: "Let us harvest the crop."
verse_text_arabic: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: ani igh'dū ʿalā ḥarthikum in kuntum ṣārimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن اغدوا على حرثكم إن كنتم صرمين

verse_text_english: On their way, they confided to each other.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-inṭalaqū wahum yatakhāfatūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فانطلقوا وهم يتخفتون

verse_text_english: That from then on, none of them would be poor.
verse_text_arabic: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: an lā yadkhulannahā l-yawma ʿalaykum mis'kīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن لا يدخلنها اليوم عليكم مسكين

verse_text_english: They were so absolutely sure of their harvest.
verse_text_arabic: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَٰدِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waghadaw ʿalā ḥardin qādirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وغدوا على حرد قدرين

verse_text_english: But when they saw it, they said, "We were so wrong!
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā ra-awhā qālū innā laḍāllūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما رأوها قالوا إنا لضالون

verse_text_english: "Now, we have nothing!"
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal naḥnu maḥrūmūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل نحن محرومون

verse_text_english: The righteous among them said, "If only you had glorified (GOD)!"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla awsaṭuhum alam aqul lakum lawlā tusabbiḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أوسطهم ألم أقل لكم لولا تسبحون

verse_text_english: They said, "Glory be to our Lord. We have transgressed."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū sub'ḥāna rabbinā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا سبحن ربنا إنا كنا ظلمين

verse_text_english: They started to blame each other.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatalāwamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتلومون

verse_text_english: They said, "Woe to us. We sinned.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ṭāghīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا يويلنا إنا كنا طغين

verse_text_english: "May our Lord grant us a better one. We repent to our Lord."
verse_text_arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: aasa rabbuna an yubdilanakhayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona
verse_text_arabic_clean: عسى ربنا أن يبدلنا خيرا منها إنا إلى ربنا رغبون

verse_text_english: Such was the requital. But the retribution of the Hereafter is far worse, if they only knew.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhālika l-ʿadhābu walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك العذاب ولعذاب الءاخرة أكبر لو كانوا يعلمون

verse_text_english: The righteous have deserved, at their Lord, gardens of bliss.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna lil'muttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti l-naʿīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن للمتقين عند ربهم جنت النعيم

verse_text_english: Shall we treat the submitters like the criminals?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: afanajʿalu l-mus'limīna kal-muj'rimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفنجعل المسلمين كالمجرمين

verse_text_english: What is wrong with your logic?
verse_text_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما لكم كيف تحكمون

verse_text_english: Do you have another book to uphold?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lakum kitābun fīhi tadrusūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لكم كتب فيه تدرسون

verse_text_english: In it, do you find anything you want?
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna lakum fīhi lamā takhayyarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن لكم فيه لما تخيرون

verse_text_english: Or, have you received solemn assurances from us that grant you whatever you wish on the Day of Resurrection?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لكم أيمن علينا بلغة إلى يوم القيمة إن لكم لما تحكمون

verse_text_english: Ask them, "Who guarantees this for you?"
verse_text_arabic: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: salhum ayyuhum bidhālika zaʿīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: سلهم أيهم بذلك زعيم

verse_text_english: Do they have idols? Let their idols help them, if they are truthful.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم شركاء فليأتوا بشركائهم إن كانوا صدقين

verse_text_english: The day will come when they will be exposed, and they will be required to fall prostrate, but they will be unable to.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqin wayud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يكشف عن ساق ويدعون إلى السجود فلا يستطيعون

verse_text_english: With their eyes subdued, humiliation will cover them. They were invited to fall prostrate when they were whole and able.
verse_text_arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi wahum sālimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: خشعة أبصرهم ترهقهم ذلة وقد كانوا يدعون إلى السجود وهم سلمون

verse_text_english: Therefore, let Me deal with those who reject this Hadith; we will lead them on whence they never perceive.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fadharnī waman yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذرنى ومن يكذب بهذا الحديث سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون

verse_text_english: I will give them enough rope; My scheming is formidable.
verse_text_arabic: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأملى لهم إن كيدى متين

verse_text_english: Are you asking them for money, so they are burdened by the fine?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم تسـٔلهم أجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون

verse_text_english: Do they know the future? Do they have it recorded?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون

verse_text_english: You shall steadfastly persevere in carrying out the commands of your Lord. Do not be like (Jonah) who called from inside the fish.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تكن كصاحب الحوت إذ نادى وهو مكظوم

verse_text_english: If it were not for his Lord's grace, he would have been ejected into the desert as a sinner.
verse_text_arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: لولا أن تدركه نعمة من ربه لنبذ بالعراء وهو مذموم

verse_text_english: But his Lord blessed him, and made him righteous.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fajaʿalahu mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاجتبه ربه فجعله من الصلحين

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieved show their ridicule in their eyes when they hear the message and say, "He is crazy!"
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن يكاد الذين كفروا ليزلقونك بأبصرهم لما سمعوا الذكر ويقولون إنه لمجنون

verse_text_english: It is in fact a message to the world.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما هو إلا ذكر للعلمين

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The incontestable (event).
verse_text_arabic: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verse_text_transliterated: al-ḥāqat
verse_text_arabic_clean: الحاقة

verse_text_english: What an incontestable (event)!
verse_text_arabic: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verse_text_transliterated: mā l-ḥāqat
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما الحاقة

verse_text_english: It is truly incontestable.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-ḥāqat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما الحاقة

verse_text_english: Thamûd and 'Ãd disbelieved in the Shocker.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat thamūdu waʿādun bil-qāriʿat
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت ثمود وعاد بالقارعة

verse_text_english: As for Thamûd, they were annihilated by the devastating (quake).
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā thamūdu fa-uh'likū bil-ṭāghiyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما ثمود فأهلكوا بالطاغية

verse_text_english: As for 'Ãd, they were annihilated by a persistent, violent storm.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā ʿādun fa-uh'likū birīḥin ṣarṣarin ʿātiyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما عاد فأهلكوا بريح صرصر عاتية

verse_text_english: He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, violently. You could see the people tossed around like decayed palm trunks.
verse_text_arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: sakharahā ʿalayhim sabʿa layālin wathamāniyata ayyāmin ḥusūman fatarā l-qawma fīhā ṣarʿā ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin khāwiyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: سخرها عليهم سبع ليال وثمنية أيام حسوما فترى القوم فيها صرعى كأنهم أعجاز نخل خاوية

verse_text_english: Can you find any trace of them?
verse_text_arabic: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fahal tarā lahum min bāqiyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فهل ترى لهم من باقية

verse_text_english: Pharaoh, others before him, and the sinners (of Sodom) were wicked.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: wajāa fir'ʿawnu waman qablahu wal-mu'tafikātu bil-khāṭi-at
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجاء فرعون ومن قبله والمؤتفكت بالخاطئة

verse_text_english: They disobeyed the messenger of their Lord. Consequently, He requited them a devastating requital.
verse_text_arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verse_text_transliterated: faʿaṣaw rasūla rabbihim fa-akhadhahum akhdhatan rābiyata
verse_text_arabic_clean: فعصوا رسول ربهم فأخذهم أخذة رابية

verse_text_english: The flood was devastating, so we carried you on the floating (ark).
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā lammā ṭaghā l-māu ḥamalnākum fī l-jāriyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا لما طغا الماء حملنكم فى الجارية

verse_text_english: We rendered it a lesson for you, that any listening ear may understand.
verse_text_arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: linajʿalahā lakum tadhkiratan wataʿiyahā udhunun wāʿiyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: لنجعلها لكم تذكرة وتعيها أذن وعية

verse_text_english: When the horn is blown once.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri nafkhatun wāḥidatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا نفخ فى الصور نفخة وحدة

verse_text_english: The earth and the mountains will be carried off and crushed; utterly crushed.
verse_text_arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
verse_text_transliterated: waḥumilati l-arḍu wal-jibālu fadukkatā dakkatan wāḥidata
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحملت الأرض والجبال فدكتا دكة وحدة

verse_text_english: That is the day when the inevitable event will come to pass.
verse_text_arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: fayawma-idhin waqaʿati l-wāqiʿat
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيومئذ وقعت الواقعة

verse_text_english: The heaven will crack, and fall apart.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inshaqqati l-samāu fahiya yawma-idhin wāhiyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وانشقت السماء فهى يومئذ واهية

verse_text_english: The angels will be all around, and Your Lord's dominion will then encompass eight (universes).*
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-malaku ʿalā arjāihā wayaḥmilu ʿarsha rabbika fawqahum yawma-idhin thamāniyatu
verse_footnote_english: *69:17 This earth is full of misery because of its physical distance from God, since it is in the seventh universe (7:143). In the Hereafter, an eighth universe will be created that will be even farther than our seventh universe; it will be called "Hell" (89:23).
verse_text_arabic_clean: والملك على أرجائها ويحمل عرش ربك فوقهم يومئذ ثمنية

verse_text_english: On that day, you will be exposed, nothing of you can be hidden.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma-idhin tuʿ'raḍūna lā takhfā minkum khāfiyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: يومئذ تعرضون لا تخفى منكم خافية

verse_text_english: As for the one who receives his record with his right hand, he will say, "Come read my record.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnihi fayaqūlu hāumu iq'raū kitābiya
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما من أوتى كتبه بيمينه فيقول هاؤم اقرءوا كتبيه

verse_text_english: "I did believe that I was going to be held accountable."
verse_text_arabic: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
verse_text_transliterated: innī ẓanantu annī mulāqin ḥisābiya
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنى ظننت أنى ملق حسابيه

verse_text_english: He has deserved a happy life.
verse_text_arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fahuwa fī ʿīshatin rāḍiyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فهو فى عيشة راضية

verse_text_english: In an exalted Paradise.
verse_text_arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fī jannatin ʿāliyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى جنة عالية

verse_text_english: Its fruits are within reach.
verse_text_arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: quṭūfuhā dāniyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قطوفها دانية

verse_text_english: Eat and drink happily in return for your works in days past.
verse_text_arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā aslaftum fī l-ayāmi l-khāliyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلوا واشربوا هنيـٔا بما أسلفتم فى الأيام الخالية

verse_text_english: As for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I never received my record.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu bishimālihi fayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ūta kitābiya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما من أوتى كتبه بشماله فيقول يليتنى لم أوت كتبيه

verse_text_english: "I wish I never knew my account.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
verse_text_transliterated: walam adri mā ḥisābiya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولم أدر ما حسابيه

verse_text_english: "I wish my death was eternal.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
verse_text_transliterated: yālaytahā kānati l-qāḍiyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: يليتها كانت القاضية

verse_text_english: "My money cannot help me.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ
verse_text_transliterated: mā aghnā ʿannī māliya
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أغنى عنى ماليه

verse_text_english: "All my power is gone."
verse_text_arabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ
verse_text_transliterated: halaka ʿannī sul'ṭāniya
verse_text_arabic_clean: هلك عنى سلطنيه

verse_text_english: Take him and shackle him.
verse_text_arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
verse_text_transliterated: khudhūhu faghullūh
verse_text_arabic_clean: خذوه فغلوه

verse_text_english: Burn him in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma l-jaḥīma ṣallūh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم الجحيم صلوه

verse_text_english: In a chain that is seventy arms long, tie him up.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma fī sil'silatin dharʿuhā sabʿūna dhirāʿan fa-us'lukūh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم فى سلسلة ذرعها سبعون ذراعا فاسلكوه

verse_text_english: For he did not believe in GOD, Most Great.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu kāna lā yu'minu bil-lahi l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه كان لا يؤمن بالله العظيم

verse_text_english: Nor did he advocate the feeding of the poor.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا يحض على طعام المسكين

verse_text_english: Consequently, he has no friend here.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: falaysa lahu l-yawma hāhunā ḥamīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فليس له اليوم ههنا حميم

verse_text_english: Nor any food, except the bitter variety.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walā ṭaʿāmun illā min ghis'līni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا طعام إلا من غسلين

verse_text_english: Food for the sinners.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yakuluhu illā l-khāṭiūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يأكله إلا الخطـٔون

verse_text_english: I swear by what you see.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falā uq'simu bimā tub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا أقسم بما تبصرون

verse_text_english: And what you do not see.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā lā tub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما لا تبصرون

verse_text_english: This is the utterance of an honorable messenger.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه لقول رسول كريم

verse_text_english: Not the utterance of a poet; rarely do you believe.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā huwa biqawli shāʿirin qalīlan mā tu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما هو بقول شاعر قليلا ما تؤمنون

verse_text_english: Nor the utterance of a soothsayer; rarely do you take heed.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walā biqawli kāhinin qalīlan mā tadhakkarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا بقول كاهن قليلا ما تذكرون

verse_text_english: A revelation from the Lord of the universe.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: tanzīlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزيل من رب العلمين

verse_text_english: Had he uttered any other teachings.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw taqawwala ʿalaynā baʿḍa l-aqāwīl
verse_subtitle_english: Muhammad Forbidden from Issuing Any Religious Teachings
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو تقول علينا بعض الأقاويل

verse_text_english: We would have punished him.
verse_text_arabic: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: la-akhadhnā min'hu bil-yamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لأخذنا منه باليمين

verse_text_english: We would have stopped the revelations to him.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma laqaṭaʿnā min'hu l-watīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم لقطعنا منه الوتين

verse_text_english: None of you could have helped him.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā minkum min aḥadin ʿanhu ḥājizīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما منكم من أحد عنه حجزين

verse_text_english: This is a reminder for the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu latadhkiratun lil'muttaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه لتذكرة للمتقين

verse_text_english: We know; some of you are rejectors.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innā lanaʿlamu anna minkum mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنا لنعلم أن منكم مكذبين

verse_text_english: It is but sorrow for the disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu laḥasratun ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه لحسرة على الكفرين

verse_text_english: It is the absolute truth.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu laḥaqqu l-yaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه لحق اليقين

verse_text_english: Therefore, you shall glorify the name of your Lord, Most Great.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fasabbiḥ bi-is'mi rabbika l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: A questioner may question the inevitable retribution.
verse_text_arabic: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
verse_text_transliterated: sa-ala sāilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿi
verse_text_arabic_clean: سأل سائل بعذاب واقع

verse_text_english: For the disbelievers, none can stop it.
verse_text_arabic: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
verse_text_transliterated: lil'kāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿu
verse_text_arabic_clean: للكفرين ليس له دافع

verse_text_english: From GOD; Possessor of the highest Height.
verse_text_arabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
verse_text_transliterated: mina l-lahi dhī l-maʿārij
verse_text_arabic_clean: من الله ذى المعارج

verse_text_english: The angels and the Spirit, with their reports, climb to Him in a day that equals fifty thousand years.
verse_text_arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanati
verse_text_arabic_clean: تعرج الملئكة والروح إليه فى يوم كان مقداره خمسين ألف سنة

verse_text_english: Therefore, you shall resort to a gracious patience.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir ṣabran jamīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاصبر صبرا جميلا

verse_text_english: For they see it far away.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًا
verse_text_transliterated: innahum yarawnahu baʿīda
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنهم يرونه بعيدا

verse_text_english: While we see it very close.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًا
verse_text_transliterated: wanarāhu qarība
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونرىه قريبا

verse_text_english: The day will come when the sky will be like molten rocks.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma takūnu l-samāu kal-muh'l
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم تكون السماء كالمهل

verse_text_english: The mountains will be like fluffy wool.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
verse_text_transliterated: watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتكون الجبال كالعهن

verse_text_english: No friend will care about his close friend.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
verse_text_transliterated: walā yasalu ḥamīmun ḥamīma
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا يسـٔل حميم حميما

verse_text_english: When they see them, the guilty will wish he could give his own children as ransom, to spare him the retribution of that day.
verse_text_arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: يبصرونهم يود المجرم لو يفتدى من عذاب يومئذ ببنيه

verse_text_english: Also his spouse, and his brother.
verse_text_arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: waṣāḥibatihi wa-akhīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وصحبته وأخيه

verse_text_english: Even his whole tribe that raised him.
verse_text_arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: wafaṣīlatihi allatī tu'wīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفصيلته التى تـٔويه

verse_text_english: Even all the people on earth, if it would save him.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن فى الأرض جميعا ثم ينجيه

verse_text_english: No; it is aflame.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā innahā laẓ
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إنها لظى

verse_text_english: Eager to burn.
verse_text_arabic: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: nazzāʿatan lilshaw
verse_text_arabic_clean: نزاعة للشوى

verse_text_english: It calls on those who turned away.
verse_text_arabic: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: tadʿū man adbara watawall
verse_text_arabic_clean: تدعوا من أدبر وتولى

verse_text_english: Those who hoarded and counted.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wajamaʿa fa-awʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجمع فأوعى

verse_text_english: Indeed, the human being is anxious.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-insāna khuliqa halūʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الإنسن خلق هلوعا

verse_text_english: If touched by adversity, despondent.
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
verse_text_transliterated: idhā massahu l-sharu jazūʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا مسه الشر جزوعا

verse_text_english: If blessed by wealth, stingy.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā massahu l-khayru manūʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا مسه الخير منوعا

verse_text_english: Except for the worshipers.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā l-muṣalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا المصلين

verse_text_english: Who always observe their contact prayers (Salat).
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim dāimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين هم على صلاتهم دائمون

verse_text_english: Part of their money is set aside.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna fī amwālihim ḥaqqun maʿlūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين فى أمولهم حق معلوم

verse_text_english: For the poor and the needy.
verse_text_arabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: lilssāili wal-maḥrūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: للسائل والمحروم

verse_text_english: They believe in the Day of Judgment.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna yuṣaddiqūna biyawmi l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين يصدقون بيوم الدين

verse_text_english: They reverence their Lord's requital.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون

verse_text_english: Their Lord's requital is not taken for granted.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ʿadhāba rabbihim ghayru mamūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن عذاب ربهم غير مأمون

verse_text_english: They keep their chastity.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين هم لفروجهم حفظون

verse_text_english: (They have relations) only with their spouses, or what is legally theirs—
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا على أزوجهم أو ما ملكت أيمنهم فإنهم غير ملومين

verse_text_english: anyone who transgresses these limits is a sinner—
verse_text_arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن ابتغى وراء ذلك فأولئك هم العادون

verse_text_english: And the believers keep their word; they are trustworthy.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين هم لأمنتهم وعهدهم رعون

verse_text_english: Their testimony is truthful.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum bishahādātihim qāimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين هم بشهدتهم قائمون

verse_text_english: They consistently observe their contact prayers (Salat), on time.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين هم على صلاتهم يحافظون

verse_text_english: They have deserved a position of honor, in Paradise.
verse_text_arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ulāika fī jannātin muk'ramūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولئك فى جنت مكرمون

verse_text_english: What is keeping those who disbelieved from joining you?
verse_text_arabic: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famāli alladhīna kafarū qibalaka muh'ṭiʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمال الذين كفروا قبلك مهطعين

verse_text_english: To the right, and to the left, they flee.
verse_text_arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: aani alyameeni waAAani alshshimaliAAizeena
verse_text_arabic_clean: عن اليمين وعن الشمال عزين

verse_text_english: How can any of them expect to enter the blissful Paradise?
verse_text_arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: أيطمع كل امرئ منهم أن يدخل جنة نعيم

verse_text_english: Never; we created them, and they know from what.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā innā khalaqnāhum mimmā yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إنا خلقنهم مما يعلمون

verse_text_english: I solemnly swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests; we are able—
verse_text_arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا أقسم برب المشرق والمغرب إنا لقدرون

verse_text_english: to substitute better people in their place; we can never be defeated.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: aala an nubaddila khayran minhum wamanahnu bimasbooqeena
verse_text_arabic_clean: على أن نبدل خيرا منهم وما نحن بمسبوقين

verse_text_english: Therefore, let them blunder and play, until they meet the day that is awaiting them.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلقوا يومهم الذى يوعدون

verse_text_english: That is the day they come out of the graves in a hurry, as if herded to the (sacrificial) altars.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يخرجون من الأجداث سراعا كأنهم إلى نصب يوفضون

verse_text_english: With their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. That is the day that is awaiting them.
verse_text_arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: خشعة أبصرهم ترهقهم ذلة ذلك اليوم الذى كانوا يوعدون

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: We sent Noah to his people: "You shall warn your people before a painful retribution afflicts them."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه أن أنذر قومك من قبل أن يأتيهم عذاب أليم

verse_text_english: He said, "O my people, I am a manifest warner to you.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال يقوم إنى لكم نذير مبين

verse_text_english: "To alert you that you shall worship GOD, reverence Him, and obey me.
verse_text_arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن اعبدوا الله واتقوه وأطيعون

verse_text_english: "He will then forgive you your sins and respite you for a predetermined period. Most assuredly, GOD's appointment can never be delayed, once it is due, if you only knew."
verse_text_arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويؤخركم إلى أجل مسمى إن أجل الله إذا جاء لا يؤخر لو كنتم تعلمون

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, I have invited my people night and day.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylan wanahāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب إنى دعوت قومى ليلا ونهارا

verse_text_english: "But my invitation only increased their aversion.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلم يزدهم دعاءى إلا فرارا

verse_text_english: "Whenever I invited them to be forgiven by You, they placed their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, insisted, and turned arrogant.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنى كلما دعوتهم لتغفر لهم جعلوا أصبعهم فى ءاذانهم واستغشوا ثيابهم وأصروا واستكبروا استكبارا

verse_text_english: "Then I invited them publicly.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إنى دعوتهم جهارا

verse_text_english: "Then I proclaimed to them loudly, and I spoke to them privately.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إنى أعلنت لهم وأسررت لهم إسرارا

verse_text_english: "I said, 'Implore your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.
verse_text_arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
verse_text_transliterated: faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقلت استغفروا ربكم إنه كان غفارا

verse_text_english: "'He will then shower you generously with rain.
verse_text_arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: يرسل السماء عليكم مدرارا

verse_text_english: " 'And provide you with money and children, and orchards, and streams.' "
verse_text_arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayum'did'kum bi-amwālin wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātin wayajʿal lakum anhāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويمددكم بأمول وبنين ويجعل لكم جنت ويجعل لكم أنهرا

verse_text_english: Why should you not strive to reverence GOD?
verse_text_arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما لكم لا ترجون لله وقارا

verse_text_english: He is the One who created you in stages.
verse_text_arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: waqad khalaqakum aṭwāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقد خلقكم أطوارا

verse_text_english: Do you not realize that GOD created seven universes in layers?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
verse_text_transliterated: alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم تروا كيف خلق الله سبع سموت طباقا

verse_text_english: He designed the moon therein to be a light, and placed the sun to be a lamp.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala l-shamsa sirāja
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعل القمر فيهن نورا وجعل الشمس سراجا

verse_text_english: And GOD germinated you from the earth like plants.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabāta
verse_text_arabic_clean: والله أنبتكم من الأرض نباتا

verse_text_english: Then He returns you into it, and He will surely bring you out.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rāja
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم يعيدكم فيها ويخرجكم إخراجا

verse_text_english: GOD made the earth habitable for you.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والله جعل لكم الأرض بساطا

verse_text_english: That you may build roads therein.
verse_text_arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
verse_text_transliterated: litaslukū min'hā subulan fijāja
verse_text_arabic_clean: لتسلكوا منها سبلا فجاجا

verse_text_english: Noah said, "My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed those who were even more corrupted when blessed with money and children.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla nūḥun rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū man lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال نوح رب إنهم عصونى واتبعوا من لم يزده ماله وولده إلا خسارا

verse_text_english: "They schemed terrible schemes.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
verse_text_transliterated: wamakarū makran kubbāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومكروا مكرا كبارا

verse_text_english: "They said, 'Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, Suwaa', Yaghouth, Ya'ooq, and Nasr.'
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا لا تذرن ءالهتكم ولا تذرن ودا ولا سواعا ولا يغوث ويعوق ونسرا

verse_text_english: "They misled many. Therefore, let the wicked plunge deeper into loss."
verse_text_arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًا
verse_text_transliterated: waqad aḍallū kathīran walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā ḍalāla
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقد أضلوا كثيرا ولا تزد الظلمين إلا ضللا

verse_text_english: Because of their sins they were drowned and assigned to the hellfire. They found no helpers to protect them from GOD.
verse_text_arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: مما خطيـٔتهم أغرقوا فأدخلوا نارا فلم يجدوا لهم من دون الله أنصارا
