verse_text_english: Noah also said, "My Lord, do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verse_text_transliterated: waqāla nūḥun rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقال نوح رب لا تذر على الأرض من الكفرين ديارا

verse_text_english: "For if you let them, they will only mislead your servants and give birth to nothing but wicked disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verse_text_transliterated: innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنك إن تذرهم يضلوا عبادك ولا يلدوا إلا فاجرا كفارا

verse_text_english: "My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and anyone who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. But do not give the disbelievers anything but annihilation."
verse_text_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: rabbi igh'fir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minan walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā tabāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب اغفر لى ولولدى ولمن دخل بيتى مؤمنا وللمؤمنين والمؤمنت ولا تزد الظلمين إلا تبارا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Say, "I was inspired that a group of jinns listened, then said, 'We have heard a wonderful Quran.*
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarun mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajaba
verse_footnote_english: *72:1-28 The messenger here is named, mathematically, as "Rashad Khalifa," to whom God revealed the end of the world (Appendix 25). The number of verses from 1:1 to 72:27, where the messenger is mentioned, is 5472, 19x72x4. The word "Rashada" occurs 4 times in Sura 72. The value of "Rashada" is 504, and 504+28 (verses of Sura 72) is 532, 19x28. The value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230)+72+28=1330 =19x70. The digits of Sura 72 and its number of verses (28) add up to 7+2+2+8=19. Also, the crucial expression, "only to a messenger that He chooses" has a value of 1919, 19x101.
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أوحى إلى أنه استمع نفر من الجن فقالوا إنا سمعنا قرءانا عجبا

verse_text_english: "'It guides to righteousness, and we have believed in it; we will never set up any idols besides our Lord.
verse_text_arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: yahdī ilā l-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan nush'rika birabbinā aḥada
verse_text_arabic_clean: يهدى إلى الرشد فـٔامنا به ولن نشرك بربنا أحدا

verse_text_english: "'The Most High is our only Lord. He never had a mate, nor a son.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibatan walā walada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنه تعلى جد ربنا ما اتخذ صحبة ولا ولدا

verse_text_english: "'It is the foolish among us who used to utter such nonsense about GOD.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنه كان يقول سفيهنا على الله شططا

verse_text_english: "'We thought that neither the humans, nor the jinns, could possibly utter lies about GOD.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā ẓanannā an lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhiba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا ظننا أن لن تقول الإنس والجن على الله كذبا

verse_text_english: "'Human beings used to seek power through jinn beings, but they only afflicted them with a lot of adversity.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annahu kāna rijālun mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālin mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنه كان رجال من الإنس يعوذون برجال من الجن فزادوهم رهقا

verse_text_english: "'They thought, just like you thought, that GOD would not send another (messenger).
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum an lan yabʿatha l-lahu aḥada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنهم ظنوا كما ظننتم أن لن يبعث الله أحدا

verse_text_english: "'We touched the heaven and found it filled with formidable guards and projectiles.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā lamasnā l-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdan washuhuba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا لمسنا السماء فوجدنها ملئت حرسا شديدا وشهبا

verse_text_english: "'We used to sit there in order to spy. Anyone who listens is pursued by a powerful projectile.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi faman yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihāban raṣada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا كنا نقعد منها مقعد للسمع فمن يستمع الءان يجد له شهابا رصدا

verse_text_english: "'We have no idea if something bad is intended for the inhabitants of Earth, or if their Lord wills to redeem them.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا لا ندرى أشر أريد بمن فى الأرض أم أراد بهم ربهم رشدا

verse_text_english: "'Some of us are righteous, and some are less than righteous; we follow various paths.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā minnā l-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا منا الصلحون ومنا دون ذلك كنا طرائق قددا

verse_text_english: "'We knew full well that we can never run away from GOD on earth; we can never run away and escape.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā ẓanannā an lan nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan nuʿ'jizahu haraba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا ظننا أن لن نعجز الله فى الأرض ولن نعجزه هربا

verse_text_english: "'When we heard the guidance, we believed therein. Anyone who believes in his Lord will never fear any injustice, nor any affliction.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi faman yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsan walā rahaqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا لما سمعنا الهدى ءامنا به فمن يؤمن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا

verse_text_english: "'Among us are the submitters, and among us are the compromisers.'" As for those who submitted, they are on the right path.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا منا المسلمون ومنا القسطون فمن أسلم فأولئك تحروا رشدا

verse_text_english: As for the compromisers, they will be fuel for Gehenna.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭaba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما القسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا

verse_text_english: If they remain on the right path, we will bless them with abundant water.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā l-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وألو استقموا على الطريقة لأسقينهم ماء غدقا

verse_text_english: We will surely test them all. As for him who disregards the message of his Lord, He will direct him to ever increasing retribution.
verse_text_arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: linaftinahum fīhi waman yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿada
verse_text_arabic_clean: لنفتنهم فيه ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا

verse_text_english: The places of worship belong to GOD; do not call on anyone else beside GOD.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأن المسجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله أحدا

verse_text_english: When GOD's servant* advocated Him alone, almost all of them banded together to oppose him.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libada
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنه لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا

verse_text_english: Say, "I worship only my Lord; I never set up any idols besides Him."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥada
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنما أدعوا ربى ولا أشرك به أحدا

verse_text_english: Say, "I possess no power to harm you, nor to guide you."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarran walā rashada
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنى لا أملك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا

verse_text_english: Say, "No one can protect me from GOD, nor can I find any other refuge besides Him.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul innī lan yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥadun walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥada
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنى لن يجيرنى من الله أحد ولن أجد من دونه ملتحدا

verse_text_english: "I deliver GOD's proclamations and messages." Those who disobey GOD and His messenger incur the fire of Hell, wherein they abide forever.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: illā balāghan mina l-lahi warisālātihi waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abada
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا بلغا من الله ورسلته ومن يعص الله ورسوله فإن له نار جهنم خلدين فيها أبدا

verse_text_english: Once they see what is awaiting them, they will find out who is really weaker in power, and fewer in number.
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiran wa-aqallu ʿadada
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى إذا رأوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من أضعف ناصرا وأقل عددا

verse_text_english: Say, "I do not know if what is promised to you will happen soon, or if my Lord will delay it for awhile."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: qul in adrī aqarībun mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amada
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إن أدرى أقريب ما توعدون أم يجعل له ربى أمدا

verse_text_english: He is the Knower of the future; He does not reveal the future to anyone.
verse_text_arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: a'alimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru'ala ghaybihi ahadan
verse_text_arabic_clean: علم الغيب فلا يظهر على غيبه أحدا

verse_text_english: Only to a messenger that He chooses,* does He reveal from the past and the future, specific news.*
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: illā mani ir'taḍā min rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣada
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا من ارتضى من رسول فإنه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا

verse_text_english: This is to ascertain that they have delivered their Lord's messages. He is fully aware of what they have. He has counted the numbers of all things.
verse_text_arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadada
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليعلم أن قد أبلغوا رسلت ربهم وأحاط بما لديهم وأحصى كل شىء عددا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: O you cloaked one.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā l-muzamil
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها المزمل

verse_text_english: Meditate during the night, except rarely.
verse_text_arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: qumi al-layla illā qalīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: قم اليل إلا قليلا

verse_text_english: Half of it, or a little less.
verse_text_arabic: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: niṣ'fahu awi unquṣ min'hu qalīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: نصفه أو انقص منه قليلا

verse_text_english: Or a little more. And read the Quran from cover to cover.
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: aw zid ʿalayhi warattili l-qur'āna tartīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو زد عليه ورتل القرءان ترتيلا

verse_text_english: We will give you a heavy message.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā sanul'qī ʿalayka qawlan thaqīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا سنلقى عليك قولا ثقيلا

verse_text_english: The meditation at night is more effective, and more righteous.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna nāshi-ata al-layli hiya ashaddu waṭan wa-aqwamu qīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ناشئة اليل هى أشد وطـٔا وأقوم قيلا

verse_text_english: You have a lot of time during the day for other matters.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna laka fī l-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن لك فى النهار سبحا طويلا

verse_text_english: You shall commemorate the name of your Lord, to come ever closer and closer to Him.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabtīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر اسم ربك وتبتل إليه تبتيلا

verse_text_english: Lord of the east and the west; there is no other god besides Him. You should choose Him as your advocate.
verse_text_arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-ittakhidh'hu wakīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب المشرق والمغرب لا إله إلا هو فاتخذه وكيلا

verse_text_english: And remain steadfast in the face of their utterances, and disregard them in a nice manner.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-uh'jur'hum hajran jamīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: واصبر على ما يقولون واهجرهم هجرا جميلا

verse_text_english: And let Me deal with the rejectors, who have been generously blessed; just give them a little time.
verse_text_arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wadharnī wal-mukadhibīna ulī l-naʿmati wamahhil'hum qalīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: وذرنى والمكذبين أولى النعمة ومهلهم قليلا

verse_text_english: We have severe punishments, and Hell.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna ladaynā ankālan wajaḥīma
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن لدينا أنكالا وجحيما

verse_text_english: Food that can hardly be swallowed, and painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verse_text_transliterated: waṭaʿāman dhā ghuṣṣatin waʿadhāban alīma
verse_text_arabic_clean: وطعاما ذا غصة وعذابا أليما

verse_text_english: The day will come when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will turn into a weightless pile.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma tarjufu l-arḍu wal-jibālu wakānati l-jibālu kathīban mahīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم ترجف الأرض والجبال وكانت الجبال كثيبا مهيلا

verse_text_english: We have sent to you a messenger, just as we sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā arsalnā ilaykum rasūlan shāhidan ʿalaykum kamā arsalnā ilā fir'ʿawna rasūla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أرسلنا إليكم رسولا شهدا عليكم كما أرسلنا إلى فرعون رسولا

verse_text_english: Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and, consequently, we punished him severely.
verse_text_arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: faʿaṣā fir'ʿawnu l-rasūla fa-akhadhnāhu akhdhan wabīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: فعصى فرعون الرسول فأخذنه أخذا وبيلا

verse_text_english: If you disbelieve, how can you evade a day so terrible that it makes the infants gray-haired?
verse_text_arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
verse_text_transliterated: fakayfa tattaqūna in kafartum yawman yajʿalu l-wil'dāna shība
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكيف تتقون إن كفرتم يوما يجعل الولدن شيبا

verse_text_english: The heaven will shatter therefrom. His promise is true.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
verse_text_transliterated: al-samāu munfaṭirun bihi kāna waʿduhu mafʿūla
verse_text_arabic_clean: السماء منفطر به كان وعده مفعولا

verse_text_english: This is a reminder; whoever wills, let him choose the path to his Lord.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذه تذكرة فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا

verse_text_english: Your Lord knows that you meditate during two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, and so do some of those who believed with you. GOD has designed the night and the day, and He knows that you cannot always do this. He has pardoned you. Instead, you shall read what you can of the Quran. He knows that some of you may be ill, others may be traveling in pursuit of GOD's provisions, and others may be striving in the cause of GOD. You shall read what you can of it, and observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and lend GOD a loan of righteousness. Whatever good you send ahead on behalf of your souls, you will find it at GOD far better and generously rewarded. And implore GOD for forgiveness. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
verse_text_transliterated: inna rabbaka yaʿlamu annaka taqūmu adnā min thuluthayi al-layli waniṣ'fahu wathuluthahu waṭāifatun mina alladhīna maʿaka wal-lahu yuqaddiru al-layla wal-nahāra ʿalima an lan tuḥ'ṣūhu fatāba ʿalaykum fa-iq'raū mā tayassara mina l-qur'āni ʿalima an sayakūnu minkum marḍā waākharūna yaḍribūna fī l-arḍi yabtaghūna min faḍli l-lahi waākharūna yuqātilūna fī sabīli l-lahi fa-iq'raū mā tayassara min'hu wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aqriḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan wamā tuqaddimū li-anfusikum min khayrin tajidūhu ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayran wa-aʿẓama ajran wa-is'taghfirū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ربك يعلم أنك تقوم أدنى من ثلثى اليل ونصفه وثلثه وطائفة من الذين معك والله يقدر اليل والنهار علم أن لن تحصوه فتاب عليكم فاقرءوا ما تيسر من القرءان علم أن سيكون منكم مرضى وءاخرون يضربون فى الأرض يبتغون من فضل الله وءاخرون يقتلون فى سبيل الله فاقرءوا ما تيسر منه وأقيموا الصلوة وءاتوا الزكوة وأقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا وما تقدموا لأنفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله هو خيرا وأعظم أجرا واستغفروا الله إن الله غفور رحيم

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: O you hidden secret.*
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā l-mudathir
verse_footnote_english: *74:1 God's infinite wisdom willed to reveal the Quran through Muhammad, while the Quran's awesome 19-based mathematical miracle was revealed through God's Messenger of the Covenant 1406 lunar years after revelation of the Quran (1406=19x74 & 1974 AD was the Solar Year of discovery). In retrospect, we realize that the whole sura refers to the Quran's 19-based miracle (Appendices 1 & 2).
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها المدثر

verse_text_english: Come out and warn.
verse_text_arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
verse_text_transliterated: qum fa-andhi
verse_text_arabic_clean: قم فأنذر

verse_text_english: Extol your Lord.
verse_text_arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
verse_text_transliterated: warabbaka fakabbi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وربك فكبر

verse_text_english: Purify your garment.*
verse_text_arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
verse_text_transliterated: wathiyābaka faṭahhi
verse_footnote_english: *74:4 Quran is the garment containing the secret code. This refers to removing 9:128-9.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وثيابك فطهر

verse_text_english: Forsake what is wrong.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ruj'za fa-uh'ju
verse_text_arabic_clean: والرجز فاهجر

verse_text_english: Be content with your lot.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
verse_text_transliterated: walā tamnun tastakthir
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا تمنن تستكثر

verse_text_english: Steadfastly commemorate your Lord.
verse_text_arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
verse_text_transliterated: walirabbika fa-iṣ'bi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولربك فاصبر

verse_text_english: Then, when the horn is blown.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā nuqira fī l-nāqūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا نقر فى الناقور

verse_text_english: That will be a difficult day.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fadhālika yawma-idhin yawmun ʿasīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذلك يومئذ يوم عسير

verse_text_english: For the disbelievers, not easy.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: aala alkafireena ghayruyaseerin
verse_text_arabic_clean: على الكفرين غير يسير

verse_text_english: Let Me deal with one I created as an individual.
verse_text_arabic: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
verse_text_transliterated: dharnī waman khalaqtu waḥīda
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذرنى ومن خلقت وحيدا

verse_text_english: I provided him with lots of money.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿaltu lahu mālan mamdūda
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا

verse_text_english: And children to behold.
verse_text_arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
verse_text_transliterated: wabanīna shuhūda
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبنين شهودا

verse_text_english: I made everything easy for him.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wamahhadttu lahu tamhīda
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومهدت له تمهيدا

verse_text_english: Yet, he is greedy for more.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma yaṭmaʿu an azīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم يطمع أن أزيد

verse_text_english: He stubbornly refused to accept these proofs.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
verse_text_transliterated: kallā innahu kāna liāyātinā ʿanīda
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إنه كان لءايتنا عنيدا

verse_text_english: I will increasingly punish him.
verse_text_arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
verse_text_transliterated: sa-ur'hiquhu ṣaʿūda
verse_text_arabic_clean: سأرهقه صعودا

verse_text_english: For he reflected, then decided.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu fakkara waqaddar
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه فكر وقدر

verse_text_english: Miserable is what he decided.
verse_text_arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
verse_text_transliterated: faqutila kayfa qaddar
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقتل كيف قدر

verse_text_english: Miserable indeed is what he decided.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma qutila kayfa qaddar
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم قتل كيف قدر

verse_text_english: He looked.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma naẓar
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم نظر

verse_text_english: He frowned and whined.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma ʿabasa wabasar
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم عبس وبسر

verse_text_english: Then he turned away arrogantly.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma adbara wa-is'takbar
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أدبر واستكبر

verse_text_english: He said, "This is but clever magic!
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: faqāla in hādhā illā siḥ'run yu'thar
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقال إن هذا إلا سحر يؤثر

verse_text_english: "This is human made."
verse_text_arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: in hādhā illā qawlu l-bashar
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا إلا قول البشر

verse_text_english: I will commit him to retribution.
verse_text_arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: sa-uṣ'līhi saqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: سأصليه سقر

verse_text_english: What retribution!
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā saqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما سقر

verse_text_english: Thorough and comprehensive.
verse_text_arabic: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: lā tub'qī walā tadhar
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا تبقى ولا تذر

verse_text_english: Obvious to all the people.
verse_text_arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: lawwāḥatun lil'bashar
verse_text_arabic_clean: لواحة للبشر

verse_text_english: Over it is nineteen.*
verse_text_arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: a'layha tis'a ta'ashar
verse_footnote_english: *74:30-35 This "One of the great miracles" provides the first physical evidence that the Quran is God's message to the world. This 19-based miracle is detailed in Appendix 1.
verse_text_arabic_clean: عليها تسعة عشر

verse_text_english: We appointed angels to be guardians of Hell, and we assigned their number (19) (1) to disturb the disbelievers, (2) to convince the Christians and Jews (that this is a divine scripture), (3) to strengthen the faith of the faithful, (4) to remove all traces of doubt from the hearts of Christians, Jews, as well as the believers, and (5) to expose those who harbor doubt in their hearts, and the disbelievers; they will say, "What did GOD mean by this allegory?" GOD thus sends astray whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is a reminder for the people.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā jaʿalnā aṣḥāba l-nāri illā malāikatan wamā jaʿalnā ʿiddatahum illā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū liyastayqina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wayazdāda alladhīna āmanū īmānan walā yartāba alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wal-mu'minūna waliyaqūla alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-kāfirūna mādhā arāda l-lahu bihādhā mathalan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu wamā yaʿlamu junūda rabbika illā huwa wamā hiya illā dhik'rā lil'bashar
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما جعلنا أصحب النار إلا ملئكة وما جعلنا عدتهم إلا فتنة للذين كفروا ليستيقن الذين أوتوا الكتب ويزداد الذين ءامنوا إيمنا ولا يرتاب الذين أوتوا الكتب والمؤمنون وليقول الذين فى قلوبهم مرض والكفرون ماذا أراد الله بهذا مثلا كذلك يضل الله من يشاء ويهدى من يشاء وما يعلم جنود ربك إلا هو وما هى إلا ذكرى للبشر

verse_text_english: Absolutely, (I swear) by the moon.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā wal-qamar
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا والقمر

verse_text_english: And the night as it passes.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-al-layli idh adbar
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليل إذ أدبر

verse_text_english: And the morning as it shines.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā asfar
verse_text_arabic_clean: والصبح إذا أسفر

verse_text_english: This is one of the great miracles.*
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: innahā la-iḥ'dā l-kubar
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنها لإحدى الكبر

verse_text_english: A warning to the human race.
verse_text_arabic: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: nadhīran lil'bashar
verse_text_arabic_clean: نذيرا للبشر

verse_text_english: For those among you who wish to advance, or regress.
verse_text_arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
verse_text_transliterated: liman shāa minkum an yataqaddama aw yata-akhar
verse_text_arabic_clean: لمن شاء منكم أن يتقدم أو يتأخر

verse_text_english: Every soul is trapped by its sins.
verse_text_arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: kullu nafsin bimā kasabat rahīnatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كل نفس بما كسبت رهينة

verse_text_english: Except for those on the right.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: illā aṣḥāba l-yamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا أصحب اليمين

verse_text_english: While in Paradise, they will ask.
verse_text_arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fī jannātin yatasāalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى جنت يتساءلون

verse_text_english: About the guilty.
verse_text_arabic: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: aani almujrimeena
verse_text_arabic_clean: عن المجرمين

verse_text_english: "What brought you to this retribution?"
verse_text_arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā salakakum fī saqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما سلككم فى سقر

verse_text_english: They will say, "We did not observe the contact prayers (Salat).
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū lam naku mina l-muṣalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا لم نك من المصلين

verse_text_english: "We did not feed the poor.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walam naku nuṭ'ʿimu l-mis'kīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولم نك نطعم المسكين

verse_text_english: "We blundered with the blunderers.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wakunnā nakhūḍu maʿa l-khāiḍīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكنا نخوض مع الخائضين

verse_text_english: "We disbelieved in the Day of Judgment.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wakunnā nukadhibu biyawmi l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكنا نكذب بيوم الدين

verse_text_english: "Until certainty came to us now."
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā atānā l-yaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى أتىنا اليقين

verse_text_english: The intercession of the intercessors will never help them.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā tanfaʿuhum shafāʿatu l-shāfiʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما تنفعهم شفعة الشفعين

verse_text_english: Why are they so averse to this reminder?
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā lahum ʿani l-tadhkirati muʿ'riḍīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين

verse_text_english: Running like zebras.
verse_text_arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ka-annahum ḥumurun mus'tanfiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كأنهم حمر مستنفرة

verse_text_english: Who are fleeing from the lion!
verse_text_arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: farrat min qaswarati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فرت من قسورة

verse_text_english: Does each one of them want to receive the scripture personally?
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
verse_text_transliterated: bal yurīdu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yu'tā ṣuḥufan munasharata
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل يريد كل امرئ منهم أن يؤتى صحفا منشرة

verse_text_english: Indeed, they do not fear the Hereafter.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā bal lā yakhāfūna l-ākhirat
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا بل لا يخافون الءاخرة

verse_text_english: Indeed, this is a reminder.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā innahu tadhkiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إنه تذكرة

verse_text_english: For those who wish to take heed.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: faman shāa dhakarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن شاء ذكره

verse_text_english: They cannot take heed against GOD's will. He is the source of righteousness; He is the source of forgiveness.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yadhkurūna illā an yashāa l-lahu huwa ahlu l-taqwā wa-ahlu l-maghfirat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يذكرون إلا أن يشاء الله هو أهل التقوى وأهل المغفرة

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
verse_text_arabic: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: lā uq'simu biyawmi l-qiyāmat
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا أقسم بيوم القيمة

verse_text_english: And I swear by the blaming soul.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: walā uq'simu bil-nafsi l-lawāmat
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا أقسم بالنفس اللوامة

verse_text_english: Does the human being think that we will not reconstruct his bones?
verse_text_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: ayaḥsabu l-insānu allan najmaʿa ʿiẓāmah
verse_text_arabic_clean: أيحسب الإنسن ألن نجمع عظامه

verse_text_english: Yes indeed; we are able to reconstruct his finger tip.
verse_text_arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: balā qādirīna ʿalā an nusawwiya banānah
verse_text_arabic_clean: بلى قدرين على أن نسوى بنانه

verse_text_english: But the human being tends to believe only what he sees in front of him.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: bal yurīdu l-insānu liyafjura amāmah
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل يريد الإنسن ليفجر أمامه

verse_text_english: He doubts the Day of Resurrection!
verse_text_arabic: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: yasalu ayyāna yawmu l-qiyāmat
verse_text_arabic_clean: يسـٔل أيان يوم القيمة

verse_text_english: Once the vision is sharpened.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā bariqa l-baṣar
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا برق البصر

verse_text_english: And the moon is eclipsed.
verse_text_arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: wakhasafa l-qamar
verse_text_arabic_clean: وخسف القمر

verse_text_english: And the sun and the moon crash into one another.
verse_text_arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: wajumiʿa l-shamsu wal-qamar
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجمع الشمس والقمر

verse_text_english: The human being will say on that day, "Where is the escape?"
verse_text_arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
verse_text_transliterated: yaqūlu l-insānu yawma-idhin ayna l-mafar
verse_text_arabic_clean: يقول الإنسن يومئذ أين المفر

verse_text_english: Absolutely, there is no escape.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā lā wazar
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا لا وزر

verse_text_english: To your Lord, on that day, is the final destiny.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
verse_text_transliterated: ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-mus'taqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى ربك يومئذ المستقر

verse_text_english: The human being will be informed, on that day, of everything he did to advance himself, and everything he did to regress himself.
verse_text_arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
verse_text_transliterated: yunabba-u l-insānu yawma-idhin bimā qaddama wa-akhar
verse_text_arabic_clean: ينبؤا الإنسن يومئذ بما قدم وأخر

verse_text_english: The human being will be his own judge.
verse_text_arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: bali l-insānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل الإنسن على نفسه بصيرة

verse_text_english: No excuses will be accepted.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw alqā maʿādhīrah
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو ألقى معاذيره

verse_text_english: Do not move your tongue to hasten it.
verse_text_arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
verse_text_transliterated: lā tuḥarrik bihi lisānaka litaʿjala bih
verse_subtitle_english: Muhammad Forbidden From Explaining the Quran
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا تحرك به لسانك لتعجل به

verse_text_english: It is we who will collect it into Quran.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ʿalaynā jamʿahu waqur'ānah
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن علينا جمعه وقرءانه

verse_text_english: Once we recite it, you shall follow such a Quran.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā qaranāhu fa-ittabiʿ qur'ānah
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا قرأنه فاتبع قرءانه

verse_text_english: Then it is we who will explain it.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma inna ʿalaynā bayānah
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إن علينا بيانه

verse_text_english: Indeed, you love this fleeting life.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā bal tuḥibbūna l-ʿājilat
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا بل تحبون العاجلة

verse_text_english: While disregarding the Hereafter.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
verse_text_transliterated: watadharūna l-ākhirat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتذرون الءاخرة

verse_text_english: Some faces, on that day, will be happy.
verse_text_arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wujūhun yawma-idhin nāḍiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجوه يومئذ ناضرة

verse_text_english: Looking at their Lord.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ilā rabbihā nāẓiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى ربها ناظرة

verse_text_english: Other faces will be, on that day, miserable.
verse_text_arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wawujūhun yawma-idhin bāsiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووجوه يومئذ باسرة

verse_text_english: Expecting the worst.
verse_text_arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: taẓunnu an yuf'ʿala bihā fāqiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: تظن أن يفعل بها فاقرة

verse_text_english: Indeed, when (the soul) reaches the throat.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā idhā balaghati l-tarāqiy
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إذا بلغت التراقى

verse_text_english: And it is ordered: "Let go!"
verse_text_arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waqīla man rāqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقيل من راق

verse_text_english: He knows it is the end.
verse_text_arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
verse_text_transliterated: waẓanna annahu l-firāq
verse_text_arabic_clean: وظن أنه الفراق

verse_text_english: Each leg will lay motionless next to the other leg.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-tafati l-sāqu bil-sāq
verse_text_arabic_clean: والتفت الساق بالساق

verse_text_english: To your Lord, on that day, is the summoning.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
verse_text_transliterated: ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-masāq
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى ربك يومئذ المساق

verse_text_english: For he observed neither the charity, nor the contact prayers (Salat).
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: falā ṣaddaqa walā ṣall
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا صدق ولا صلى

verse_text_english: But he disbelieved and turned away.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walākin kadhaba watawall
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولكن كذب وتولى

verse_text_english: With his family, he acted arrogantly.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma dhahaba ilā ahlihi yatamaṭṭ
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم ذهب إلى أهله يتمطى

verse_text_english: You have deserved this.
verse_text_arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: awlā laka fa-awl
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولى لك فأولى

verse_text_english: Indeed, you have deserved this.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma awlā laka fa-awl
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أولى لك فأولى

verse_text_english: Does the human being think that he will go to nothing?
verse_text_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
verse_text_transliterated: ayaḥsabu l-insānu an yut'raka suda
verse_text_arabic_clean: أيحسب الإنسن أن يترك سدى

verse_text_english: Was he not a drop of ejected semen?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alam yaku nuṭ'fatan min maniyyin yum'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم يك نطفة من منى يمنى

verse_text_english: Then He created an embryo out of it!
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma kāna ʿalaqatan fakhalaqa fasaww
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم كان علقة فخلق فسوى

verse_text_english: He made it into male or female!
verse_text_arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: fajaʿala min'hu l-zawjayni l-dhakara wal-unth
verse_text_arabic_clean: فجعل منه الزوجين الذكر والأنثى

verse_text_english: Is He then unable to revive the dead?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawt
verse_text_arabic_clean: أليس ذلك بقدر على أن يحى الموتى

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Is it not a fact that there was a time when the human being was nothing to be mentioned?
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: hal atā ʿalā l-insāni ḥīnun mina l-dahri lam yakun shayan madhkūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل أتى على الإنسن حين من الدهر لم يكن شيـٔا مذكورا

verse_text_english: We created the human from a liquid mixture, from two parents, in order to test him. Thus, we made him a hearer and a seer.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā khalaqnā l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin amshājin nabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿan baṣīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا خلقنا الإنسن من نطفة أمشاج نبتليه فجعلنه سميعا بصيرا

verse_text_english: We showed him the two paths, then, he is either appreciative, or unappreciative.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā hadaynāhu l-sabīla immā shākiran wa-immā kafūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا هدينه السبيل إما شاكرا وإما كفورا

verse_text_english: We prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Hell.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna salāsilā wa-aghlālan wasaʿīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أعتدنا للكفرين سلسلا وأغللا وسعيرا

verse_text_english: As for the virtuous, they will drink from cups spiced with nectar.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-abrāra yashrabūna min kasin kāna mizājuhā kāfūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الأبرار يشربون من كأس كان مزاجها كافورا

verse_text_english: A spring that is reserved for GOD's servants; it will gush out as they will.
verse_text_arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: aaynan yashrabu biha 'aibaduAllahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran
verse_text_arabic_clean: عينا يشرب بها عباد الله يفجرونها تفجيرا

verse_text_english: They fulfill their pledges, and reverence a day that is extremely difficult.
verse_text_arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: yūfūna bil-nadhri wayakhāfūna yawman kāna sharruhu mus'taṭīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوفون بالنذر ويخافون يوما كان شره مستطيرا

verse_text_english: They donate their favorite food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive.
verse_text_arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayuṭ'ʿimūna l-ṭaʿāma ʿalā ḥubbihi mis'kīnan wayatīman wa-asīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويطعمون الطعام على حبه مسكينا ويتيما وأسيرا

verse_text_english: "We feed you for the sake of GOD; we expect no reward from you, nor thanks.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: innamā nuṭ'ʿimukum liwajhi l-lahi lā nurīdu minkum jazāan walā shukūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنما نطعمكم لوجه الله لا نريد منكم جزاء ولا شكورا

verse_text_english: "We fear from our Lord a day that is full of misery and trouble."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā nakhāfu min rabbinā yawman ʿabūsan qamṭarīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا نخاف من ربنا يوما عبوسا قمطريرا

verse_text_english: Consequently, GOD protects them from the evils of that day, and rewards them with joy and contentment.
verse_text_arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: fawaqāhumu l-lahu sharra dhālika l-yawmi walaqqāhum naḍratan wasurūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فوقىهم الله شر ذلك اليوم ولقىهم نضرة وسرورا

verse_text_english: He rewards them for their steadfastness with Paradise, and silk.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wajazāhum bimā ṣabarū jannatan waḥarīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجزىهم بما صبروا جنة وحريرا

verse_text_english: They relax therein on luxurious furnishings. They suffer neither the heat of the sun, nor any cold.
verse_text_arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki lā yarawna fīhā shamsan walā zamharīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: متكـٔين فيها على الأرائك لا يرون فيها شمسا ولا زمهريرا

verse_text_english: The shade covers them therein, and the fruits are brought within reach.
verse_text_arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wadāniyatan ʿalayhim ẓilāluhā wadhullilat quṭūfuhā tadhlīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: ودانية عليهم ظللها وذللت قطوفها تذليلا

verse_text_english: They are served drinks in silver containers and cups that are translucent.
verse_text_arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verse_text_transliterated: wayuṭāfu ʿalayhim biāniyatin min fiḍḍatin wa-akwābin kānat qawārīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويطاف عليهم بـٔانية من فضة وأكواب كانت قواريرا

verse_text_english: Translucent cups, though made of silver; they rightly deserved all this.
verse_text_arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: qawārīrā min fiḍḍatin qaddarūhā taqdīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: قواريرا من فضة قدروها تقديرا

verse_text_english: They enjoy drinks of delicious flavors.
verse_text_arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayus'qawna fīhā kasan kāna mizājuhā zanjabīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويسقون فيها كأسا كان مزاجها زنجبيلا

verse_text_english: From a spring therein known as "Salsabeel."
verse_text_arabic: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: aaynan feeha tusammasalsabeelan
verse_text_arabic_clean: عينا فيها تسمى سلسبيلا

verse_text_english: Serving them will be immortal servants. When you see them, they will look like scattered pearls.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna idhā ra-aytahum ḥasib'tahum lu'lu-an manthūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون إذا رأيتهم حسبتهم لؤلؤا منثورا

verse_text_english: Wherever you look, you will see bliss, and a wonderful dominion.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā ra-ayta thamma ra-ayta naʿīman wamul'kan kabīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا رأيت ثم رأيت نعيما وملكا كبيرا

verse_text_english: On them will be clothes of green velvet, satin, and silver ornaments. Their Lord will provide them with pure drinks.
verse_text_arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: aaliyahum thiyabu sundusinkhudrun wa-istabraqun wahulloo asawira minfiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran
verse_text_arabic_clean: عليهم ثياب سندس خضر وإستبرق وحلوا أساور من فضة وسقىهم ربهم شرابا طهورا

verse_text_english: This is the reward that awaits you, for your efforts have been appreciated.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā kāna lakum jazāan wakāna saʿyukum mashkūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا كان لكم جزاء وكان سعيكم مشكورا

verse_text_english: We have revealed to you this Quran; a special revelation from us.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: innā naḥnu nazzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna tanzīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا نحن نزلنا عليك القرءان تنزيلا

verse_text_english: You shall steadfastly carry out your Lord's commandments, and do not obey any sinful disbeliever among them.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā tuṭiʿ min'hum āthiman aw kafūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم ءاثما أو كفورا

verse_text_english: And commemorate the name of your Lord day and night.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika buk'ratan wa-aṣīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر اسم ربك بكرة وأصيلا

verse_text_english: During the night, fall prostrate before Him, and glorify Him many a long night.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wamina al-layli fa-us'jud lahu wasabbiḥ'hu laylan ṭawīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن اليل فاسجد له وسبحه ليلا طويلا

verse_text_english: These people are preoccupied with this fleeting life, while disregarding—just ahead of them—a heavy day.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna hāulāi yuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata wayadharūna warāahum yawman thaqīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هؤلاء يحبون العاجلة ويذرون وراءهم يوما ثقيلا

verse_text_english: We created them, and established them, and, whenever we will, we can substitute others in their place.
verse_text_arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: naḥnu khalaqnāhum washadadnā asrahum wa-idhā shi'nā baddalnā amthālahum tabdīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: نحن خلقنهم وشددنا أسرهم وإذا شئنا بدلنا أمثلهم تبديلا

verse_text_english: This is a reminder: whoever wills shall choose the path to his Lord.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīla
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذه تذكرة فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا

verse_text_english: Whatever you will is in accordance with GOD's will. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verse_text_transliterated: wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīma
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء الله إن الله كان عليما حكيما

verse_text_english: He admits whomever He wills into His mercy. As for the transgressors, He has prepared for them a painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimīna aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban alīma
verse_text_arabic_clean: يدخل من يشاء فى رحمته والظلمين أعد لهم عذابا أليما

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: (Angels) dispatched in succession.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-mur'salāti ʿur'fa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والمرسلت عرفا

verse_text_english: To drive the wind.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالعصفت عصفا

verse_text_english: Stir up clouds.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-nāshirāti nashra
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنشرت نشرا

verse_text_english: Distribute the provisions.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-fāriqāti farqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالفرقت فرقا

verse_text_english: Deliver messages.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-mul'qiyāti dhik'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالملقيت ذكرا

verse_text_english: Good news, as well as warnings.
verse_text_arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: authran aw nuthran
verse_text_arabic_clean: عذرا أو نذرا

verse_text_english: What is promised will come to pass.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verse_text_transliterated: innamā tūʿadūna lawāqiʿu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنما توعدون لوقع

verse_text_english: Thus, when the stars are put out.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā l-nujūmu ṭumisa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا النجوم طمست

verse_text_english: The sky is opened up.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-samāu furija
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا السماء فرجت

verse_text_english: The mountains are blown up.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-jibālu nusifa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الجبال نسفت

verse_text_english: The messengers are summoned.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-rusulu uqqita
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الرسل أقتت

verse_text_english: That is the appointed day.
verse_text_arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: li-ayyi yawmin ujjila
verse_text_arabic_clean: لأى يوم أجلت

verse_text_english: The Day of Decision.
verse_text_arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verse_text_transliterated: liyawmi l-faṣl
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليوم الفصل

verse_text_english: What a Day of Decision!
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-faṣl

verse_text_transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: Did we not create you from a lowly liquid?*
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ

verse_footnote_english: *77:20-23 According to Langman's Medical Embryology, by T. W. Sadler (Fifth Edition, Page 88): "In general the length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days or 38 weeks after fertilization." Both 266 and 38 are multiples of 19 (Appendix 1).
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين

verse_text_english: Then we placed it in a well-protected repository.

verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى قدر معلوم

verse_text_english: We measured it precisely.* We are the best designers.

verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: Did we not make the earth an abode?

verse_text_arabic_clean: أحياء وأموتا

verse_text_english: We placed on it high mountains, and provided you with fresh water to drink.

verse_text_english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verse_text_transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: Go to what you used to disbelieve in.

verse_text_english: Go to a shade of three different densities.

verse_text_transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: That is the day they do not speak.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا يوم لا ينطقون

verse_text_english: Nor are they given permission to apologize.

verse_text_english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: This is the Day of Decision. We have summoned you and the previous generations.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

verse_text_english: If you have any schemes, go ahead and scheme.

verse_text_transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: The righteous will enjoy shade and springs.

verse_text_english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: Eat and enjoy temporarily; you are guilty.
verse_text_arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ

verse_text_english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verse_text_transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: When they are told, "Bow down," they do not bow down.

verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_arabic_clean: عم يتساءلون

verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنزلنا من المعصرت ماء ثجاجا

verse_text_english: To produce with it grains and plants.
verse_text_arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
verse_text_transliterated: linukh'rija bihi ḥabban wanabāta

verse_text_arabic_clean: وجنت ألفافا

verse_text_arabic_clean: إن يوم الفصل كان ميقتا

verse_text_arabic_clean: لبثين فيها أحقابا

verse_text_english: They never taste in it coolness, nor a drink.

verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يذوقون فيها بردا ولا شرابا

verse_text_arabic_clean: إنهم كانوا لا يرجون حسابا

verse_text_english: And utterly rejected our signs.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhabū biāyātinā kidhāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذبوا بـٔايتنا كذابا

verse_text_english: We counted everything in a record.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًا
verse_text_transliterated: wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu kitāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكل شىء أحصينه كتبا

verse_text_english: Suffer the consequences; we will only increase your retribution.
verse_text_arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
verse_text_transliterated: fadhūqū falan nazīdakum illā ʿadhāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذوقوا فلن نزيدكم إلا عذابا

verse_text_english: The righteous have deserved a reward.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna lil'muttaqīna mafāza
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن للمتقين مفازا

verse_text_english: Orchards and grapes.
verse_text_arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًا
verse_text_transliterated: ḥadāiqa wa-aʿnāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: حدائق وأعنبا

verse_text_english: Magnificent spouses.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
verse_text_transliterated: wakawāʿiba atrāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكواعب أترابا

verse_text_english: Delicious drinks.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
verse_text_transliterated: wakasan dihāqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكأسا دهاقا

verse_text_english: They will never hear in it any nonsense or lies.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
verse_text_transliterated: lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā kidhāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا كذبا

verse_text_english: A reward from your Lord; a generous recompense.
verse_text_arabic: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
verse_text_transliterated: jazāan min rabbika ʿaṭāan ḥisāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: جزاء من ربك عطاء حسابا

verse_text_english: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. The Most Gracious. No one can abrogate His decisions.
verse_text_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
verse_text_transliterated: rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna min'hu khiṭāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب السموت والأرض وما بينهما الرحمن لا يملكون منه خطابا

verse_text_english: The day will come when the Spirit and the angels will stand in a row. None will speak except those permitted by the Most Gracious, and they will utter only what is right.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yaqūmu l-rūḥu wal-malāikatu ṣaffan lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يقوم الروح والملئكة صفا لا يتكلمون إلا من أذن له الرحمن وقال صوابا

verse_text_english: Such is the inevitable day. Whoever wills let him take refuge in his Lord.
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verse_text_transliterated: dhālika l-yawmu l-ḥaqu faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi maāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذلك اليوم الحق فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه مـٔابا

verse_text_english: We have sufficiently warned you about an imminent retribution. That is the day when everyone will examine what his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish I were dust."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāba
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أنذرنكم عذابا قريبا يوم ينظر المرء ما قدمت يداه ويقول الكافر يليتنى كنت تربا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The (angels who) snatch (the souls of the disbelievers) forcibly.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-nāziʿāti gharqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنزعت غرقا

verse_text_english: And those who gently take (the souls of the believers) joyfully.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-nāshiṭāti nashṭa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنشطت نشطا

verse_text_english: And those floating everywhere.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-sābiḥāti sabḥa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسبحت سبحا

verse_text_english: Eagerly racing with one another—
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-sābiqāti sabqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالسبقت سبقا

verse_text_english: to carry out various commands.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-mudabirāti amra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالمدبرت أمرا

verse_text_english: The day the quake quakes.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma tarjufu l-rājifat
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم ترجف الراجفة

verse_text_english: Followed by the second blow.
verse_text_arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: tatbaʿuhā l-rādifat
verse_text_arabic_clean: تتبعها الرادفة

verse_text_english: Certain minds will be terrified.
verse_text_arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qulūbun yawma-idhin wājifatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قلوب يومئذ واجفة

verse_text_english: Their eyes will be subdued.
verse_text_arabic: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: abṣāruhā khāshiʿatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أبصرها خشعة

verse_text_english: They will say, "We have been recreated from the grave!
verse_text_arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: yaqūlūna a-innā lamardūdūna fī l-ḥāfirat
verse_text_arabic_clean: يقولون أءنا لمردودون فى الحافرة

verse_text_english: "How did this happen after we had turned into rotten bones?"
verse_text_arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
verse_text_transliterated: a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman nakhirata
verse_text_arabic_clean: أءذا كنا عظما نخرة

verse_text_english: They had said, "This is an impossible recurrence."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū til'ka idhan karratun khāsiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا تلك إذا كرة خاسرة

verse_text_english: All it takes is one nudge.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإنما هى زجرة وحدة

verse_text_english: Whereupon they get up.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā hum bil-sāhirat
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا هم بالساهرة

verse_text_english: Have you known about the history of Moses?
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu mūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل أتىك حديث موسى

verse_text_english: His Lord called him at the holy valley of Tuwaa.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verse_text_transliterated: idh nādāhu rabbuhu bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwa
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ نادىه ربه بالواد المقدس طوى

verse_text_english: "Go to Pharaoh; he has transgressed."
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى

verse_text_english: Tell him, "Would you not reform?
verse_text_arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: faqul hal laka ilā an tazakk
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقل هل لك إلى أن تزكى

verse_text_english: "Let me guide you to your Lord, that you may turn reverent."
verse_text_arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ahdiyaka ilā rabbika fatakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأهديك إلى ربك فتخشى

verse_text_english: He then showed him the great miracle.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-arāhu l-āyata l-kub'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأرىه الءاية الكبرى

verse_text_english: But he disbelieved and rebelled.
verse_text_arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fakadhaba waʿaṣ
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكذب وعصى

verse_text_english: Then he turned away in a hurry.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma adbara yasʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أدبر يسعى

verse_text_english: He summoned and proclaimed.
verse_text_arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: faḥashara fanād
verse_text_arabic_clean: فحشر فنادى

verse_text_english: He said, "I am your Lord; most high."
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: faqāla anā rabbukumu l-aʿl
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقال أنا ربكم الأعلى

verse_text_english: Consequently, GOD committed him to the retribution in the Hereafter, as well as in the first life.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-akhadhahu l-lahu nakāla l-ākhirati wal-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأخذه الله نكال الءاخرة والأولى

verse_text_english: This is a lesson for the reverent.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: inna fī dhālika laʿib'ratan liman yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن فى ذلك لعبرة لمن يخشى

verse_text_english: Are you more difficult to create than the heaven? He constructed it.
verse_text_arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بَنَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: a-antum ashaddu khalqan ami l-samāu banāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءأنتم أشد خلقا أم السماء بنىها

verse_text_english: He raised its masses, and perfected it.
verse_text_arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: rafaʿa samkahā fasawwāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: رفع سمكها فسوىها

verse_text_english: He made its night dark, and brightened its morn.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aghṭasha laylahā wa-akhraja ḍuḥāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأغطش ليلها وأخرج ضحىها

verse_text_english: He made the earth egg-shaped.*
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-arḍa baʿda dhālika daḥāh
verse_footnote_english: *79:30 The Arabic word "dahhaahaa" is derived from "Dahhyah" which means "egg."
verse_text_arabic_clean: والأرض بعد ذلك دحىها

verse_text_english: From it, He produced its own water and pasture.
verse_text_arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: akhraja min'hā māahā wamarʿāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: أخرج منها ماءها ومرعىها

verse_text_english: He established the mountains.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-jibāla arsāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: والجبال أرسىها

verse_text_english: All this to provide life support for you and your animals.
verse_text_arabic: مَتَٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
verse_text_transliterated: matāʿan lakum wali-anʿāmiku
verse_text_arabic_clean: متعا لكم ولأنعمكم

verse_text_english: Then, when the great blow comes.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā jāati l-ṭāmatu l-kub'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا جاءت الطامة الكبرى

verse_text_english: That is the day when the human will remember everything he did.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yatadhakkaru l-insānu mā saʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يتذكر الإنسن ما سعى

verse_text_english: Hell will be brought into existence.
verse_text_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: waburrizati l-jaḥīmu liman yar
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبرزت الجحيم لمن يرى

verse_text_english: As for the one who transgressed.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā man ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما من طغى

verse_text_english: Who was preoccupied with this life.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verse_text_transliterated: waāthara l-ḥayata l-dun'y
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاثر الحيوة الدنيا

verse_text_english: Hell will be the abode.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-inna l-jaḥīma hiya l-maw
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإن الجحيم هى المأوى

verse_text_english: As for the one who reverenced the majesty of his Lord, and enjoined the self from sinful lusts.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā man khāfa maqāma rabbihi wanahā l-nafsa ʿani l-haw
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما من خاف مقام ربه ونهى النفس عن الهوى

verse_text_english: Paradise will be the abode.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-inna l-janata hiya l-maw
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإن الجنة هى المأوى

verse_text_english: They ask you about the Hour, and when it will take place!
verse_text_arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: yasalūnaka ʿani l-sāʿati ayyāna mur'sāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: يسـٔلونك عن الساعة أيان مرسىها

verse_text_english: It is not you (Muhammad) who is destined to announce its time.
verse_text_arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
verse_text_transliterated: fīma anta min dhik'rāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيم أنت من ذكرىها

verse_text_english: Your Lord decides its fate.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
verse_text_transliterated: ilā rabbika muntahāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى ربك منتهىها

verse_text_english: Your mission is to warn those who expect it.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: innamā anta mundhiru man yakhshāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنما أنت منذر من يخشىها

verse_text_english: The day they see it, they will feel as if they lasted one evening or half a day.
verse_text_arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: ka-annahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbathū illā ʿashiyyatan aw ḍuḥāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: كأنهم يوم يرونها لم يلبثوا إلا عشية أو ضحىها

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: He (Muhammad) frowned and turned away.
verse_text_arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: abasa watawalla
verse_text_arabic_clean: عبس وتولى

verse_text_english: When the blind man came to him.
verse_text_arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: an jāahu l-aʿm
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن جاءه الأعمى

verse_text_english: How do you know? He may purify himself.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yud'rīka laʿallahu yazzakk
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يدريك لعله يزكى

verse_text_english: Or he may take heed, and benefit from the message.
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: aw yadhakkaru fatanfaʿahu l-dhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو يذكر فتنفعه الذكرى

verse_text_english: As for the rich man.
verse_text_arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: ammā mani is'taghn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أما من استغنى

verse_text_english: You gave him your attention.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-anta lahu taṣadd
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأنت له تصدى

verse_text_english: Even though you could not guarantee his salvation.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā ʿalayka allā yazzakk
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما عليك ألا يزكى

verse_text_english: The one who came to you eagerly.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā man jāaka yasʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما من جاءك يسعى

verse_text_english: And is really reverent.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wahuwa yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهو يخشى

verse_text_english: You ignored him.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-anta ʿanhu talahh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأنت عنه تلهى

verse_text_english: Indeed, this is a reminder.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā innahā tadhkiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إنها تذكرة

verse_text_english: Whoever wills shall take heed.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: faman shāa dhakarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن شاء ذكره

verse_text_english: In honorable scriptures.
verse_text_arabic: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fī ṣuḥufin mukarramati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى صحف مكرمة

verse_text_english: Exalted and pure.
verse_text_arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: marfūʿatin muṭahharati
verse_text_arabic_clean: مرفوعة مطهرة

verse_text_english: (Written) by the hands of messengers.
verse_text_arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: bi-aydī safarati
verse_text_arabic_clean: بأيدى سفرة

verse_text_english: Who are honorable and righteous.
verse_text_arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kirāmin bararati
verse_text_arabic_clean: كرام بررة

verse_text_english: Woe to the human being; he is so unappreciative!
verse_text_arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: qutila l-insānu mā akfarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: قتل الإنسن ما أكفره

verse_text_english: What did He create him from?
