verse_text_arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: min ayyi shayin khalaqah
verse_text_arabic_clean: من أى شىء خلقه

verse_text_english: From a tiny drop, He creates him and designs him.
verse_text_arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: min nuṭ'fatin khalaqahu faqaddarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: من نطفة خلقه فقدره

verse_text_english: Then He points out the path for him.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma l-sabīla yassarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم السبيل يسره

verse_text_english: Then He puts him to death, and into the grave.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma amātahu fa-aqbarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم أماته فأقبره

verse_text_english: When He wills, He resurrects him.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma idhā shāa ansharah
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إذا شاء أنشره

verse_text_english: He shall uphold His commandments.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā lammā yaqḍi mā amarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا لما يقض ما أمره

verse_text_english: Let the human consider his food!
verse_text_arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
verse_text_transliterated: falyanẓuri l-insānu ilā ṭaʿāmih
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلينظر الإنسن إلى طعامه

verse_text_english: We pour the water generously.
verse_text_arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا
verse_text_transliterated: annā ṣababnā l-māa ṣabba
verse_text_arabic_clean: أنا صببنا الماء صبا

verse_text_english: Then we split the soil open.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
verse_text_transliterated: thumma shaqaqnā l-arḍa shaqqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم شققنا الأرض شقا

verse_text_english: We grow in it grains.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-anbatnā fīhā ḥabba
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأنبتنا فيها حبا

verse_text_english: Grapes and pasture.
verse_text_arabic: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
verse_text_transliterated: waʿinaban waqaḍba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعنبا وقضبا

verse_text_english: Olives and palms.
verse_text_arabic: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
verse_text_transliterated: wazaytūnan wanakhla
verse_text_arabic_clean: وزيتونا ونخلا

verse_text_english: A variety of orchards.
verse_text_arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا
verse_text_transliterated: waḥadāiqa ghul'ba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحدائق غلبا

verse_text_english: Fruits and vegetables.
verse_text_arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wafākihatan wa-abba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفكهة وأبا

verse_text_english: To provide life support for you and your animals.
verse_text_arabic: مَّتَٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
verse_text_transliterated: matāʿan lakum wali-anʿāmiku
verse_text_arabic_clean: متعا لكم ولأنعمكم

verse_text_english: Then, when the blow comes to pass.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā jāati l-ṣākhat
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا جاءت الصاخة

verse_text_english: That is the day when one flees from his brother.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yafirru l-maru min akhīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يفر المرء من أخيه

verse_text_english: From his mother and father.
verse_text_arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ummihi wa-abīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأمه وأبيه

verse_text_english: From his spouse and children.
verse_text_arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: waṣāḥibatihi wabanīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وصحبته وبنيه

verse_text_english: Each one of them, on that day, worries about his own destiny.
verse_text_arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: likulli im'ri-in min'hum yawma-idhin shanun yugh'nīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: لكل امرئ منهم يومئذ شأن يغنيه

verse_text_english: Some faces on that day will be happy.
verse_text_arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wujūhun yawma-idhin mus'firatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجوه يومئذ مسفرة

verse_text_english: Laughing and joyful.
verse_text_arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ḍāḥikatun mus'tabshiratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ضاحكة مستبشرة

verse_text_english: Other faces, on that day, will be covered with misery.
verse_text_arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wawujūhun yawma-idhin ʿalayhā ghabaratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووجوه يومئذ عليها غبرة

verse_text_english: Overwhelmed by remorse.
verse_text_arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: tarhaquhā qataratu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ترهقها قترة

verse_text_english: These are the wicked disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: ulāika humu l-kafaratu l-fajarat
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولئك هم الكفرة الفجرة

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: When the sun is rolled.
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: idhā l-shamsu kuwwira
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا الشمس كورت

verse_text_english: The stars are crashed into each other.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-nujūmu inkadara
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا النجوم انكدرت

verse_text_english: The mountains are wiped out.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-jibālu suyyira
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الجبال سيرت

verse_text_english: The reproduction is halted.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-ʿishāru ʿuṭṭila
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا العشار عطلت

verse_text_english: The beasts are summoned.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-wuḥūshu ḥushira
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الوحوش حشرت

verse_text_english: The oceans are set aflame.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-biḥāru sujjira
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا البحار سجرت

verse_text_english: The souls are restored to their bodies.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-nufūsu zuwwija
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا النفوس زوجت

verse_text_english: The girl who was buried alive is asked:
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-mawūdatu su-ila
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الموءدة سئلت

verse_text_english: For what crime was she killed?
verse_text_arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: bi-ayyi dhanbin qutila
verse_text_arabic_clean: بأى ذنب قتلت

verse_text_english: The records are made known.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-ṣuḥufu nushira
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الصحف نشرت

verse_text_english: The heaven is removed.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-samāu kushiṭa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا السماء كشطت

verse_text_english: Hell is ignited.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-jaḥīmu suʿʿira
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الجحيم سعرت

verse_text_english: Paradise is presented.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-janatu uz'lifa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الجنة أزلفت

verse_text_english: Every soul will know everything it brought.
verse_text_arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: alimat nafsun ma ahdara
verse_text_arabic_clean: علمت نفس ما أحضرت

verse_text_english: I solemnly swear by the galaxies.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
verse_text_transliterated: falā uq'simu bil-khunas
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا أقسم بالخنس

verse_text_english: Precisely running in their orbits.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
verse_text_transliterated: al-jawāri l-kunas
verse_text_arabic_clean: الجوار الكنس

verse_text_english: By the night as it falls.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-al-layli idhā ʿasʿas
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليل إذا عسعس

verse_text_english: And the morn as it breathes.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā tanaffas
verse_text_arabic_clean: والصبح إذا تنفس

verse_text_english: This is the utterance of an honorable messenger. *
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmi
verse_footnote_english: *81:19 By adding the sura number, plus the verse number, plus the gematrical value of the name "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), we get 1330, 19x70. This provides Quranic mathematical proof that this messenger is Rashad Khalifa.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه لقول رسول كريم

verse_text_english: Authorized by the Possessor of the Throne, fully supported.
verse_text_arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: dhī quwwatin ʿinda dhī l-ʿarshi makīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذى قوة عند ذى العرش مكين

verse_text_english: He shall be obeyed and trusted.
verse_text_arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: muṭāʿin thamma amīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: مطاع ثم أمين

verse_text_english: Your friend (Rashad) is not crazy.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā ṣāḥibukum bimajnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما صاحبكم بمجنون

verse_text_english: He saw him at the high horizon. *
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad raāhu bil-ufuqi l-mubīn
verse_footnote_english: *81:23 Rashad Khalifa was summoned to the high horizon as detailed in Appendix 2.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد رءاه بالأفق المبين

verse_text_english: He is not holding back any news.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā huwa ʿalā l-ghaybi biḍanīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما هو على الغيب بضنين

verse_text_english: It is not the talk of a rejected devil.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā huwa biqawli shayṭānin rajīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما هو بقول شيطن رجيم

verse_text_english: Now then, where will you go?
verse_text_arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ayna tadhhabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأين تذهبون

verse_text_english: This is a message to all the people.
verse_text_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هو إلا ذكر للعلمين

verse_text_english: For those who wish to go straight.
verse_text_arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: liman shāa minkum an yastaqīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: لمن شاء منكم أن يستقيم

verse_text_english: Whatever you will is in accordance with the will of GOD, Lord of the universe.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء الله رب العلمين

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: When the heaven is shattered.
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: idhā l-samāu infaṭara
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا السماء انفطرت

verse_text_english: The planets are scattered.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-kawākibu intathara
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الكواكب انتثرت

verse_text_english: The oceans are exploded.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-biḥāru fujjira
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا البحار فجرت

verse_text_english: The graves are opened.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-qubūru buʿ'thira
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا القبور بعثرت

verse_text_english: Every soul will find out what caused it to advance, and what caused it to regress.
verse_text_arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: alimat nafsun ma qaddamatwaakhkharat
verse_text_arabic_clean: علمت نفس ما قدمت وأخرت

verse_text_english: O you human being, what diverted you from your Lord, Most Honorable?
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā l-insānu mā gharraka birabbika l-karīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها الإنسن ما غرك بربك الكريم

verse_text_english: The One who created you, designed you, and perfected you.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī khalaqaka fasawwāka faʿadalak
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى خلقك فسوىك فعدلك

verse_text_english: In whatever design He chose, He constructed it.
verse_text_arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verse_text_transliterated: fī ayyi ṣūratin mā shāa rakkabak
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى أى صورة ما شاء ركبك

verse_text_english: Indeed, you disbelieve in the religion.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā bal tukadhibūna bil-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا بل تكذبون بالدين

verse_text_english: Oblivious to the fact that there are (invisible) keepers around you.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna ʿalaykum laḥāfiẓīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن عليكم لحفظين

verse_text_english: They are honest recorders.
verse_text_arabic: كِرَامًا كَٰتِبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: kirāman kātibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كراما كتبين

verse_text_english: They record everything you do.
verse_text_arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yaʿlamūna mā tafʿalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يعلمون ما تفعلون

verse_text_english: Surely, the pious have deserved bliss.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الأبرار لفى نعيم

verse_text_english: While the wicked have deserved Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna l-fujāra lafī jaḥīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن الفجار لفى جحيم

verse_text_english: Will incur it on the Day of Judgment.
verse_text_arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: yaṣlawnahā yawma l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يصلونها يوم الدين

verse_text_english: They never leave it.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā hum ʿanhā bighāibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما هم عنها بغائبين

verse_text_english: Awesome is the Day of Judgment.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما يوم الدين

verse_text_english: What a day; the Day of Judgment!
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma mā adrāka mā yawmu l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم ما أدرىك ما يوم الدين

verse_text_english: That is the day when no soul can help another soul, and all decisions, on that day, will belong to GOD.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma lā tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan wal-amru yawma-idhin lillah
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيـٔا والأمر يومئذ لله

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Woe to the cheaters.
verse_text_arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waylun lil'muṭaffifīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل للمطففين

verse_text_english: Who demand full measure when receiving from the people.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā l-nāsi yastawfūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين إذا اكتالوا على الناس يستوفون

verse_text_english: But when giving them the measures or weights, they cheat.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā kālūhum aw wazanūhum yukh'sirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا كالوهم أو وزنوهم يخسرون

verse_text_english: Do they not know that they will be resurrected?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alā yaẓunnu ulāika annahum mabʿūthūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألا يظن أولئك أنهم مبعوثون

verse_text_english: On a tremendous day?
verse_text_arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: liyawmin ʿaẓīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليوم عظيم

verse_text_english: That is the day when all people will stand before the Lord of the universe.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yaqūmu l-nāsu lirabbi l-ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يقوم الناس لرب العلمين

verse_text_english: Indeed, the book of the wicked is in Sijjeen.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā inna kitāba l-fujāri lafī sijjīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إن كتب الفجار لفى سجين

verse_text_english: Do you know what Sijjeen is?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā sijjīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما سجين

verse_text_english: A numerically structured book.
verse_text_arabic: كِتَٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: kitābun marqūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كتب مرقوم

verse_text_english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
verse_text_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: They do not believe in the Day of Judgment.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna yukadhibūna biyawmi l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين يكذبون بيوم الدين

verse_text_english: None disbelieves therein except the transgressor, the sinful.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yukadhibu bihi illā kullu muʿ'tadin athīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يكذب به إلا كل معتد أثيم

verse_text_english: When our revelations are recited to him, he says, "Tales from the past!"
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا تتلى عليه ءايتنا قال أسطير الأولين

verse_text_english: Indeed, their hearts have become shielded by their sins.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا بل ران على قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون

verse_text_english: Indeed, they will be isolated, on that day, from their Lord.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā innahum ʿan rabbihim yawma-idhin lamaḥjūbūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إنهم عن ربهم يومئذ لمحجوبون

verse_text_english: Then they will be thrown into Hell.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma innahum laṣālū l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إنهم لصالوا الجحيم

verse_text_english: They will be told, "This is what you used to deny."
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma yuqālu hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم يقال هذا الذى كنتم به تكذبون

verse_text_english: Indeed, the book of the righteous will be in 'Elleyyeen.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā inna kitāba l-abrāri lafī ʿilliyyīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إن كتب الأبرار لفى عليين

verse_text_english: Do you know what 'Elleyyeen is?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā ʿilliyyūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما عليون

verse_text_english: A numerically structured book.
verse_text_arabic: كِتَٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: kitābun marqūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كتب مرقوم

verse_text_english: To be witnessed by those close to Me.
verse_text_arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yashhaduhu l-muqarabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يشهده المقربون

verse_text_english: The righteous have deserved bliss.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الأبرار لفى نعيم

verse_text_english: On luxurious furnishings they watch.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ala al-ara-iki yanthuroona
verse_text_arabic_clean: على الأرائك ينظرون

verse_text_english: You recognize in their faces the joy of bliss.
verse_text_arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: taʿrifu fī wujūhihim naḍrata l-naʿīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: تعرف فى وجوههم نضرة النعيم

verse_text_english: Their drinks will be spiced with nectar.
verse_text_arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
verse_text_transliterated: yus'qawna min raḥīqin makhtūmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: يسقون من رحيق مختوم

verse_text_english: Its spice is like musk. This is what the competitors should compete for.
verse_text_arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: khitāmuhu mis'kun wafī dhālika falyatanāfasi l-mutanāfisūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ختمه مسك وفى ذلك فليتنافس المتنفسون

verse_text_english: Mixed into it will be special flavors.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamizājuhu min tasnīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومزاجه من تسنيم

verse_text_english: From a spring that is reserved for those close to Me.
verse_text_arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: aynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona
verse_text_arabic_clean: عينا يشرب بها المقربون

verse_text_english: The wicked used to laugh at those who believed.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين أجرموا كانوا من الذين ءامنوا يضحكون

verse_text_english: When they passed by them, they used to poke fun.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā marrū bihim yataghāmazūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا مروا بهم يتغامزون

verse_text_english: When they got together with their people, they used to joke.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā inqalabū ilā ahlihimu inqalabū fakihīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا انقلبوا إلى أهلهم انقلبوا فكهين

verse_text_english: Whenever they saw them, they said, "These people are far astray!
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā ra-awhum qālū inna hāulāi laḍāllūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا رأوهم قالوا إن هؤلاء لضالون

verse_text_english: "They have no such thing as (invisible) guards."
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā ur'silū ʿalayhim ḥāfiẓīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أرسلوا عليهم حفظين

verse_text_english: Today, those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fal-yawma alladhīna āmanū mina l-kufāri yaḍḥakūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاليوم الذين ءامنوا من الكفار يضحكون

verse_text_english: On luxurious furnishings they watch.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ala al-ara-iki yanthuroona
verse_text_arabic_clean: على الأرائك ينظرون

verse_text_english: Most assuredly, the disbelievers are requited for what they did.
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: hal thuwwiba l-kufāru mā kānū yafʿalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The time will come when the sky is ruptured.
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
verse_text_transliterated: idhā l-samāu inshaqqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا السماء انشقت

verse_text_english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأذنت لربها وحقت

verse_text_english: The earth will be leveled.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā l-arḍu mudda
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا الأرض مدت

verse_text_english: It will eject its contents, as it erupts.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alqat mā fīhā watakhalla
verse_text_arabic_clean: وألقت ما فيها وتخلت

verse_text_english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأذنت لربها وحقت

verse_text_english: O humans, you are irreversibly heading for a meeting with your Lord.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyuhā l-insānu innaka kādiḥun ilā rabbika kadḥan famulāqīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيها الإنسن إنك كادح إلى ربك كدحا فملقيه

verse_text_english: As for the one who receives his record in his right hand,
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnih
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما من أوتى كتبه بيمينه

verse_text_english: His reckoning will be easy.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fasawfa yuḥāsabu ḥisāban yasīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسوف يحاسب حسابا يسيرا

verse_text_english: He will return to his people joyfully.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayanqalibu ilā ahlihi masrūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وينقلب إلى أهله مسرورا

verse_text_english: As for the one who receives his record behind his back,
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu warāa ẓahrih
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما من أوتى كتبه وراء ظهره

verse_text_english: He will be ridden with remorse.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: fasawfa yadʿū thubūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسوف يدعوا ثبورا

verse_text_english: And will burn in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wayaṣlā saʿīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويصلى سعيرا

verse_text_english: He used to act arrogantly among his people.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: innahu kāna fī ahlihi masrūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه كان فى أهله مسرورا

verse_text_english: He thought that he will never be called to account.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu ẓanna an lan yaḥūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه ظن أن لن يحور

verse_text_english: Yes indeed, his Lord was Seer of him.
verse_text_arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: balā inna rabbahu kāna bihi baṣīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: بلى إن ربه كان به بصيرا

verse_text_english: I solemnly swear by the rosy dusk.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
verse_text_transliterated: falā uq'simu bil-shafaq
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا أقسم بالشفق

verse_text_english: And the night as it spreads.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-al-layli wamā wasaq
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليل وما وسق

verse_text_english: And the moon and its phases.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-qamari idhā ittasaq
verse_text_arabic_clean: والقمر إذا اتسق

verse_text_english: You will move from stage to stage.
verse_text_arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: latarkabunna ṭabaqan ʿan ṭabaqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: لتركبن طبقا عن طبق

verse_text_english: Why do they not believe?
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā lahum lā yu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما لهم لا يؤمنون

verse_text_english: And when the Quran is recited to them, they do not fall prostrate.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā quri-a ʿalayhimu l-qur'ānu lā yasjudūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا قرئ عليهم القرءان لا يسجدون

verse_text_english: This is because those who disbelieved are rejecting (the Quran).
verse_text_arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bali alladhīna kafarū yukadhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل الذين كفروا يكذبون

verse_text_english: GOD is fully aware of their innermost thoughts.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yūʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والله أعلم بما يوعون

verse_text_english: Promise them painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fabashir'hum biʿadhābin alīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فبشرهم بعذاب أليم

verse_text_english: As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they receive a recompense that is well deserved.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم أجر غير ممنون

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The sky and its galaxies.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-samāi dhāti l-burūj
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسماء ذات البروج

verse_text_english: The promised day.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-yawmi l-mawʿūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليوم الموعود

verse_text_english: The witness and the witnessed.
verse_text_arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
verse_text_transliterated: washāhidin wamashhūdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وشاهد ومشهود

verse_text_english: Woe to the people of the canyon.
verse_text_arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
verse_text_transliterated: qutila aṣḥābu l-ukh'dūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: قتل أصحب الأخدود

verse_text_english: They ignited a blazing fire.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
verse_text_transliterated: al-nāri dhāti l-waqūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: النار ذات الوقود

verse_text_english: Then sat around it.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
verse_text_transliterated: idh hum ʿalayhā quʿūdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ هم عليها قعود

verse_text_english: To watch the burning of the believers.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wahum ʿalā mā yafʿalūna bil-mu'minīna shuhūdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهم على ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين شهود

verse_text_english: They hated them for no other reason than believing in GOD, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā naqamū min'hum illā an yu'minū bil-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما نقموا منهم إلا أن يؤمنوا بالله العزيز الحميد

verse_text_english: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. And GOD witnesses all things.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى له ملك السموت والأرض والله على كل شىء شهيد

verse_text_english: Surely, those who persecute the believing men and women, then fail to repent, have incurred the retribution of Gehenna; they have incurred the retribution of burning.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna fatanū l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti thumma lam yatūbū falahum ʿadhābu jahannama walahum ʿadhābu l-ḥarīq
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنت ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق

verse_text_english: Surely, those who believed and led a righteous life, have deserved gardens with flowing streams. This is the greatest triumph.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru dhālika l-fawzu l-kabīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم جنت تجرى من تحتها الأنهر ذلك الفوز الكبير

verse_text_english: Indeed, your Lord's blow is severe.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna baṭsha rabbika lashadīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن بطش ربك لشديد

verse_text_english: He is the One who initiates and repeats.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu huwa yub'di-u wayuʿīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه هو يبدئ ويعيد

verse_text_english: And He is the Forgiving, Most Kind.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
verse_text_transliterated: wahuwa l-ghafūru l-wadūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهو الغفور الودود

verse_text_english: Possessor of the glorious throne.
verse_text_arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
verse_text_transliterated: dhū l-ʿarshi l-majīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذو العرش المجيد

verse_text_english: Doer of whatever He wills.
verse_text_arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
verse_text_transliterated: faʿʿālun limā yurīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: فعال لما يريد

verse_text_english: Did you note the history of the troops?
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
verse_text_transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu l-junūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل أتىك حديث الجنود

verse_text_english: Pharaoh and Thamûd?
verse_text_arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
verse_text_transliterated: fir'ʿawna wathamūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: فرعون وثمود

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieve are plagued with denial.
verse_text_arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: bali alladhīna kafarū fī takdhībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل الذين كفروا فى تكذيب

verse_text_english: GOD is fully aware of them.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-lahu min warāihim muḥīṭu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والله من ورائهم محيط

verse_text_english: Indeed, it is a glorious Quran.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: bal huwa qur'ānun majīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل هو قرءان مجيد

verse_text_english: In a preserved master tablet.
verse_text_arabic: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: fī lawḥin maḥfūẓi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى لوح محفوظ

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: By the sky and Al-Taareq.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-samāi wal-ṭāriq
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسماء والطارق

verse_text_english: Do you know what Al-Taareq is?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-ṭāriq
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما الطارق

verse_text_english: The bright star.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
verse_text_transliterated: al-najmu l-thāqib
verse_text_arabic_clean: النجم الثاقب

verse_text_english: Absolutely, everyone is well guarded.
verse_text_arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
verse_text_transliterated: in kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ

verse_text_english: Let the human reflect on his creation.
verse_text_arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
verse_text_transliterated: falyanẓuri l-insānu mimma khuliq
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلينظر الإنسن مم خلق

verse_text_english: He was created from ejected liquid.
verse_text_arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: khuliqa min māin dāfiqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلق من ماء دافق

verse_text_english: From between the spine and the viscera.
verse_text_arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
verse_text_transliterated: yakhruju min bayni l-ṣul'bi wal-tarāib
verse_text_arabic_clean: يخرج من بين الصلب والترائب

verse_text_english: He is certainly able to resurrect him.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu ʿalā rajʿihi laqādiru
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه على رجعه لقادر

verse_text_english: The day all secrets become known.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma tub'lā l-sarāir
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم تبلى السرائر

verse_text_english: He will have no power, nor a helper.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: famā lahu min quwwatin walā nāṣiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر

verse_text_english: By the sky that returns (the water).
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-samāi dhāti l-rajʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسماء ذات الرجع

verse_text_english: By the earth that cracks (to grow plants).
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-arḍi dhāti l-ṣadʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: والأرض ذات الصدع

verse_text_english: This is a serious narration.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu laqawlun faṣlu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه لقول فصل

verse_text_english: Not to be taken lightly.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā huwa bil-hazl
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما هو بالهزل

verse_text_english: They plot and scheme.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: innahum yakīdūna kayda
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنهم يكيدون كيدا

verse_text_english: But so do I.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-akīdu kayda
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأكيد كيدا

verse_text_english: Just respite the disbelievers a short respite.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
verse_text_transliterated: famahhili l-kāfirīna amhil'hum ruwayda
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمهل الكفرين أمهلهم رويدا

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.
verse_text_arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
verse_text_transliterated: sabbiḥi is'ma rabbika l-aʿl
verse_text_arabic_clean: سبح اسم ربك الأعلى

verse_text_english: He creates and shapes.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī khalaqa fasaww
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى خلق فسوى

verse_text_english: He designs and guides.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhī qaddara fahad
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذى قدر فهدى

verse_text_english: He produces the pasture.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhī akhraja l-marʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذى أخرج المرعى

verse_text_english: Then turns it into light hay.
verse_text_arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fajaʿalahu ghuthāan aḥw
verse_text_arabic_clean: فجعله غثاء أحوى

verse_text_english: We will recite to you; do not forget.
verse_text_arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: sanuq'ri-uka falā tans
verse_text_arabic_clean: سنقرئك فلا تنسى

verse_text_english: Everything is in accordance with GOD's will; He knows what is declared, and what is hidden.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: illā mā shāa l-lahu innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra wamā yakhf
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا ما شاء الله إنه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى

verse_text_english: We will direct you to the easiest path.
verse_text_arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wanuyassiruka lil'yus'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونيسرك لليسرى

verse_text_english: Therefore, you shall remind; perhaps the reminder will benefit.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fadhakkir in nafaʿati l-dhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذكر إن نفعت الذكرى

verse_text_english: The reverent will take heed.
verse_text_arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: sayadhakkaru man yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: سيذكر من يخشى

verse_text_english: The wicked will avoid it.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
verse_text_transliterated: wayatajannabuhā l-ashq
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويتجنبها الأشقى

verse_text_english: Consequently, he will suffer the great Hellfire.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī yaṣlā l-nāra l-kub'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى يصلى النار الكبرى

verse_text_english: Wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥy
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى

verse_text_english: Successful indeed is the one who redeems his soul.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qad aflaḥa man tazakk
verse_text_arabic_clean: قد أفلح من تزكى

verse_text_english: By remembering the name of his Lord, and observing the contact prayers (Salat).
verse_text_arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wadhakara is'ma rabbihi faṣall
verse_text_arabic_clean: وذكر اسم ربه فصلى

verse_text_english: Indeed, you are preoccupied with this first life.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verse_text_transliterated: bal tu'thirūna l-ḥayata l-dun'y
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل تؤثرون الحيوة الدنيا

verse_text_english: Even though the Hereafter is far better and everlasting.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ākhiratu khayrun wa-abq
verse_text_arabic_clean: والءاخرة خير وأبقى

verse_text_english: This is recorded in the earlier teachings.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā lafī l-ṣuḥufi l-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا لفى الصحف الأولى

verse_text_english: The teachings of Abraham and Moses.
verse_text_arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: ṣuḥufi ib'rāhīma wamūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: صحف إبرهيم وموسى

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Are you aware of the Overwhelming?
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu l-ghāshiyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل أتىك حديث الغشية

verse_text_english: Faces on that day will be shamed.
verse_text_arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wujūhun yawma-idhin khāshiʿatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجوه يومئذ خشعة

verse_text_english: Laboring and exhausted.
verse_text_arabic: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: aamilatun nasibatun
verse_text_arabic_clean: عاملة ناصبة

verse_text_english: Suffering in a blazing Hellfire.
verse_text_arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
verse_text_transliterated: taṣlā nāran ḥāmiyata
verse_text_arabic_clean: تصلى نارا حامية

verse_text_english: Drinking from a flaming spring.
verse_text_arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: tus'qā min ʿaynin āniyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: تسقى من عين ءانية

verse_text_english: They will have no food except the useless variety.
verse_text_arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
verse_text_transliterated: laysa lahum ṭaʿāmun illā min ḍarīʿi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليس لهم طعام إلا من ضريع

verse_text_english: It never nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yus'minu walā yugh'nī min jūʿi
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسمن ولا يغنى من جوع

verse_text_english: Other faces on that day will be full of joy.
verse_text_arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wujūhun yawma-idhin nāʿimatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجوه يومئذ ناعمة

verse_text_english: Satisfied with their work.
verse_text_arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: lisaʿyihā rāḍiyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: لسعيها راضية

verse_text_english: In an exalted Paradise.
verse_text_arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fī jannatin ʿāliyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى جنة عالية

verse_text_english: In it, no nonsense is heard.
verse_text_arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةً
verse_text_transliterated: lā tasmaʿu fīhā lāghiyata
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا تسمع فيها لغية

verse_text_english: In it, a spring flows.
verse_text_arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fīhā ʿaynun jāriyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيها عين جارية

verse_text_english: In it, there are luxurious furnishings.
verse_text_arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fīhā sururun marfūʿatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيها سرر مرفوعة

verse_text_english: And drinks made available.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-akwābun mawḍūʿatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأكواب موضوعة

verse_text_english: And pitchers in rows.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wanamāriqu maṣfūfatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونمارق مصفوفة

verse_text_english: And carpets throughout.
verse_text_arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wazarābiyyu mabthūthatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وزرابى مبثوثة

verse_text_english: Why do they not reflect on the camels and how they are created?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: afalā yanẓurūna ilā l-ibili kayfa khuliqa
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفلا ينظرون إلى الإبل كيف خلقت

verse_text_english: And the sky and how it is raised.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ilā l-samāi kayfa rufiʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإلى السماء كيف رفعت

verse_text_english: And the mountains and how they are constructed.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ilā l-jibāli kayfa nuṣiba
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإلى الجبال كيف نصبت

verse_text_english: And the earth and how it is built.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ilā l-arḍi kayfa suṭiḥa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإلى الأرض كيف سطحت

verse_text_english: You shall remind, for your mission is to deliver this reminder.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fadhakkir innamā anta mudhakkiru
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذكر إنما أنت مذكر

verse_text_english: You have no power over them.
verse_text_arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: lasta ʿalayhim bimuṣayṭiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: لست عليهم بمصيطر

verse_text_english: As for those who turn away and disbelieve.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā man tawallā wakafar
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا من تولى وكفر

verse_text_english: GOD will commit them to the great retribution.
verse_text_arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: fayuʿadhibuhu l-lahu l-ʿadhāba l-akbar
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيعذبه الله العذاب الأكبر

verse_text_english: To us is their ultimate destiny.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ilaynā iyābahu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن إلينا إيابهم

verse_text_english: Then we will call them to account.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
verse_text_transliterated: thumma inna ʿalaynā ḥisābahu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم إن علينا حسابهم

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: By the dawn.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-fajr
verse_text_arabic_clean: والفجر

verse_text_english: And the ten nights. *
verse_text_arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walayālin ʿashri
verse_footnote_english: *89:2 Last ten nights of Ramadan, wherein many believers retreat to the masjids (2:187).
verse_text_arabic_clean: وليال عشر

verse_text_english: By the even and the odd. *
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-shafʿi wal-watr
verse_footnote_english: *89:3 See Appendix 1 for the role of the even numbers and the odd numbers.
verse_text_arabic_clean: والشفع والوتر

verse_text_english: By the night as it passes.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-al-layli idhā yasr
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليل إذا يسر

verse_text_english: A profound oath, for one who possesses intelligence.
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hal fī dhālika qasamun lidhī ḥij'ri
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل فى ذلك قسم لذى حجر

verse_text_english: Have you noted what your Lord did to 'Ãd?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verse_text_transliterated: alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʿādi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد

verse_text_english: Erum; the town with tall buildings.
verse_text_arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: irama dhāti l-ʿimād
verse_text_arabic_clean: إرم ذات العماد

verse_text_english: There was nothing like it anywhere.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
verse_text_transliterated: allatī lam yukh'laq mith'luhā fī l-bilād
verse_text_arabic_clean: التى لم يخلق مثلها فى البلد

verse_text_english: Also Thamûd, who carved the rocks in their valley.
verse_text_arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: wathamūda alladhīna jābū l-ṣakhra bil-wād
verse_text_arabic_clean: وثمود الذين جابوا الصخر بالواد

verse_text_english: And Pharaoh who possessed might.
verse_text_arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: wafir'ʿawna dhī l-awtād
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفرعون ذى الأوتاد

verse_text_english: They all transgressed in the land.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna ṭaghaw fī l-bilād
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين طغوا فى البلد

verse_text_english: They spread evil throughout.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aktharū fīhā l-fasād
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأكثروا فيها الفساد

verse_text_english: Consequently, your Lord poured upon them a whipping retribution.
verse_text_arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: faṣabba ʿalayhim rabbuka sawṭa ʿadhābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب

verse_text_english: Your Lord is ever watchful.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna rabbaka labil-mir'ṣād
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ربك لبالمرصاد

verse_text_english: When the human being is tested by his Lord, through blessings and joy, he says, "My Lord is generous towards me."
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā l-insānu idhā mā ib'talāhu rabbuhu fa-akramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbī akraman
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما الإنسن إذا ما ابتلىه ربه فأكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربى أكرمن

verse_text_english: But if He tests him through reduction in provisions, he says, "My Lord is humiliating me!"
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā idhā mā ib'talāhu faqadara ʿalayhi riz'qahu fayaqūlu rabbī ahānan
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما إذا ما ابتلىه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربى أهنن

verse_text_english: Wrong! It is you who brought it on yourselves by not regarding the orphan.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā bal lā tuk'rimūna l-yatīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا بل لا تكرمون اليتيم

verse_text_english: And not advocating charity towards the poor.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: walā taḥāḍḍūna ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا تحضون على طعام المسكين

verse_text_english: And consuming the inheritance of helpless orphans.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
verse_text_transliterated: watakulūna l-turātha aklan lamma
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتأكلون التراث أكلا لما

verse_text_english: And loving the money too much.
verse_text_arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
verse_text_transliterated: watuḥibbūna l-māla ḥubban jamma
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتحبون المال حبا جما

verse_text_english: Indeed, when the earth is crushed, utterly crushed.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
verse_text_transliterated: kallā idhā dukkati l-arḍu dakkan dakka
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إذا دكت الأرض دكا دكا

verse_text_english: And your Lord comes, together with the angels in row after row.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
verse_text_transliterated: wajāa rabbuka wal-malaku ṣaffan ṣaffa
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجاء ربك والملك صفا صفا

verse_text_english: On that day, Gehenna will be brought forth. On that day, the human being will remember—but what a remembrance—it will be too late.
verse_text_arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wajīa yawma-idhin bijahannama yawma-idhin yatadhakkaru l-insānu wa-annā lahu l-dhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجاىء يومئذ بجهنم يومئذ يتذكر الإنسن وأنى له الذكرى

verse_text_english: He will say, "Oh, I wish I prepared for my (eternal) life."
verse_text_arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
verse_text_transliterated: yaqūlu yālaytanī qaddamtu liḥayāt
verse_text_arabic_clean: يقول يليتنى قدمت لحياتى

verse_text_english: On that day, no retribution could be worse than His retribution.
verse_text_arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fayawma-idhin lā yuʿadhibu ʿadhābahu aḥadu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيومئذ لا يعذب عذابه أحد

verse_text_english: And no confinement is as effective as His confinement.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: walā yūthiqu wathāqahu aḥadu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا يوثق وثاقه أحد

verse_text_english: As for you, O content soul.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
verse_text_transliterated: yāayyatuhā l-nafsu l-muṭ'ma-inat
verse_text_arabic_clean: يأيتها النفس المطمئنة

verse_text_english: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing.
verse_text_arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
verse_text_transliterated: ir'jiʿī ilā rabbiki rāḍiyatan marḍiyyata
verse_text_arabic_clean: ارجعى إلى ربك راضية مرضية

verse_text_english: Welcome into My servants.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ud'khulī fī ʿibād
verse_text_arabic_clean: فادخلى فى عبدى

verse_text_english: Welcome into My Paradise.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ud'khulī jannat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وادخلى جنتى

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: I solemnly swear by this town.
verse_text_arabic: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
verse_text_transliterated: lā uq'simu bihādhā l-balad
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا أقسم بهذا البلد

verse_text_english: The town where you live.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anta ḥillun bihādhā l-balad
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنت حل بهذا البلد

verse_text_english: The begetting and the begotten.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
verse_text_transliterated: wawālidin wamā walad
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووالد وما ولد

verse_text_english: We created the human being to work hard (to redeem himself).*
verse_text_arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī kabadi
verse_footnote_english: *90:4 See the Introduction and Appendix 7 for the purpose behind our creation.
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد خلقنا الإنسن فى كبد

verse_text_english: Does he think that no one will ever call him to account?
verse_text_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ayaḥsabu an lan yaqdira ʿalayhi aḥadu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أيحسب أن لن يقدر عليه أحد

verse_text_english: He boasts, "I spent so much money!"
verse_text_arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا
verse_text_transliterated: yaqūlu ahlaktu mālan lubada
verse_text_arabic_clean: يقول أهلكت مالا لبدا

verse_text_english: Does he think that no one sees him?
verse_text_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ayaḥsabu an lam yarahu aḥadu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أيحسب أن لم يره أحد

verse_text_english: Did we not give him two eyes?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
verse_text_transliterated: alam najʿal lahu ʿaynayn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم نجعل له عينين

verse_text_english: A tongue and two lips?
verse_text_arabic: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
verse_text_transliterated: walisānan washafatayn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولسانا وشفتين

verse_text_english: Did we not show him the two paths?
verse_text_arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
verse_text_transliterated: wahadaynāhu l-najdayn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهدينه النجدين

verse_text_english: He should choose the difficult path.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
verse_text_transliterated: falā iq'taḥama l-ʿaqabat
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا اقتحم العقبة

verse_text_english: Which one is the difficult path?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-ʿaqabat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما العقبة

verse_text_english: The freeing of slaves.
verse_text_arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fakku raqabati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فك رقبة

verse_text_english: Feeding, during the time of hardship.
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: aw iṭ'ʿāmun fī yawmin dhī masghabati
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو إطعم فى يوم ذى مسغبة

verse_text_english: Orphans who are related.
verse_text_arabic: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: yatīman dhā maqrabati
verse_text_arabic_clean: يتيما ذا مقربة

verse_text_english: Or the poor who is in need.
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: aw mis'kīnan dhā matrabati
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو مسكينا ذا متربة

verse_text_english: And being one of those who believe, and exhorting one another to be steadfast, and exhorting one another to be kind.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma kāna mina alladhīna āmanū watawāṣaw bil-ṣabri watawāṣaw bil-marḥamat
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم كان من الذين ءامنوا وتواصوا بالصبر وتواصوا بالمرحمة

verse_text_english: These have deserved happiness.
verse_text_arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: ulāika aṣḥābu l-maymanat
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولئك أصحب الميمنة

verse_text_english: As for those who disbelieved in our revelations, they have incurred misery.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyātinā hum aṣḥābu l-mashamat
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين كفروا بـٔايتنا هم أصحب المشـٔمة

verse_text_english: They will be confined in the Hellfire.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
verse_text_transliterated: ʿalayhim nārun mu'ṣadatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: عليهم نار مؤصدة

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: By the sun and its brightness.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-shamsi waḍuḥāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: والشمس وضحىها

verse_text_english: The moon that follows it.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-qamari idhā talāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: والقمر إذا تلىها

verse_text_english: The day that reveals.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-nahāri idhā jallāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنهار إذا جلىها

verse_text_english: The night that covers.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-al-layli idhā yaghshāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليل إذا يغشىها

verse_text_english: The sky and Him who built it.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-samāi wamā banāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسماء وما بنىها

verse_text_english: The earth and Him who sustains it.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-arḍi wamā ṭaḥāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: والأرض وما طحىها

verse_text_english: The soul and Him who created it.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wanafsin wamā sawwāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونفس وما سوىها

verse_text_english: Then showed it what is evil and what is good.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-alhamahā fujūrahā wataqwāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فألهمها فجورها وتقوىها

verse_text_english: Successful is one who redeems it.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: qad aflaḥa man zakkāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: قد أفلح من زكىها

verse_text_english: Failing is one who neglects it.
verse_text_arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: waqad khāba man dassāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقد خاب من دسىها

verse_text_english: Thamûd's disbelief caused them to transgress.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat thamūdu biṭaghwāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت ثمود بطغوىها

verse_text_english: They followed the worst among them.
verse_text_arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: idhi inbaʿatha ashqāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ انبعث أشقىها

verse_text_english: GOD's messenger said to them, "This is GOD's camel; let her drink."
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: faqāla lahum rasūlu l-lahi nāqata l-lahi wasuq'yāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقال لهم رسول الله ناقة الله وسقيها

verse_text_english: They disbelieved him and slaughtered her. Their Lord then requited them for their sin and annihilated them.
verse_text_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: fakadhabūhu faʿaqarūhā fadamdama ʿalayhim rabbuhum bidhanbihim fasawwāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم فسوىها

verse_text_english: Yet, those who came after them remain heedless.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
verse_text_transliterated: walā yakhāfu ʿuq'bāh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا يخاف عقبها

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: By the night as it covers.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-al-layli idhā yaghsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليل إذا يغشى

verse_text_english: The day as it reveals.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-nahāri idhā tajall
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنهار إذا تجلى

verse_text_english: And Him who created the male and the female.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā khalaqa l-dhakara wal-unth
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما خلق الذكر والأنثى

verse_text_english: Your works are of various kinds.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna saʿyakum lashatt
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن سعيكم لشتى

verse_text_english: As for him who gives to charity and maintains righteousness.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā man aʿṭā wa-ittaq
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما من أعطى واتقى

verse_text_english: And upholds the scripture.
verse_text_arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: waṣaddaqa bil-ḥus'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: وصدق بالحسنى

verse_text_english: We will direct him towards happiness.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fasanuyassiruhu lil'yus'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسنيسره لليسرى

verse_text_english: But he who is stingy, though he is rich.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā man bakhila wa-is'taghn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما من بخل واستغنى

verse_text_english: And disbelieves in the scripture.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhaba bil-ḥus'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذب بالحسنى

verse_text_english: We will direct him towards misery.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fasanuyassiruhu lil'ʿus'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسنيسره للعسرى

verse_text_english: His money cannot help him when he falls.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yugh'nī ʿanhu māluhu idhā taradd
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يغنى عنه ماله إذا تردى

verse_text_english: We provide the guidance.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ʿalaynā lalhud
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن علينا للهدى

verse_text_english: We control the Hereafter, as well as this life.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna lanā lalākhirata wal-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن لنا للءاخرة والأولى

verse_text_english: I have warned you about the blazing Hellfire.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-andhartukum nāran talaẓẓ
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأنذرتكم نارا تلظى

verse_text_english: None burns therein except the wicked.
verse_text_arabic: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
verse_text_transliterated: lā yaṣlāhā illā l-ashq
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يصلىها إلا الأشقى

verse_text_english: Who disbelieves and turns away.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī kadhaba watawall
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى كذب وتولى

verse_text_english: Avoiding it will be the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
verse_text_transliterated: wasayujannabuhā l-atq
verse_text_arabic_clean: وسيجنبها الأتقى

verse_text_english: Who gives from his money to charity.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī yu'tī mālahu yatazakk
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى يؤتى ماله يتزكى

verse_text_english: Seeking nothing in return.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā li-aḥadin ʿindahu min niʿ'matin tuj'z
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما لأحد عنده من نعمة تجزى

verse_text_english: Seeking only his Lord, the Most High.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ib'tighāa wajhi rabbihi l-aʿl
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا ابتغاء وجه ربه الأعلى

verse_text_english: He will certainly attain salvation.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walasawfa yarḍ
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولسوف يرضى

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: By the forenoon.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ḍuḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: والضحى

verse_text_english: By the night as it falls.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-al-layli idhā saj
verse_text_arabic_clean: واليل إذا سجى

verse_text_english: Your Lord never abandoned you, nor did He forget.
verse_text_arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: mā waddaʿaka rabbuka wamā qal
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما ودعك ربك وما قلى

verse_text_english: The Hereafter is far better for you than this first (life).
verse_text_arabic: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walalākhiratu khayrun laka mina l-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: وللءاخرة خير لك من الأولى

verse_text_english: And your Lord will give you enough; you will be pleased.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: walasawfa yuʿ'ṭīka rabbuka fatarḍ
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولسوف يعطيك ربك فترضى

verse_text_english: Did He not find you orphaned and He gave you a home?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alam yajid'ka yatīman faāw
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم يجدك يتيما فـٔاوى

verse_text_english: He found you astray, and guided you.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wawajadaka ḍāllan fahad
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووجدك ضالا فهدى

verse_text_english: He found you poor, and made you rich.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wawajadaka ʿāilan fa-aghn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووجدك عائلا فأغنى

verse_text_english: Therefore, you shall not forsake the orphan.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā l-yatīma falā taqha
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما اليتيم فلا تقهر

verse_text_english: Nor shall you reprimand the beggar.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā l-sāila falā tanha
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما السائل فلا تنهر

verse_text_english: You shall proclaim the blessing your Lord has bestowed upon you.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā biniʿ'mati rabbika faḥaddit
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما بنعمة ربك فحدث

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Did we not cool your temper?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
verse_text_transliterated: alam nashraḥ laka ṣadrak
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم نشرح لك صدرك

verse_text_english: And we unloaded your load (of sins).
verse_text_arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
verse_text_transliterated: wawaḍaʿnā ʿanka wiz'rak
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووضعنا عنك وزرك

verse_text_english: One that burdened your back.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī anqaḍa ẓahrak
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى أنقض ظهرك

verse_text_english: We exalted you to an honorable position.
verse_text_arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
verse_text_transliterated: warafaʿnā laka dhik'rak
verse_text_arabic_clean: ورفعنا لك ذكرك

verse_text_english: With pain there is gain.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإن مع العسر يسرا

verse_text_english: Indeed, with pain there is gain.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن مع العسر يسرا

verse_text_english: Whenever possible you shall strive.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā faraghta fa-inṣa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا فرغت فانصب

verse_text_english: Seeking only your Lord.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ilā rabbika fa-ir'gha
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإلى ربك فارغب

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: By the fig and the olive.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-tīni wal-zaytūn
verse_footnote_english: *95:1-3 The fig, olive, Sinai, and Mecca possibly symbolize Adam, Jesus, Moses, Abraham, and Muhammad, respectively. Thus, all major religions are represented.
verse_text_arabic_clean: والتين والزيتون

verse_text_english: Mount Sinai.
verse_text_arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waṭūri sīnīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وطور سينين

verse_text_english: And this honored town (Mecca).*
verse_text_arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wahādhā l-baladi l-amīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهذا البلد الأمين

verse_text_english: We created man in the best design.
verse_text_arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد خلقنا الإنسن فى أحسن تقويم

verse_text_english: Then turned him into the lowliest of the lowly.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma radadnāhu asfala sāfilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم رددنه أسفل سفلين

verse_text_english: Except those who believe and lead a righteous life; they receive a reward that is well deserved.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فلهم أجر غير ممنون

verse_text_english: Why do you still reject the faith?
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: famā yukadhibuka baʿdu bil-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما يكذبك بعد بالدين

verse_text_english: Is GOD not the Most Wise, of all the wise ones?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: alaysa l-lahu bi-aḥkami l-ḥākimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أليس الله بأحكم الحكمين

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Read, in the name of your Lord, who created.*
verse_text_arabic: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
verse_text_transliterated: iq'ra bi-is'mi rabbika alladhī khalaq
verse_footnote_english: *96:1-19 From 96 to 114 is 19 suras. The first revelation (96:1-5) is 19 Arabic words, 76 letters (19x4). The sura consists of 19 verses and 304 Arabic letters (App. 1 & 23).
verse_text_arabic_clean: اقرأ باسم ربك الذى خلق

verse_text_english: He created man from an embryo.
verse_text_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: khalaqa l-insāna min ʿalaqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلق الإنسن من علق

verse_text_english: Read, and your Lord, Most Exalted.
verse_text_arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
verse_text_transliterated: iq'ra warabbuka l-akram
verse_text_arabic_clean: اقرأ وربك الأكرم

verse_text_english: Teaches by means of the pen.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī ʿallama bil-qalam
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى علم بالقلم

verse_text_english: He teaches man what he never knew.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
verse_text_transliterated: allama al-insana ma lamyaAAlam
verse_text_arabic_clean: علم الإنسن ما لم يعلم

verse_text_english: Indeed, the human transgresses.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā inna l-insāna layaṭgh
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا إن الإنسن ليطغى

verse_text_english: When he becomes rich.
verse_text_arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: an raāhu is'taghn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن رءاه استغنى

verse_text_english: To your Lord is the ultimate destiny.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ilā rabbika l-ruj'ʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن إلى ربك الرجعى

verse_text_english: Have you seen the one who enjoins.
verse_text_arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: ara-ayta alladhī yanh
verse_text_arabic_clean: أرءيت الذى ينهى

verse_text_english: Others from praying?
verse_text_arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: abdan itha salla
verse_text_arabic_clean: عبدا إذا صلى

verse_text_english: Is it not better for him to follow the guidance?
verse_text_arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
