verse_text_transliterated: ara-ayta in kāna ʿalā l-hud
verse_text_arabic_clean: أرءيت إن كان على الهدى

verse_text_english: Or advocate righteousness?
verse_text_arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: aw amara bil-taqw
verse_text_arabic_clean: أو أمر بالتقوى

verse_text_english: If he disbelieves and turns away.
verse_text_arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: ara-ayta in kadhaba watawall
verse_text_arabic_clean: أرءيت إن كذب وتولى

verse_text_english: Does he not realize that GOD sees?
verse_text_arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: alam yaʿlam bi-anna l-laha yar
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألم يعلم بأن الله يرى

verse_text_english: Indeed, unless he refrains, we will take him by the forelock.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā la-in lam yantahi lanasfaʿan bil-nāṣiyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا لئن لم ينته لنسفعا بالناصية

verse_text_english: A forelock that is disbelieving and sinful.
verse_text_arabic: نَاصِيَةٍ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: nāṣiyatin kādhibatin khāṭi-ati
verse_text_arabic_clean: ناصية كذبة خاطئة

verse_text_english: Let him then call on his helpers.
verse_text_arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: falyadʿu nādiyah
verse_text_arabic_clean: فليدع ناديه

verse_text_english: We will call the guardians of Hell.
verse_text_arabic: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
verse_text_transliterated: sanadʿu l-zabāniyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: سندع الزبانية

verse_text_english: You shall not obey him; you shall fall prostrate and draw nearer.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب
verse_text_transliterated: kallā lā tuṭiʿ'hu wa-us'jud wa-iq'tari
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا لا تطعه واسجد واقترب

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: We revealed it in the Night of Destiny.*
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā anzalnāhu fī laylati l-qadr
verse_footnote_english: *97:1 The Quran was placed into Muhammad's soul on the 27th night of Ramadan, 13 B.H. (Before Hijrah). See also 17:1, 44:3, 53:1-18, and Appendix 28.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أنزلنه فى ليلة القدر

verse_text_english: How awesome is the Night of Destiny!
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā laylatu l-qadr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما ليلة القدر

verse_text_english: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.
verse_text_arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: laylatu l-qadri khayrun min alfi shahri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر

verse_text_english: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by their Lord's leave, to carry out every command.
verse_text_arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: tanazzalu l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu fīhā bi-idh'ni rabbihim min kulli amri
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزل الملئكة والروح فيها بإذن ربهم من كل أمر

verse_text_english: Peaceful it is until the advent of the dawn.
verse_text_arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: salāmun hiya ḥattā maṭlaʿi l-fajr
verse_text_arabic_clean: سلم هى حتى مطلع الفجر

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture, as well as the idol worshipers, insist on their ways, despite the proof given to them.*
verse_text_arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: lam yakuni alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna munfakkīna ḥattā tatiyahumu l-bayinat
verse_footnote_english: *98:1-2 The proof is the Quran's mathematical code (Appendix 1) and the messenger is Rashad Khalifa. The No. of sura (98), plus the verse No. (2), plus the numerical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230) add up to 1330 (19x70), the same total as in 81:19 (App. 2).
verse_text_arabic_clean: لم يكن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتب والمشركين منفكين حتى تأتيهم البينة

verse_text_english: A messenger from GOD is reciting to them sacred instructions.*
verse_text_arabic: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
verse_text_transliterated: rasūlun mina l-lahi yatlū ṣuḥufan muṭahharata
verse_text_arabic_clean: رسول من الله يتلوا صحفا مطهرة

verse_text_english: In them there are valuable teachings.
verse_text_arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fīhā kutubun qayyimatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فيها كتب قيمة

verse_text_english: In fact, those who received the scripture did not dispute until the proof was given to them.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā tafarraqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba illā min baʿdi mā jāathumu l-bayinat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تفرق الذين أوتوا الكتب إلا من بعد ما جاءتهم البينة

verse_text_english: All that was asked of them was to worship GOD, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone, observe the contact prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). Such is the perfect religion.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā umirū illā liyaʿbudū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna ḥunafāa wayuqīmū l-ṣalata wayu'tū l-zakata wadhālika dīnu l-qayimat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين له الدين حنفاء ويقيموا الصلوة ويؤتوا الزكوة وذلك دين القيمة

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture, and the idol worshipers have incurred the fire of Gehenna forever. They are the worst creatures.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna fī nāri jahannama khālidīna fīhā ulāika hum sharru l-bariyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتب والمشركين فى نار جهنم خلدين فيها أولئك هم شر البرية

verse_text_english: Those who believed and led a righteous life are the best creatures.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika hum khayru l-bariyat
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت أولئك هم خير البرية

verse_text_english: Their reward at their Lord is the gardens of Eden with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. GOD is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. Such is the reward for those who reverence their Lord.
verse_text_arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: jazāuhum ʿinda rabbihim jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu dhālika liman khashiya rabbah
verse_text_arabic_clean: جزاؤهم عند ربهم جنت عدن تجرى من تحتها الأنهر خلدين فيها أبدا رضى الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك لمن خشى ربه

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: When the earth is severely quaked.
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
verse_text_transliterated: idhā zul'zilati l-arḍu zil'zālah
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا زلزلت الأرض زلزالها

verse_text_english: And the earth ejects its loads.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-akhrajati l-arḍu athqālah
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأخرجت الأرض أثقالها

verse_text_english: The human will wonder: "What is happening?"
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
verse_text_transliterated: waqāla l-insānu mā lah
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقال الإنسن ما لها

verse_text_english: On that day, it will tell its news.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma-idhin tuḥaddithu akhbārah
verse_text_arabic_clean: يومئذ تحدث أخبارها

verse_text_english: That your Lord has commanded it.
verse_text_arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
verse_text_transliterated: bi-anna rabbaka awḥā lah
verse_text_arabic_clean: بأن ربك أوحى لها

verse_text_english: On that day, the people will issue from every direction, to be shown their works.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma-idhin yaṣduru l-nāsu ashtātan liyuraw aʿmālahu
verse_text_arabic_clean: يومئذ يصدر الناس أشتاتا ليروا أعملهم

verse_text_english: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: faman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin khayran yarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره

verse_text_english: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: waman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin sharran yarah
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: By the fast gallopers.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والعديت ضبحا

verse_text_english: Igniting sparks.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-mūriyāti qadḥa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالموريت قدحا

verse_text_english: Invading (the enemy) by morning.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-mughīrāti ṣub'ḥa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالمغيرت صبحا

verse_text_english: Striking terror therein.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
verse_text_transliterated: fa-atharna bihi naqʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأثرن به نقعا

verse_text_english: Penetrating to the heart of their territory.
verse_text_arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
verse_text_transliterated: fawasaṭna bihi jamʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: فوسطن به جمعا

verse_text_english: The human being is unappreciative of his Lord.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-insāna lirabbihi lakanūdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الإنسن لربه لكنود

verse_text_english: He bears witness to this fact.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu ʿalā dhālika lashahīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه على ذلك لشهيد

verse_text_english: He loves material things excessively.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahu liḥubbi l-khayri lashadīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنه لحب الخير لشديد

verse_text_english: Does he not realize that the day will come when the graves are opened?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفلا يعلم إذا بعثر ما فى القبور

verse_text_english: And all secrets are brought out.
verse_text_arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: waḥuṣṣila mā fī l-ṣudūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحصل ما فى الصدور

verse_text_english: They will find out, on that day, that their Lord has been fully Cognizant of them.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
verse_text_transliterated: inna rabbahum bihim yawma-idhin lakhabīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ربهم بهم يومئذ لخبير

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The Shocker.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: al-qāriʿat
verse_text_arabic_clean: القارعة

verse_text_english: What a shocker!
verse_text_arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: mā l-qāriʿat
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما القارعة

verse_text_english: Do you have any idea what the Shocker is?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-qāriʿat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما القارعة

verse_text_english: That is the day when the people come out like swarms of butterflies.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yakūnu l-nāsu kal-farāshi l-mabthūth
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يكون الناس كالفراش المبثوث

verse_text_english: The mountains will be like fluffy wool.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
verse_text_transliterated: watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'ni l-manfūsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتكون الجبال كالعهن المنفوش

verse_text_english: As for him whose weights are heavy.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ammā man thaqulat mawāzīnuh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأما من ثقلت موزينه

verse_text_english: He will lead a happy (eternal) life.
verse_text_arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fahuwa fī ʿīshatin rāḍiyati
verse_text_arabic_clean: فهو فى عيشة راضية

verse_text_english: As for him whose weights are light.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ammā man khaffat mawāzīnuh
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأما من خفت موزينه

verse_text_english: His destiny is lowly.
verse_text_arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ummuhu hāwiyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأمه هاوية

verse_text_english: Do you know what it is?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā adrāka mā hiya
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أدرىك ما هيه

verse_text_english: The blazing Hellfire.
verse_text_arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
verse_text_transliterated: nārun ḥāmiyatu
verse_text_arabic_clean: نار حامية

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: You remain preoccupied with hoarding.
verse_text_arabic: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
verse_text_transliterated: alhākumu l-takāthur
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألهىكم التكاثر

verse_text_english: Until you go to the graves.
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā zur'tumu l-maqābir
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى زرتم المقابر

verse_text_english: Indeed, you will find out.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā sawfa taʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا سوف تعلمون

verse_text_english: Most assuredly, you will find out.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم كلا سوف تعلمون

verse_text_english: If only you could find out for certain.
verse_text_arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: kallā law taʿlamūna ʿil'ma l-yaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلا لو تعلمون علم اليقين

verse_text_english: You would envision Hell.
verse_text_arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: latarawunna l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: لترون الجحيم

verse_text_english: Then you would see it with the eye of certainty.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma latarawunnahā ʿayna l-yaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم لترونها عين اليقين

verse_text_english: Then you will be questioned, on that day, about the blessings you had enjoyed.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: As if his money will make him immortal.

verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
verse_text_transliterated: qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaq
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أعوذ برب الفلق

verse_text_english: "From the evils among His creations.
verse_text_arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
verse_text_transliterated: min sharri mā khalaq
verse_text_arabic_clean: من شر ما خلق

verse_text_english: "From the evils of darkness as it falls.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن شر غاسق إذا وقب

verse_text_english: "From the evils of the troublemakers.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin sharri l-nafāthāti fī l-ʿuqad
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن شر النفثت فى العقد

verse_text_english: "From the evils of the envious when they envy."
verse_text_arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد

verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of the people.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
verse_text_transliterated: qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-nās
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل أعوذ برب الناس

verse_text_english: "The King of the people.
verse_text_arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verse_text_transliterated: maliki l-nās
verse_text_arabic_clean: ملك الناس

verse_text_english: "The god of the people.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verse_text_transliterated: ilāhi l-nās
verse_text_arabic_clean: إله الناس

verse_text_english: "From the evils of sneaky whisperers.
verse_text_arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
verse_text_transliterated: min sharri l-waswāsi l-khanās
verse_text_arabic_clean: من شر الوسواس الخناس

verse_text_english: "Who whisper into the chests of the people.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri l-nās
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى يوسوس فى صدور الناس

verse_text_english: "Be they of the jinns, or the people."
verse_text_arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
verse_text_transliterated: mina l-jinati wal-nās
verse_footnote_english: *114:6 Thus, the total occurrence of the crucial word "God" (Allah) throughout the Quran is 2698, 19x142. The reader can ascertain the accuracy of this total by randomly checking the numbers of the word "God" at the bottom of any pages in this book. Additionally, if one adds the verse numbers wherever the word "God" occurs, the total comes to 118123, also a multiple of 19 (118123 = 19x6217). Details of the Quran's unique mathematical composition are given in Appendices 1, 2, 24, 25, 26, and 29.
verse_text_arabic_clean: من الجنة والناس
